```python
            event_data["error"] = event["error"]
        session_manager.publish(
            EditorEventType.TOOL_EXECUTED, event["tool"], session_id, **event_data,
        )

    def list_models(self) -> dict:
        """Doorway function: list Ollama models installed on this host."""
        error = None
        try:
            models = [m.get("model") or m.get("name") for m in ollama.list().get("models", [])]
        except Exception as exc:
            models = []
            error = str(exc)
        return {
            "models": sorted(models),
            "default": "qwen2.5-coder:latest",
            "error": error if not models else None,
        }

    def export_session(self, session_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Render a session as Markdown; returns ``(filename, markdown)``."""
        agent = self.sessions.get(session_id)
        if agent is None:
            raise SessionNotFoundError(f"Session '{session_id}' not found.")

        now = datetime.now()
        timestamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
        safe_session_id = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", session_id).strip("._")
        if not safe_session_id:
            safe_session_id = "session"
        filename = f"novous_{safe_session_id}_{timestamp}.md"
        exported_at = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        agent_name = agent.profile.name or session_id

        lines = [
            f"# Novous Chat Session Log — {agent_name}",
            f"**Agent ID:** `{agent.profile.id}` | **Model:** `{agent.model}` | "
            f"**Session Key:** `{session_id}`",
            f"**Exported At:** `{exported_at}`",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
            "## Tool Execution Metrics",
            "",
        ]

        if agent.tool_stats:
            lines.extend([
                "| Tool Name | Total Calls | Successes | Errors | Success Rate |",
                "| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |",
            ])
            for tool_name, metrics in agent.tool_stats.items():
                lines.append(
                    f"| `{tool_name}` | {metrics['calls']} | {metrics['successes']} | "
                    f"{metrics['errors']} | {metrics['success_rate']:.1%} |"
                )
        else:
            lines.append("*No tools executed in this session.*")

        lines.extend(["", "---", "", "## Conversation History", ""])
        for msg in agent.messages:
            role = str(msg.get("role", "unknown")).upper()
            if role == "SYSTEM":
                continue
            content = msg.get("content") or ""
            lines.extend([f"### {role.title()}", "", str(content), ""])

        full_markdown = "\n".join(lines)
        return filename, full_markdown


agent_library = AgentLibrary()
tool_catalog = ToolCatalog()
tool = tool_catalog.tool
questionnaire = QuestionnaireRegistry()
chat_service = ChatService()


# --- Built-in tools (registered by ToolCatalog.load_tools) -----------------------------

_OPERATORS = {
    ast.Add: operator.add,
    ast.Sub: operator.sub,
    ast.Mult: operator.mul,
    ast.Div: operator.truediv,
    ast.FloorDiv: operator.floordiv,
    ast.Mod: operator.mod,
    ast.Pow: operator.pow,
    ast.USub: operator.neg,
    ast.UAdd: operator.pos,
}


def _safe_eval(expr: str):
    def _eval(node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
            return _eval(node.body)
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, (int, float)):
            return node.value
        if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and type(node.op) in _OPERATORS:
            return _OPERATORS[type(node.op)](_eval(node.left), _eval(node.right))
        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and type(node.op) in _OPERATORS:
            return _OPERATORS[type(node.op)](_eval(node.operand))
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported expression element: {ast.dump(node)}")

    return _eval(ast.parse(expr, mode="eval"))


@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="core_engine")
def calculator(expression: str) -> str:
    """Evaluate a basic arithmetic expression (numbers, + - * / // % ** and parentheses)."""
    result = _safe_eval(expression)
    return f"{expression} = {result}"

@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="editor")
def extract_docstrings(path: str) -> str:
    """Parse Python code AST to extract module, class, and function docstrings."""
    try:
        abs_path = editor_files.resolve_project_path(path)
        code = abs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        parsed_tree = ast.parse(code)

        docstrings = {
            "file": path,
            "module_docstring": ast.get_docstring(parsed_tree),
            "classes": {},
            "functions": {},
        }

        for node in ast.walk(parsed_tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                docstrings["classes"][node.name] = ast.get_docstring(node)
            elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                docstrings["functions"][node.name] = ast.get_docstring(node)

        return json.dumps(docstrings, indent=2)
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Error extracting docstrings from '{path}': {exc}"


@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="editor")
def search_workspace(query: str, extension: str = ".py") -> str:
    """Search workspace files for matching keyword or snippet."""
    try:
        matches = []
        ext = extension if extension.startswith(".") else f".{extension}"
        for file_path in editor_files.PROJECT_ROOT.rglob(f"*{ext}"):
            if not file_path.is_file() or file_path.name.startswith("."):
                continue
            try:
                rel = str(file_path.relative_to(editor_files.PROJECT_ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")
                content = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                for idx, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
                    if query.lower() in line.lower():
                        matches.append(f"{rel}:{idx} - {line.strip()}")
            except Exception:
                continue
        return (
            "\n".join(matches[:50])
            if matches
            else f"No matches found for query '{query}'."
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Error searching workspace: {exc}"


@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="codebuilder")
def run_python_code(code: str) -> str:
    """Run a Python snippet in CodeBuilder and return its output and diagnostics."""
    from codebuilder.execution import execute_python_code
    from codebuilder.schemas_codebuilder import CodeExecutionRequest

    from orchestration.logic_orchestration import codebuilder_run_state, telemetry_bus

    result = execute_python_code(CodeExecutionRequest(code=code))
    context = telemetry_bus.current_context()
    if context is not None:
        trace_id, agent_id = context
        source_matches_editor = codebuilder_run_state.matches_editor_source(trace_id, code)
        if codebuilder_run_state.save_execution(
            trace_id,
            code,
            result.model_dump(),
            allow_non_editor_source=agent_id == "tester",
        ):
            diagnostic_lines = sorted(
                {
                    item.line
                    for item in result.diagnostics
                    if source_matches_editor and item.line is not None and item.line > 0
                }
            )[:120]
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "EDITOR_CODE_EXECUTION", agent_id, "editor",
                {
                    "status": "success" if result.status == "SUCCESS" else "error",
                    "diagnostic_lines": diagnostic_lines,
                },
            )
    return json.dumps(result.model_dump(), ensure_ascii=False)

@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="codebuilder")
def preview_editor_code(proposed_content: str) -> str:
    """Preview complete proposed code in the active CodeBuilder editor without saving it."""
    from orchestration.logic_orchestration import (
        MAX_EDITOR_CONTENT_BYTES,
        codebuilder_run_state,
        telemetry_bus,
    )
    from tools.logic_tools import code_change_preview

    if not isinstance(proposed_content, str):
        raise ValueError("The editor preview must be text.")
    if len(proposed_content.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_EDITOR_CONTENT_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("The editor preview exceeds the 1 MB limit.")
    context = telemetry_bus.current_context()
    if context is None:
        raise ValueError("Editor-buffer previews are only available during a CodeBuilder workflow.")
    trace_id, agent_id = context
    original = codebuilder_run_state.get_editor_code(trace_id)
    if original is None:
        raise ValueError("The original CodeBuilder editor buffer is unavailable for this workflow.")
    lines = code_change_preview.changed_line_numbers(original, proposed_content, "after")
    if not codebuilder_run_state.save_preview(trace_id, proposed_content, lines):
        raise ValueError("The CodeBuilder workflow preview could not be saved.")
    telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "EDITOR_CODE_PREVIEW", agent_id, "editor", {"changed_lines": lines})
    return json.dumps(
        {"status": "success" if lines else "nothing_found", "changed_lines": lines},
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )


_HTTP_METHOD_DECORATORS = {"get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete", "options", "head"}


@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="codebuilder")
def inspect_http_routes(path: str) -> str:
    """Statically list HTTP route decorators in a workspace Python file without running the server."""
    from tools.logic_tools import workspace_files

    if not isinstance(path, str) or not path.strip() or len(path) > 512:
        raise ValueError("Provide a workspace-relative Python file path.")
    if not path.lower().endswith(".py"):
        raise ValueError("HTTP route inspection only accepts Python source files.")
    source_info = workspace_files.read_file_bytes(path, 1_000_000)
    source = source_info["content"].decode("utf-8")
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=path)
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not inspect routes in {path}: Python syntax error at line {exc.lineno}."
        ) from exc

    routes = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            continue
        for decorator in node.decorator_list:
            if not isinstance(decorator, ast.Call) or not isinstance(decorator.func, ast.Attribute):
                continue
            method = decorator.func.attr.lower()
            if method in _HTTP_METHOD_DECORATORS:
                method_names = [method.upper()]
            elif method in {"route", "api_route"}:
                methods_node = next(
                    (keyword.value for keyword in decorator.keywords if keyword.arg == "methods"),
                    None,
                )
                method_names = (
                    sorted(
                        {
                            item.value.upper()
                            for item in methods_node.elts
                            if isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str)
                        }
                    )
                    if isinstance(methods_node, (ast.List, ast.Tuple))
                    else []
                )
            else:
                continue
            path_node = decorator.args[0] if decorator.args else None
            routes.append(
                {
                    "line": decorator.lineno,
                    "function": node.name,
                    "route": path_node.value
                    if isinstance(path_node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(path_node.value, str)
                    else None,
                    "methods": method_names,
                    "router": decorator.func.value.id
                    if isinstance(decorator.func.value, ast.Name)
                    else None,
                }
            )
    routes.sort(key=lambda route: route["line"])
    return json.dumps({"path": source_info["path"], "routes": routes}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)


@tool_catalog.builtin(provider="core_engine")
def preview_code_change(path: str, proposed_content: str) -> str:
    """Preview changed line numbers for a workspace file without writing its contents."""
    from tools.logic_tools import code_change_preview

    return json.dumps(code_change_preview.preview(path, proposed_content), ensure_ascii=False)
```

```python
"""Core-engine data contracts: agent profiles, chat/session requests and tool metadata."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable, List, Literal, TypedDict

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

AgentEnvironment = Literal["workspace", "codebuilder", "prompt-creation"]


@dataclass
class AgentProfile:
    id: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    description: str = ""
    mode: str = "chat"  # "agent" attaches tools; "chat" takes none
    system_prompt: str = ""
    role: str = ""
    purpose: str = ""
    boundaries: str = ""
    model: str = ""
    tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    extras: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


class CreateAgentRequest(BaseModel):
    agent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=120)
    description: str = ""
    mode: str = "chat"
    squad: str = ""
    environment: AgentEnvironment = "workspace"
    environment_name: str = Field("", max_length=64)


AgentDefinitionKind = Literal["prompt", "subagent"]


class SubagentUsage(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    usage: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)


class AgentToolsRequest(BaseModel):
    tools: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=200)
    mode: Literal["chat", "agent"] | None = None
    # None keeps the sub-agents the prompt already lists; [] clears them.
    subagents: List[SubagentUsage] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50)


class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    message: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    agent_id: str
    model: str = "qwen2.5-coder:latest"
    session_id: str | None = None
    environment: AgentEnvironment = "workspace"


class ExportSessionRequest(BaseModel):
    session_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class AnswerSubmissionRequest(BaseModel):
    request_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    answers: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ToolMetadata(TypedDict, total=False):
    """One ``ToolCatalog.registry`` entry."""
    name: str
    function: Callable
    provider: str
    description: list[str] | str
    signature: str
    custom: bool
```

## `docs/tool-library.md`
```markdown
# Tools

Agents call the tools in `tools/`, `core_engine/` and the promoted module. This page covers the
Tool Library and the Tool Workbench, where tools are edited, tested and added.

## Where things are

- `tools/promoted_tools.py`: custom tools added from the Workbench. Each one is a public
  top-level function decorated with `@tool`, after the `# PROMOTION_MARKER` line.
- `tools/data/tool_prompts.json`: the wording the LLM sees for each tool, saved from the
  Tool Library (`{"tool_name": "one-line wording"}`).
- `tools/logic_tools.py` (`ToolRegistryService`): add, update, remove and read tools.
- `tools/interface_tools.py`: the `/api/tools/*` routes.

## Writing a tool

- The **docstring** describes how the tool works, what it expects as input and what it
  returns. You read it in the code and the Workbench.
- The **prompt wording** is the one line an agent sees in its function schema and in its
  `## Available Tools` section. Write it as a use instruction, for example:
  "Ask the user questions in a questionnaire window when you need their background, goals or
  constraints before you can give advice; returns their answers."
- When no wording is saved, the agent sees the first line of the docstring.
- The function name is the tool name. Use short snake_case names. Models misspell long
  camelCase names, and a misspelled name cannot be called.

## Tool Library (Tools tab → Tool Workbench → Registered Tool Library)

- **Edit** opens a tool.
  - Custom tools: change the code and click **Save code**. The function must keep its name.
    Syntax errors, a missing function, or code that fails to load are refused, and the file
    is restored.
  - Built-in tools: the code is read-only, but the prompt wording can be changed.
- **Prompt description**: save the wording for the tool. Saving rewrites the
  `## Available Tools` section of every agent and sub-agent that uses the tool, so the new
  wording reaches them. Clear the box and save to go back to the docstring.
  - Wording is one default per tool. Different wording per model is not built yet.
  - Do not hand-edit the `## Available Tools` section of an agent. It is generated, and
    saving the tool's wording replaces it.
- **Remove** deletes a custom tool from `promoted_tools.py`.

## Tool Workbench test (Stage 2: Ask LLM to Use Function)

- Tick one or more installed models. Models without tool support are shown but cannot be
  ticked. Each ticked model is asked in turn, and the results appear in a table.
- Click a row to see that model's reply, the arguments it sent and how the call was made
  (`native` for a structured tool call, `text_json` for a call written as JSON text).
- **Check the call only** asks for the call and checks its arguments, without running the
  tool. Use it for tools that open a window, such as the questionnaire.
- The test uses the same schema an agent sends: the saved wording, and every parameter as a
  string. A call that passes here is the call an agent would make.
- Results to look for:
  - `CALL_VALID`: the model made a valid call (dry run).
  - `SUCCESS`: the call ran and returned a result.
  - `ERR_NO_TOOL_CALL`: the model replied in text and made no call.
  - `ERR_UNEXPECTED_TOOL_CALL`: it called another name. A near-miss name gets a hint.
  - `ERR_INVALID_TOOL_ARGUMENTS`: the arguments do not match the signature.
  - `UNSUPPORTED`: the model cannot use tools.
- Every model is asked once. One run can pass by chance, so repeat the test on a model you
  plan to rely on.

## Stage 3 and 4: direct Python test and promotion

- **Direct Python Test** runs the code locally with the arguments you enter. It is not
  isolated from the filesystem or network. GUI tools open their windows here.
- **Add Passed Tool to Library** promotes the tool after its direct test passes. It does not
  yet require a passing LLM test.

## Checking agents against models

Each agent's tools are checked against each installed model's tool limit. See
[`modelProfiles/README.md`](../modelProfiles/README.md#tool-limits-and-tool-checks) for the
`pinned_tools` setting and the warnings.

```

```python
"""Editor doorway: FastAPI router for /api/file/*, /api/directory/*, /api/editor/* and /api/ws."""

import asyncio

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from editor.logic_editor import editor_files, session_manager
from editor.schemas_editor import EditorEventType, FileRequest, PathRequest

router = APIRouter()


# --- REST endpoints --------------------------------------------------------

@router.get("/api/file/read")
def api_read_file(path: str):
    try:
        return editor_files.read_file_content(path)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/api/file/write")
def api_write_file(req: FileRequest, session_id: str = "http"):
    try:
        result = editor_files.write_file_content(req.path, req.content)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    session_manager.publish(EditorEventType.FILE_SAVED, req.path, session_id,
                     bytes=result["bytes_written"])
    return result


@router.post("/api/file/create")
def api_create_file(req: PathRequest, session_id: str = "http"):
    try:
        result = editor_files.create_path(req.path, req.kind)
    except (ValueError, FileExistsError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    session_manager.publish(EditorEventType.FILE_CREATED, req.path, session_id, kind=req.kind)
    return result


@router.post("/api/file/delete")
def api_delete_file(req: PathRequest, session_id: str = "http"):
    try:
        result = editor_files.delete_path(req.path)
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
    except IsADirectoryError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    session_manager.publish(EditorEventType.FILE_DELETED, req.path, session_id)
    return result


@router.get("/api/directory/tree")
def api_directory_tree(path: str = ""):
    try:
        return editor_files.get_directory_tree(path)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/api/editor/sessions")
def api_editor_sessions():
    return {"sessions": [{"session_id": s.session_id, "client": s.client,
                          "active_path": s.active_path} for s in session_manager.sessions()],
            "events": session_manager.recent_events()}


# --- WebSocket event bus ---------------------------------------------------

@router.websocket("/api/ws")
async def api_ws(websocket: WebSocket):
    await websocket.accept()
    session = session_manager.create_session(client=websocket.client.host if websocket.client else "unknown")
    queue = session_manager.subscribe(session.session_id)
    await websocket.send_json({"type": "connected", "session_id": session.session_id,
                               "sessions": len(session_manager.sessions())})

    async def pump_events():
        while True:
            payload = await queue.get()
            await websocket.send_json(payload)

    pump = asyncio.create_task(pump_events())
    try:
        while True:
            data = await websocket.receive_json()
            msg_type = data.get("type", "")
            if msg_type == "file_opened":
                session_manager.set_active_path(session.session_id, data.get("path", ""))
                session_manager.publish(EditorEventType.FILE_OPENED, data.get("path", ""),
                                session.session_id)
            elif msg_type == "cursor":
                session_manager.publish(EditorEventType.CURSOR_MOVED, data.get("path", ""),
                                session.session_id, line=data.get("line", 0),
                                column=data.get("column", 0))
            elif msg_type == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json({"type": "pong"})
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        pump.cancel()
        session_manager.drop_session(session.session_id)
        session_manager.unsubscribe(session.session_id)

```

```python
"""Editor domain logic: sandboxed workspace file operations and the session event bus."""

import asyncio
import json
import os
import time
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from editor.schemas_editor import EditorEvent as Event, EditorEventType, EditorSessionInfo


class EditorFileOperations:
    """Workspace-relative file CRUD confined to the project root, the agent library,
    existing sub-agent YAML files and any absolute folders listed in
    ``tools/allowed_paths.json``."""

    REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    PROJECT_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "workspace"
    LIBRARY_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "library"
    SUBAGENT_LIBRARY_ROOT = REPO_ROOT / "subAgentLibrary"
    ALLOWED_PATHS_CONFIG = REPO_ROOT / "tools" / "allowed_paths.json"

    def _configured_write_roots(self) -> list[Path]:
        """Folders from allowed_paths.json that absolute paths may point into (re-read on every call)."""
        try:
            data = json.loads(self.ALLOWED_PATHS_CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return []
        roots = []
        for entry in data.get("file_manager_roots", []):
            raw = entry.get("path") if isinstance(entry, dict) else entry
            if raw:
                roots.append(Path(os.path.expandvars(str(raw))).expanduser().resolve())
        return roots

    def resolve_project_path(self, relative_path: str, root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
        if not relative_path:
            raise ValueError("A project-relative path is required.")

        clean_rel = relative_path.replace("\\", "/")
        if clean_rel == "library" or clean_rel.startswith("library/"):
            base_root = self.REPO_ROOT.resolve()
            allowed_root = self.LIBRARY_ROOT.resolve()
            candidate = (base_root / clean_rel).resolve()
            try:
                candidate.relative_to(allowed_root)
            except ValueError:
                raise ValueError(f"Access outside agent library '{allowed_root}' is forbidden.") from None
            return candidate

        if clean_rel == "subAgentLibrary" or clean_rel.startswith("subAgentLibrary/"):
            allowed_root = self.SUBAGENT_LIBRARY_ROOT.resolve()
            candidate = (self.REPO_ROOT / clean_rel).resolve()
            if candidate.parent != allowed_root or candidate.suffix.lower() != ".yaml":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Only YAML files directly inside sub-agent library '{allowed_root}' can be edited."
                )
            return candidate

        if root is None and Path(relative_path).is_absolute():
            absolute = Path(os.path.expandvars(relative_path)).expanduser().resolve()
            allowed_roots = self._configured_write_roots()
            for allowed in allowed_roots:
                try:
                    absolute.relative_to(allowed)
                    return absolute
                except ValueError:
                    continue
            allowed_list = ", ".join(str(r) for r in allowed_roots) or "none configured"
            raise ValueError(f"Absolute path '{absolute}' is outside the allowed folders: {allowed_list}")

        base_root = (root or self.PROJECT_ROOT).resolve()
        candidate = (base_root / clean_rel).resolve()

        try:
            candidate.relative_to(base_root)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError(f"Access outside root path '{base_root}' is forbidden.")

        return candidate

    def read_file_content(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        abs_path = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path)
        if not abs_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {relative_path}")
        content = abs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return {"path": relative_path, "content": content}

    @staticmethod
    def _is_subagent_path(relative_path: str) -> bool:
        return relative_path.replace("\\", "/").startswith("subAgentLibrary/")

    def write_file_content(self, relative_path: str, content: str) -> dict:
        abs_path = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path)
        if self._is_subagent_path(relative_path) and not abs_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Sub-agent definition does not exist and cannot be created here: {relative_path}"
            )
        abs_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        abs_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return {"path": relative_path, "bytes_written": len(content.encode('utf-8'))}

    def delete_path(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        if self._is_subagent_path(relative_path):
            raise ValueError("Sub-agent definition files cannot be deleted from the editor.")
        abs_path = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path)
        if abs_path.is_dir():
            if any(abs_path.iterdir()):
                raise IsADirectoryError(f"Directory not empty: {relative_path}")
            abs_path.rmdir()
        elif abs_path.is_file():
            abs_path.unlink()
        else:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {relative_path}")
        return {"path": relative_path, "deleted": True}

    def create_path(self, relative_path: str, kind: str = "file") -> dict:
        if self._is_subagent_path(relative_path):
            raise ValueError("New sub-agent definition files cannot be created from the editor.")
        abs_path = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path)
        if abs_path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {relative_path}")
        if kind == "directory":
            abs_path.mkdir(parents=True)
        else:
            abs_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            abs_path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        return {"path": relative_path, "created": kind}

    def get_directory_tree(self, relative_path: str = "") -> dict:
        library_requested = relative_path == "library" or relative_path.startswith("library/")
        if library_requested:
            target_dir = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path)
            tree_root = self.LIBRARY_ROOT
            path_prefix = "library"
        else:
            target_dir = self.resolve_project_path(relative_path) if relative_path else self.PROJECT_ROOT
            tree_root = self.PROJECT_ROOT
            path_prefix = ""

        def _build_tree(p: Path):
            rel = str(p.relative_to(tree_root)).replace("\\", "/")
            if path_prefix:
                rel = path_prefix if rel == "." else f"{path_prefix}/{rel}"
            if p.is_file():
                return {"name": p.name, "type": "file", "path": rel}
            children = []
            for child in sorted(p.iterdir(), key=lambda x: (not x.is_dir(), x.name.lower())):
                is_python_cache = child.is_dir() and child.name.lower() in {"__pycache__", "_pycache__"}
                if child.name.startswith(".") or is_python_cache or (
                    child.is_file() and child.suffix.lower() == ".py"
                ):
                    continue
                children.append(_build_tree(child))
            return {"name": p.name, "type": "directory", "path": rel, "children": children}

        if not target_dir.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Directory not found: {relative_path}")
        result = _build_tree(target_dir)
        if not relative_path and self.LIBRARY_ROOT.is_dir():
            result["children"].append({
                "name": "library",
                "type": "directory",
                "path": "library",
                "children": [
                    {
                        "name": file.name,
                        "type": "file",
                        "path": f"library/{file.name}",
                    }
                    for file in sorted(self.LIBRARY_ROOT.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name.lower())
                    if file.is_file()
                ],
            })
        return result


class EditorSessionManager:
    """Tracks connected editor sessions and fans events out to subscribers."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._sessions: dict[str, EditorSessionInfo] = {}
        self._subscribers: dict[str, asyncio.Queue] = {}
        self._event_log: list[dict] = []
        self._max_log = 200

    # --- session lifecycle -------------------------------------------------
    def create_session(self, client: str = "unknown") -> EditorSessionInfo:
        session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        info = EditorSessionInfo(session_id=session_id, client=client, joined_at=time.time())
        self._sessions[session_id] = info
        self._subscribers[session_id] = asyncio.Queue()
        self.broadcast(Event(type=EditorEventType.SESSION_JOIN, path="", session_id=session_id,
                             data={"client": client}))
        return info

    def drop_session(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        if session_id in self._sessions:
            self.broadcast(Event(type=EditorEventType.SESSION_LEAVE, path="",
                                 session_id=session_id))
        self._sessions.pop(session_id, None)
        self._subscribers.pop(session_id, None)

    def set_active_path(self, session_id: str, path: str) -> None:
        if session_id in self._sessions:
            self._sessions[session_id].active_path = path

    def sessions(self) -> list[EditorSessionInfo]:
        return list(self._sessions.values())

    # --- event bus ---------------------------------------------------------
    def subscribe(self, session_id: str) -> asyncio.Queue:
        queue = self._subscribers.get(session_id)
        if queue is None:
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            self._subscribers[session_id] = queue
        return queue

    def unsubscribe(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        self._subscribers.pop(session_id, None)

    def broadcast(self, event: Event) -> dict:
        payload = event.to_dict()
        self._event_log.append(payload)
        if len(self._event_log) > self._max_log:
            self._event_log = self._event_log[-self._max_log:]
        for queue in self._subscribers.values():
            queue.put_nowait(payload)
        return payload

    def publish(self, event_type: EditorEventType, path: str, session_id: str, **data) -> dict:
        return self.broadcast(Event(type=event_type, path=path, session_id=session_id, data=data or None))

    def recent_events(self, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
        return self._event_log[-limit:]


# Shared doorway instances used across the application.
editor_files = EditorFileOperations()
session_manager = EditorSessionManager()
```

```python
"""Editor data contracts: scopes, event payloads, session records and request bodies."""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class EditorScope(str, Enum):
    WORKSPACE = "workspace"
    PROJECT = "project"
    AGENTS = "agents"
    TESTING = "testing"


class EditorEventType(str, Enum):
    FILE_OPENED = "file_opened"
    FILE_SAVED = "file_saved"
    FILE_CREATED = "file_created"
    FILE_DELETED = "file_deleted"
    TOOL_EXECUTED = "tool_executed"
    CURSOR_MOVED = "cursor_moved"
    SESSION_JOIN = "session_join"
    SESSION_LEAVE = "session_leave"


@dataclass
class EditorEvent:
    """Payload broadcast to every subscriber of the editor event bus."""
    type: EditorEventType
    path: str
    session_id: str
    scope: EditorScope = EditorScope.WORKSPACE
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["type"] = self.type.value
        payload["scope"] = self.scope.value
        return payload


@dataclass
class EditorSessionInfo:
    session_id: str
    client: str = "unknown"
    active_path: str = ""
    joined_at: float = 0.0


class FileRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = ""


class PathRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    kind: str = "file"
```

```python
"""File-manager doorway: REST (/api/file-manager/*) and elFinder (/api/elfinder/connector) routes."""

import base64
import mimetypes
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request

router = APIRouter()

_VOLUME = "l1_"
_ELFINDER_API = "2.1"

def _http_error(exc: Exception) -> HTTPException:
    if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError):
        return HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
    if isinstance(exc, FileExistsError):
        return HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))
    if isinstance(exc, IsADirectoryError):
        return HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if isinstance(exc, NotADirectoryError):
        return HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if isinstance(exc, (ValueError, PermissionError)):
        return HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    raise exc


@router.get("/api/file-manager/list")

            NotADirectoryError, ValueError, PermissionError) as exc:
        raise _http_error(exc) from exc


def _encode_hash(path: str) -> str:
    normalized = path.strip("/") or "/"
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(normalized.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    return _VOLUME + token.rstrip("=")


def _decode_hash(file_hash: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(file_hash, str) or not file_hash.startswith(_VOLUME):
        raise ValueError("Invalid elFinder target.")
    token = file_hash[len(_VOLUME):]
    if not token or any(char not in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_" for char in token):
        raise ValueError("Invalid elFinder target.")
    padded = token + "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
    try:
        decoded = base64.b64decode(padded, altchars=b"-_", validate=True).decode("utf-8")
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Invalid elFinder target.") from exc
    if _encode_hash(decoded) != file_hash:
        raise ValueError("Invalid elFinder target.")
    return "" if decoded == "/" else decoded


def _entry(path: str, entry: dict, parent: str) -> dict:
    item_hash = _encode_hash(path)
    is_directory = entry["type"] == "directory"
    return {
        "name": entry["name"],
        "hash": item_hash,
        "phash": _encode_hash(parent),
        "volumeid": _VOLUME,
        "mime": "directory" if is_directory else (
            mimetypes.guess_type(entry["name"])[0] or "application/octet-stream"
        ),
        "ts": int(entry["modified"]),
        "size": entry["size"],
        "read": 1,
        "write": 1,
        "locked": 0,
        "dirs": 1 if is_directory else 0,
        "path": path,
    }


def _directory_contents(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    listing = file_backend.list_directory(path)
    return [
        _entry(item["path"], item, path)
        for item in listing["entries"]
    ]


def _directory_tree(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    entries = _directory_contents(path)
    directories = []
    for entry in entries:
        if entry["mime"] == "directory":
            directories.append({
                "name": entry["name"],
                "hash": entry["hash"],
                "phash": entry["phash"],
                "path": entry["path"],
            })
            directories.extend(_directory_tree(entry["path"]))
    return directories


def _file_info(path: str) -> dict:
    resolved = file_backend.resolve_workspace_path(path)
    parent = PurePosixPath(path).parent.as_posix()
    if parent == ".":
        parent = ""
    if resolved.is_dir():
        entries = file_backend.list_directory(path)["entries"]
        entry = {
            "name": resolved.name if path else "workspace",
            "path": path,
            "type": "directory",
            "size": 0,
            "modified": resolved.stat().st_mtime,
        }
        info = _entry(path, entry, parent)
        info["dirs"] = sum(item["type"] == "directory" for item in entries)
        return info
    stat = resolved.stat()
    return _entry(path, {
        "name": resolved.name,
        "path": resolved.relative_to(file_backend.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
        "type": "file",
        "size": stat.st_size,
        "modified": stat.st_mtime,
    }, parent)


def _child_path(parent: str, name: str) -> str:
    if not name or name in {".", ".."} or "/" in name or "\\" in name or "\x00" in name:
        raise ValueError("A valid file or directory name is required.")
    return f"{parent}/{name}" if parent else name


def _values(data, key: str) -> list[str]:
    if hasattr(data, "getlist"):
        values = data.getlist(f"{key}[]") or data.getlist(key)
    else:
        values = data.get(f"{key}[]", data.get(key, []))
    if isinstance(values, str):
        return [values]
    return list(values or [])


async def _connector_data(request: Request):
    if "application/json" in request.headers.get("content-type", ""):
        return await request.json()
    return await request.form()


@router.post("/api/elfinder/connector")
async def elfinder_connector(request: Request):
    data = await _connector_data(request)
    command = data.get("cmd", "")
    try:
        if command == "open":
            path = _decode_hash(data.get("target", _encode_hash("/")))
            cwd = _file_info(path)
            if cwd["mime"] != "directory":
                raise ValueError("The requested target is not a directory.")
            return {
                "cwd": cwd,
                "files": [cwd, *_directory_contents(path)],
                "api": _ELFINDER_API,
                "options": {
                    "path": path,
                    "url": "/api/elfinder/connector",
                    "disabled": [],
                    "separator": "/",
                    "archivers": {"create": [], "extract": []},
                },
            }

        if command == "tree":
            path = _decode_hash(data.get("target", _encode_hash("/")))
            return {"tree": _directory_tree(path)}

        if command == "ls":
            path = _decode_hash(data.get("target", ""))
            return {
                "list": {
                    item["hash"]: item["name"]
                    for item in _directory_contents(path)
                }
            }

        if command in {"mkfile", "mkdir"}:
            parent = _decode_hash(data.get("target", ""))
            name = data.get("name", "")
            path = _child_path(parent, name)
            result = file_backend.create_path(
                path, "directory" if command == "mkdir" else "file"
            )
            return {"added": [_file_info(result["path"])]}

        if command == "rename":
            source = _decode_hash(data.get("target", ""))
            resolved_source = file_backend.resolve_workspace_path(source)
            if not source or not resolved_source.exists():
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {source}")
            parent = PurePosixPath(source).parent.as_posix()
            destination = _child_path("" if parent == "." else parent, data.get("name", ""))
            result = file_backend.move_path(source, destination)
            return {"added": [_file_info(result["destination_path"])],
                    "removed": [_encode_hash(source)]}

        if command == "paste":
            destination = _decode_hash(data.get("dst", ""))
            cut = str(data.get("cut", "0")) in {"1", "true", "True"}
            added = []
            removed = []
            for source_hash in _values(data, "src"):
                source = _decode_hash(source_hash)
                source_path = file_backend.resolve_workspace_path(source)
                target_path = _child_path(destination, source_path.name)
                result = (
                    file_backend.move_path(source, target_path)
                    if cut else file_backend.copy_path(source, target_path)
                )
                added.append(_file_info(result["destination_path"]))
                if cut:
                    removed.append(source_hash)
            return {"added": added, "removed": removed}

        if command == "rm":
            targets = _values(data, "targets")
            removed = []
            for target in targets:
                path = _decode_hash(target)
                file_backend.delete_path(path)
                removed.append(target)
            return {"removed": removed}

        if command == "put":
            path = _decode_hash(data.get("target", ""))
            result = file_backend.write_file(path, data.get("content", ""))
            return {"changed": [_file_info(result["path"])]}

        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported elFinder command: {command or '(missing)'}")
    except (FileNotFoundError, FileExistsError, IsADirectoryError,
            NotADirectoryError, ValueError, PermissionError) as exc:
        return {"error": [str(exc)]}
```

## `file_manager/logic_file_manager.py`
```python
"""File-manager domain logic: secure physical file operations constrained to the
configured file-manager roots, shared by REST, elFinder and the agent tools."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from editor.logic_editor import editor_files
from file_manager.schemas_file_manager import DirectoryListing, FileEntry


class FileBackendService:
    """Single service layer for every file-manager consumer."""

    CONFIG_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "tools" / "allowed_paths.json"
    SKIP_DIRECTORIES = {"__pycache__", "_pycache__"}

    def _read_config(self) -> dict:
        if not self.CONFIG_PATH.is_file():
            return {}
        try:
            config = json.loads(self.CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Could not read file-manager configuration '{self.CONFIG_PATH}': {exc}"
            ) from exc
        if not isinstance(config, dict):
            raise RuntimeError(f"File-manager configuration must be a JSON object: {self.CONFIG_PATH}")
        return config

    def configured_roots(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Configured roots whose folders exist; missing ones are skipped, not fatal."""
        roots, _missing = self._split_roots(self._read_config())
        if not roots:
            raise RuntimeError("None of the folders in 'file_manager_roots' exist on disk.")
        return roots

    def missing_roots(self) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        """Configured roots whose folders are gone (e.g. an unplugged drive)."""
        return self._split_roots(self._read_config())[1]

    def _split_roots(self, config: dict) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], list[dict[str, str]]]:
        roots = config.get("file_manager_roots")
        if roots is None:
            legacy_path = config.get("file_manager_root", str(editor_files.PROJECT_ROOT.resolve()))
            roots = [{"name": "Workspace", "path": legacy_path}]
        if not isinstance(roots, list):
            raise RuntimeError("'file_manager_roots' must be a JSON array.")

        result = []
        missing = []
        names = set()
        paths = set()
        for entry in roots:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                raise RuntimeError("Each file-manager root must have a name and path.")
            name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
            raw_path = os.path.expandvars(str(entry.get("path", ""))).strip()
            if not name or not raw_path:
                raise RuntimeError("Each file-manager root must have a non-empty name and path.")
            root = Path(raw_path).expanduser()
            if not root.is_absolute():
                raise RuntimeError(f"File-manager root must be an absolute path: {raw_path}")
            resolved = root.resolve()
            name_key = name.casefold()
            path_key = os.path.normcase(str(resolved))
            if name_key in names or path_key in paths:
                raise RuntimeError("File-manager root names and paths must be unique.")
            names.add(name_key)
            paths.add(path_key)
            (result if resolved.is_dir() else missing).append({"name": name, "path": str(resolved)})
        if not result and not missing:
            raise RuntimeError("Configure at least one entry in 'file_manager_roots'.")
        return result, missing

    def active_root_path(self) -> Path:
        config = self._read_config()
        roots = self.configured_roots()
        selected = config.get(
            "active_file_manager_root",
            config.get("file_manager_root", roots[0]["path"]),
        )
        for root in roots:
            if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(str(selected)):
                return Path(root["path"])
        if any(os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(str(selected))
               for root in self.missing_roots()):
            return Path(roots[0]["path"])
        raise RuntimeError(
            "The active file-manager root is not present in 'file_manager_roots'."
        )

    def workspace_root(self) -> Path:
        return self.active_root_path()

    def _write_config(self, config: dict) -> None:
        self.CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        temp_path = None
        try:
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                mode="w",
                encoding="utf-8",
                newline="\n",
                dir=self.CONFIG_PATH.parent,
                prefix=f".{self.CONFIG_PATH.name}.",
                suffix=".tmp",
                delete=False,
            ) as temp_file:
                temp_path = Path(temp_file.name)
                json.dump(config, temp_file, indent=2)
                temp_file.write("\n")
            temp_path.replace(self.CONFIG_PATH)
        finally:
            if temp_path is not None and temp_path.exists():
                temp_path.unlink()

    def select_root(self, path: str) -> dict:
        roots = self.configured_roots()
        selected = next(
            (root for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(path)),
            None,
        )
        if selected is None:
            raise ValueError("Choose a configured file-manager root.")

        config = self._read_config()
        config["file_manager_roots"] = roots + self._split_roots(config)[1]
        config["active_file_manager_root"] = selected["path"]
        config["file_manager_root"] = selected["path"]
        self._write_config(config)
        return {"roots": roots, "active_path": selected["path"]}

    def manage_roots(self, action: str, paths: list[str]) -> dict:
        """Add or remove configured file-manager directories."""
        if action not in {"add", "remove"}:
            raise ValueError("Action must be 'add' or 'remove'.")
        if not paths:
            raise ValueError("Provide at least one directory path.")

        config = self._read_config()
        available, missing = self._split_roots(config)
        roots = available + missing
        current_active = str(
            config.get("active_file_manager_root", config.get("file_manager_root", roots[0]["path"]))
        )
        normalized_paths = []
        for raw_path in paths:
            value = os.path.expandvars(str(raw_path)).strip()
            if not value:
                raise ValueError("Directory paths cannot be empty.")
            candidate = Path(value).expanduser()
            if not candidate.is_absolute():
                raise ValueError(f"Directory path must be absolute: {value}")
            resolved = candidate.resolve()
            if action == "add" and not resolved.is_dir():
                raise ValueError(f"Directory does not exist: {resolved}")
            normalized_paths.append(str(resolved))

        path_keys = {os.path.normcase(path) for path in normalized_paths}
        added = []
        removed = []
        unchanged = []
        if action == "add":
            existing_paths = {os.path.normcase(root["path"]) for root in roots}
            existing_names = {root["name"].casefold() for root in roots}
            for path in normalized_paths:
                path_key = os.path.normcase(path)
                if path_key in existing_paths:
                    unchanged.append(path)
                    continue
                folder_name = Path(path).name or path
                name = folder_name
                suffix = 2
                while name.casefold() in existing_names:
                    name = f"{folder_name} ({suffix})"
                    suffix += 1
                roots.append({"name": name, "path": path})
                existing_paths.add(path_key)
                existing_names.add(name.casefold())
                added.append(path)
        else:
            configured_paths = {os.path.normcase(root["path"]) for root in roots}
            removed = [root["path"] for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) in path_keys]
            unchanged = [
                path for path in normalized_paths
                if os.path.normcase(path) not in configured_paths
            ]
            roots = [root for root in roots if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) not in path_keys]
            if not removed:
                raise ValueError("None of the provided paths are configured file-manager roots.")
            if not any(Path(root["path"]).is_dir() for root in roots):
                raise ValueError("At least one existing file-manager root must remain configured.")

        existing = [root for root in roots if Path(root["path"]).is_dir()]
        active_path = next(
            (root["path"] for root in existing if os.path.normcase(root["path"]) == os.path.normcase(current_active)),
            existing[0]["path"] if existing else roots[0]["path"],
        )
        config["file_manager_roots"] = roots
        config["active_file_manager_root"] = active_path
        config["file_manager_root"] = active_path
        self._write_config(config)
        return {
            "roots": existing,
            "missing": [root for root in roots if root not in existing],
            "active_path": active_path,
            "added": added,
            "removed": removed,
            "unchanged": unchanged,
        }

    def resolve_workspace_path(self, relative_path: str = "") -> Path:
        if not isinstance(relative_path, str):
            raise ValueError("A workspace-relative path is required.")

        clean_path = relative_path.replace("\\", "/")
        if clean_path.startswith("/") or (len(clean_path) > 1 and clean_path[1] == ":"):
            raise ValueError("Absolute paths are not allowed.")
        base_root = self.workspace_root()
        parts = Path(clean_path).parts
        if any(part in {".", ".."} for part in parts):
            raise ValueError("Relative path traversal is not allowed.")
        candidate = base_root
        for part in parts:
            candidate = candidate / part
            if candidate.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("Symbolic links are not supported by the file manager.")
        path = candidate.resolve()
        try:
            path.relative_to(base_root)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError("Access outside the workspace is forbidden.") from None
        return path

    def list_entries(self, relative_path: str = "") -> list[dict]:
        directory = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not directory.is_dir():
            if directory.exists():
                raise NotADirectoryError(f"Not a directory: {relative_path}")
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Directory not found: {relative_path}")

        entries = []
        for child in sorted(
            directory.iterdir(),
            key=lambda item: (
                not (not item.is_symlink() and item.is_dir()),
                item.name.lower(),
            ),
        ):
            if (
                child.is_symlink()
                or child.name.startswith(".")
                or (child.is_dir() and child.name.lower() in self.SKIP_DIRECTORIES)
                or (child.is_file() and child.suffix.lower() == ".pyc")
            ):
                continue
            try:
                resolved = child.resolve()
                resolved.relative_to(self.workspace_root())
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not resolved.exists():
                continue
            stat = resolved.stat()
            entries.append({
                "name": resolved.name,
                "path": resolved.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
                "type": "directory" if resolved.is_dir() else "file",
                "size": 0 if resolved.is_dir() else stat.st_size,
                "modified": stat.st_mtime,
            })
        return entries

    def directory_tree(self, relative_path: str = "") -> dict:
        directory = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not directory.is_dir():
            if directory.exists():
                raise NotADirectoryError(f"Not a directory: {relative_path}")
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Directory not found: {relative_path}")
        root = self.workspace_root()
        rel_path = directory.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        node = {
            "name": directory.name or root.name,
            "path": "" if rel_path == "." else rel_path,
            "type": "directory",
            "children": [],
        }
        for item in self.list_entries(node["path"]):
            if item["type"] == "directory":
                node["children"].append(self.directory_tree(item["path"]))
            else:
                node["children"].append({
                    "name": item["name"],
                    "path": item["path"],
                    "type": "file",
                })
        return node

    def read_file(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if not path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {relative_path}")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "content": path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        }

    def write_file(self, relative_path: str, content: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path.exists() and not path.is_file():
            raise IsADirectoryError(f"Path is not a file: {relative_path}")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "bytes_written": len(content.encode("utf-8")),
        }

    def create_path(self, relative_path: str, kind: str = "file") -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {relative_path}")
        if kind == "directory":
            path.mkdir(parents=True)
        elif kind == "file":
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.touch()
        else:
            raise ValueError("Kind must be 'file' or 'directory'.")
        return {
            "path": path.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "created": kind,
        }

    def delete_path(self, relative_path: str) -> dict:
        path = self.resolve_workspace_path(relative_path)
        if path == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be deleted.")
        if path.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(path)
        elif path.is_file():
            path.unlink()
        else:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {relative_path}")
        return {"path": relative_path.replace("\\", "/"), "deleted": True}

    def move_path(self, source_path: str, destination_path: str) -> dict:
        source = self.resolve_workspace_path(source_path)
        destination = self.resolve_workspace_path(destination_path)
        if source == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be moved.")
        if not source.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {source_path}")
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {destination_path}")
        if source.is_dir():
            try:
                destination.relative_to(source)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError("A directory cannot be moved into itself.")
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
        return {
            "source_path": source_path.replace("\\", "/"),
            "destination_path": destination.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "moved": True,
        }

    def copy_path(self, source_path: str, destination_path: str) -> dict:
        source = self.resolve_workspace_path(source_path)
        destination = self.resolve_workspace_path(destination_path)
        if source == self.workspace_root():
            raise ValueError("The workspace root cannot be copied.")
        if not source.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path not found: {source_path}")
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Path already exists: {destination_path}")
        if source.is_dir():
            try:
                destination.relative_to(source)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError("A directory cannot be copied into itself.")
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copytree(source, destination, symlinks=True)
        else:
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(source, destination)
        return {
            "source_path": source_path.replace("\\", "/"),
            "destination_path": destination.relative_to(self.workspace_root()).as_posix(),
            "copied": True,
        }

    def list_directory(self, path: str = "") -> dict:
        """Directory entries wrapped in the public ``DirectoryListing`` contract."""
        entries = self.list_entries(path)
        return DirectoryListing(
            path=path.replace("\\", "/"),
            entries=[FileEntry(**entry) for entry in entries],
        ).model_dump()


file_backend = FileBackendService()

```

## `file_manager/schemas_file_manager.py`
```python
"""File-manager data contracts: request bodies and directory listing models."""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class PathRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class FileContentRequest(PathRequest):
    content: str


class CreateRequest(PathRequest):
    kind: str = Field(default="file", pattern="^(file|directory)$")


class MoveRequest(BaseModel):
    source_path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    destination_path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class SelectRootRequest(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class ManageRootsRequest(BaseModel):
    action: Literal["add", "remove"]
    paths: list[str] = Field(..., min_length=1)


class FileEntry(BaseModel):
    name: str
    path: str
    type: str
    size: int
    modified: float


class DirectoryListing(BaseModel):
    path: str
    entries: list[FileEntry]

```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Terminal — Novous Sandbox</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/style.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/css/codebuilder.css?v=3">
</head>
<body class="bg-dark text-light tw-terminal-page">
  <div id="terminal-root"></div>
  <script type="module">
    import { mountTerminal, TERMINAL_CHANNEL } from '/static/js/terminal.js?v=2';
    const terminal = mountTerminal(document.getElementById('terminal-root'));
    terminal.focus();

    const channel = 'BroadcastChannel' in window ? new BroadcastChannel(TERMINAL_CHANNEL) : null;
    if (channel) {
      channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-open' });
      channel.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (event.data?.type === 'close-popout') window.close();
        if (event.data?.type === 'ping') channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-open' });
      };
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => channel.postMessage({ type: 'popout-closed' }));
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
