```css
.codebuilder-shell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 560px;
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

/* ---------- Toolbar ---------- */
.codebuilder-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}

.codebuilder-toolbar-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.question-dialog.is-resizable {
  resize: both;
  overflow: auto;
  width: min(560px, 92vw);
  min-width: 320px;
  min-height: 240px;
  max-width: 96vw;
  max-height: 92vh;
}

.question-dialog.is-resizable .codebuilder-open-tree {
  max-height: none;
  min-width: 0;
}

.codebuilder-file-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.codebuilder-file-label > span:nth-child(2) {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.codebuilder-python-icon {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3776ab, #4b8bbe);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#run-code:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.75; }

/* ---------- Layout grid ----------
   Columns: chat | divider | editor | divider | console
   Panel widths are CSS variables; a hidden panel is 0px wide and its divider widens
   into a tab that brings it back. */
.codebuilder-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns:
    var(--chat-w, 340px) var(--chat-gutter, 8px) minmax(0, 1fr) var(--console-gutter, 8px) var(--console-w, 320px);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 250px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="chat"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-editor-panel { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="console"] { grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1; }
.codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 5; grid-row: 1; }

/* ---------- Panes ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-editor-panel,
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}

.codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ---------- Dividers (look shared via .panel-resizer in style.css) ---------- */
/* While a drag is past the hide point, preview that the panel will disappear. */
.codebuilder-shell.chat-hiding .codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-shell.console-hiding .codebuilder-console-panel { opacity: 0.35; }

/* Hidden panel: nothing on screen but a slim tab on the divider. */
.codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed { --chat-w: 0px; --chat-gutter: 18px; }
.codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed { --console-w: 0px; --console-gutter: 18px; }
.codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed .codebuilder-chat-panel,
.codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed .codebuilder-console-panel { visibility: hidden; border: 0; }
body.is-resizing .editor-surface { pointer-events: none; }

/* ---------- Code scratchpad dialog ---------- */
.codebuilder-scratchpad-dialog {
  width: min(760px, 92vw);
  max-height: 85vh;
  padding: 1rem;
  color: var(--text-main);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-heading p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-content {
  max-height: 68vh;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-toolbar .cb-select { min-width: 9rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-run + .codebuilder-scratchpad-run { margin-top: 1rem; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { border-left-color: var(--text-muted); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-kind {
  padding: 0 0.4rem;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-title { margin: 0.3rem 0; font-weight: 600; }

/* ---------- Editor panel ---------- */
.codebuilder-editor-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.codebuilder-open-tree {
  min-width: min(480px, 80vw);
  max-height: 55vh;
  overflow: auto;
}

.codebuilder-memory-dialog {
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #444);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev, #1f2430);
  color: inherit;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
  width: min(420px, 92vw);
}

.codebuilder-memory-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog h3 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog label { display: block; margin-top: 0.7rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-dialog .form-select,
.codebuilder-memory-dialog .form-input { width: 100%; margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.codebuilder-memory-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; }

.editor-surface {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-textarea {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  resize: none;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  border: 0;
  outline: none;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  tab-size: 4;
}

.codebuilder-statusbar {
  min-height: 25px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.codebuilder-statusbar span:first-child {
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* ---------- Console panel ---------- */
.codebuilder-console-panel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* ---------- Panel headings ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-heading,
.codebuilder-console-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.codebuilder-agent-select { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.codebuilder-chat-status {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.codebuilder-console-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.2rem; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button {
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 0.75rem;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.codebuilder-console-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text-main); background: var(--bg-elev); }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button.active { color: var(--text-main); background: var(--bg-elev); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary); }
.codebuilder-console-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

.cb-section-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 32px; }
.cb-section-head h3 { margin: 0 auto 0 0; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.cb-section-head .cb-btn-accent { height: 28px; font-size: 0.78rem; }

/* ---------- Chat composer ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.codebuilder-chat-form textarea {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 64px;
  max-height: 180px;
  resize: vertical;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}
.codebuilder-chat-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; }
.codebuilder-model { flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--text-muted); }

.codebuilder-workflow-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-color);
}
.cb-squad-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-right: 0.15rem; }
.codebuilder-workflow-actions .cb-btn { height: 30px; }

.codebuilder-output-section,
.codebuilder-problems-section {
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem;
}

.codebuilder-output-section {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.console-output {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 70px;
  max-height: 40vh;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0.55rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.codebuilder-problems-section {
  flex: 0 1 35%;
  overflow: auto;
}

.diagnostics-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.55rem;
}

.diagnostics-list p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.diagnostic-item {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem;
  border: 0;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--danger);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  color: var(--text-main);
  text-align: left;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

button.diagnostic-item {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.diagnostic-item[data-severity="warning"] {
  border-left-color: var(--warning);
}

.diagnostic-item[data-severity="info"] {
  border-left-color: var(--primary);
}

/* ---------- Chat panel (left column) ---------- */
.codebuilder-chat-messages {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message {
  align-self: flex-start;
  max-width: 85%;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant {
  max-width: min(95%, 900px);
  min-width: 0;
  white-space: normal;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant .prompt-rich-markdown { font-size: inherit; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h1 { font-size: 1.3em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h2 { font-size: 1.15em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h3,
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant h4 { font-size: 1.05em; }
.codebuilder-chat-message.assistant .md-code-block pre { font-size: 0.82rem; }

.codebuilder-chat-text {
  min-width: 0;
}

.codebuilder-code-block {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.45rem 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-language {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-transform: lowercase;
}

.codebuilder-code-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.codebuilder-copy-code,
.codebuilder-send-code,
.codebuilder-expand-code,
.codebuilder-modal-close {
  padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.codebuilder-chat-code {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor,
.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor .margin,
.codebuilder-chat-code .monaco-editor-background {
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-block pre {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow: auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  tab-size: 4;
}

.codebuilder-code-block code {
  white-space: pre;
}

.codebuilder-chat-code > pre {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: none;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.user {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.codebuilder-chat-message.system {
  align-self: center;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.codebuilder-orchestration-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-summary {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-width: 0;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-summary span:first-child {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-bar p {
  grid-column: 1;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.codebuilder-orchestration-bar button {
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 1 / span 2;
  align-self: center;
}
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="running"] { color: var(--primary); }
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="error"] { color: var(--danger); }
#codebuilder-editor-activity[data-state="success"] { color: var(--success); }

/* ---------- Expanded code modal ---------- */
.codebuilder-code-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: rgba(8, 10, 16, 0.72);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: min(1100px, 94vw);
  max-height: 88vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-heading .codebuilder-code-actions {
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-body {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor,
.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor .margin,
.codebuilder-code-modal-body .monaco-editor-background {
  background: var(--bg-dark);
}

body.codebuilder-modal-open {
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ---------- Responsive: medium ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .codebuilder-layout {
    grid-template-columns: var(--chat-w, 300px) var(--chat-gutter, 8px) minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: minmax(280px, 1.4fr) minmax(180px, 0.7fr);
  }
  .codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="chat"] { grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
  .codebuilder-resizer[data-resize="console"] { display: none; }
  .codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
  .codebuilder-shell.console-collapsed .codebuilder-console-panel { visibility: visible; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
}

/* ---------- Responsive: small ---------- */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .codebuilder-shell { height: auto; min-height: 900px; }
  .codebuilder-toolbar { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .codebuilder-toolbar-actions { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .codebuilder-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: 460px minmax(350px, 55vh) minmax(260px, 35vh);
    min-height: 900px;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .codebuilder-resizer { display: none; }
  .codebuilder-chat-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .codebuilder-editor-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .codebuilder-console-panel { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; margin-top: 0; }
  .codebuilder-shell.chat-collapsed .codebuilder-chat-panel { visibility: visible; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); }
  .codebuilder-statusbar { gap: 0.55rem; font-size: 0.65rem; }
}
/* ---------- Terminal (docked tab + pop-out page) ---------- */
.codebuilder-console-panel.show-terminal .codebuilder-output-section,
.codebuilder-console-panel.show-terminal .codebuilder-problems-section {
  display: none;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-section {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-section[hidden],
.codebuilder-terminal-popped[hidden],
.codebuilder-terminal-mount[hidden] {
  display: none;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-mount {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
}

.codebuilder-terminal-popped {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 1.5rem 0.5rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.tw-terminal {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: #1e1e1e;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.5rem;
}

.tw-terminal-page,
.tw-terminal-page #terminal-root {
  height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
}

.tw-terminal-page .tw-terminal {
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border-radius: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.tw-terminal-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.tw-terminal-spacer { flex: 1; }

.tw-terminal-cwd {
  color: #9cdcfe;
  font: 0.72rem Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.tw-terminal-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #1f6f43;
  color: #fff;
}

.tw-terminal-links a {
  display: block;
  color: #4ec9b0;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.tw-terminal-output {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 6rem;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: auto;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  color: #d4d4d4;
  font: 0.78rem/1.45 Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
}

.tw-terminal-form {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  border-top: 1px solid #333;
  padding-top: 0.4rem;
}

.tw-terminal-prompt { color: #4ec9b0; font-family: Consolas, monospace; }

.tw-terminal-input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font: 0.8rem Consolas, "Courier New", monospace;
}

.codebuilder-filename {
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Code squad progress strip and live agent messages */
.codebuilder-squad-steps {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin: 0.15rem 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.55rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="idle"] { opacity: 0.45; }
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="running"] {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  animation: codebuilder-step-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="success"] { border-color: var(--success); color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="error"],
.codebuilder-squad-steps li[data-state="nothing_found"] { border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-step-attempt { font-size: 0.65rem; opacity: 0.8; }
@keyframes codebuilder-step-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.55; } }

.codebuilder-agent-message { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="code-builder"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="tester"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-agent-message[data-agent="code-troubleshooter"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-agent-header {
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.codebuilder-agent-body.is-streaming {
  max-height: 14rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
  white-space: normal;
}
.codebuilder-agent-body { white-space: normal; }
.codebuilder-workflow-stop { border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--danger); }

```

## `frontend/static/css/squads.css`
```css
/* Novous Squads — app shell (sidebar) and the Squads / Agents / Tools / Runs sections.
   Builds on the tokens in style.css. */

/* --- Shell: sections as tabs in the top bar --------------------------------- */
.navbar { padding: 0 1.25rem; min-height: 50px; gap: 1.25rem; }
.navbar .logo { flex-shrink: 0; }
.app-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 50px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.app-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.app-tab-group { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.1rem; }
.app-tab-divider { width: 1px; margin: 14px 0; background: var(--border-color); flex-shrink: 0; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 0.8rem;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.app-tabs .nav-btn:hover { color: var(--text-main); background: transparent; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 6px; }
.app-tabs .nav-btn.active { color: var(--text-main); border-bottom-color: var(--primary); }
#health-badge { flex-shrink: 0; }

/* --- Page scaffolding -------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; max-width: 1500px; }
.sq-page-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
.sq-page-head h2 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1.35rem; }
.sq-page-head p { margin: 0; }
.sq-page h4 { margin: 1rem 0 0.4rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }

.sq-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; align-items: center; }
.sq-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;
}
.sq-chip-x {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0 0.1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1;
}
.sq-chip-x:hover { color: var(--danger); }

.sq-link {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
}
.sq-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.sq-msg { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; margin: 0.35rem 0; }
.sq-msg-error { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); color: var(--danger); }
.sq-msg-warn { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); color: var(--warning); }
.sq-msg-ok {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12);
  color: var(--text-main);
  border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35);
}
.sq-msg-ok .form-select { width: auto; }

.sq-empty-state { text-align: center; padding: 2rem 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); }

.sq-pre {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
  max-height: 320px;
  overflow: auto;
}

.sq-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; margin-bottom: 0.85rem; }
.sq-field > span:first-child { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-field-inline { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; }
.sq-field-inline .form-input { width: 5rem; }

.sq-segmented { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.sq-segmented label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-segmented label:last-child { border-right: none; }
.sq-segmented input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.sq-segmented label:has(input:checked) { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--text-main); }
.sq-segmented label:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

.sq-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
.sq-search { max-width: 280px; }

/* --- Squads home ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-home { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
.sq-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  color: var(--text-main);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
}
.sq-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-card.is-selected { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--primary); }
.sq-card-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; }
.sq-card-flow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.82rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.sq-architect-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-architect-head p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }
.sq-architect-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-inline-select { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; }
.sq-inline-select .form-select { width: auto; }
.sq-pattern-note { margin: 0.6rem 0; }
.sq-architect-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 300px; gap: 1rem; margin: 0.75rem 0; }

.sq-canvas-host {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(139, 148, 167, 0.18) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0 / 18px 18px,
    var(--bg-dark);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0.5rem;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.sq-canvas { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 520px; height: auto; }
.sq-node { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
.sq-node rect { fill: var(--bg-card); stroke: var(--border-color); stroke-width: 1.5; transition: stroke 0.15s; }
.sq-node-lead rect { stroke: var(--accent); }
.sq-node-subagent rect { stroke-dasharray: 5 3; }
.sq-node:hover rect, .sq-node:focus-visible rect { stroke: var(--primary); }
.sq-node.is-selected rect { stroke: var(--primary); stroke-width: 2.5; fill: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }
.sq-node-title { fill: var(--text-main); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.sq-node-sub { fill: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.sq-edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--text-muted); stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.8; }
.sq-edge-return { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
.sq-edge-optional { stroke-dasharray: 2 4; }
.sq-arrow-head { fill: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-router { fill: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); stroke: var(--warning); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.sq-pattern-label { fill: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; text-anchor: middle; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.sq-step { fill: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.sq-empty { fill: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; text-anchor: middle; }

.sq-inspector {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 0.85rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  min-width: 0;
}
.sq-inspector h4 { margin: 0.9rem 0 0.4rem; }
.sq-inspector .form-select, .sq-agent-card .form-select { width: 100%; max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; }
.sq-inspector code { word-break: break-all; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-inspector-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-inspector-head strong { margin-right: auto; }
.sq-inspector-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 0.9rem; }

/* --- Builder ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.sq-stepper { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 1.1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-stepper button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem 0.4rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.sq-stepper button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }
.sq-step-num {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 1.4rem;
  height: 1.4rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.sq-stepper .is-current button { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--text-main); }
.sq-stepper .is-current .sq-step-num { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
.sq-stepper .is-done .sq-step-num { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); color: var(--success); }

.sq-step-body { min-height: 220px; }
.sq-builder-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 0.85rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); }

.sq-choice-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; }
.sq-choice {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.sq-choice input { position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; }
.sq-choice strong { padding-right: 1.5rem; }
.sq-choice:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-choice.is-selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }
.sq-choice:has(input:disabled) { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
.sq-group-title { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: baseline; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.5rem; }
.sq-group-title:not(:first-child) { margin-top: 1.1rem; }

.sq-two-col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 280px; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-order { position: sticky; top: 0; }
.sq-order-list { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; padding-left: 1.2rem; }
.sq-order-list li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.15rem 0; }
.sq-order-actions { display: inline-flex; }
.sq-order-actions .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.sq-toggle { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-toggle input { margin-top: 0.2rem; }

.sq-create { margin-top: 1rem; border: 1px dashed var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem; }
.sq-create summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary); font-size: 0.88rem; }

.sq-tool-table { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
.sq-tool-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 1fr) 260px;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--bg-elev);
}
.sq-tool-owner { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: flex-start; }
.sq-tool-add { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sq-tool-add .form-select { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; }

.sq-review { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.sq-validation h4 { margin-top: 0; }

/* --- Agents ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-create-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.sq-agent-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(290px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; }
.sq-agent-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem; }
.sq-agent-card p { margin: 0; }

/* --- Tools ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-tool-catalog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 420px; overflow-y: auto; }
.sq-tool-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(240px, 340px);
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-tool-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.sq-tool-item p { margin: 0.25rem 0; }
.sq-tool-item code { color: var(--text-muted); word-break: break-word; }
.sq-tool-users { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }

/* --- Runs ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.sq-runs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  grid-template-areas: "form trace" "form result";
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: start;
}
.sq-run-form { grid-area: form; }
.sq-trace { grid-area: trace; }
.sq-result { grid-area: result; }
.sq-run-form .btn-primary { width: 100%; }
.sq-recent { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; }
.sq-recent li { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; align-items: center; }

.sq-timeline {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  max-height: 340px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.sq-event {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 78px 150px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--border-color);
}
.sq-event:nth-child(odd) { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); }
.sq-event-time { color: var(--text-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.sq-event-type { text-transform: capitalize; color: var(--text-muted); }
.sq-event-text { word-break: break-word; }
.sq-event-run_started, .sq-event-run_complete { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
.sq-event-agent_message { border-left-color: var(--primary); }
.sq-event-tool_call_start, .sq-event-tool_call_end { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.sq-event-scratchpad_handoff { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.sq-event.is-error, .sq-event-error { border-left-color: var(--danger); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08); }

.sq-answer {
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--success);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.sq-output { margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.sq-output summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 0.3rem 0; }
.sq-steps { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.8rem; }
.sq-steps th, .sq-steps td { text-align: left; padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); vertical-align: top; }
.sq-steps th { color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; }
.sq-steps tr.is-error td { color: var(--danger); }

/* --- Narrow screens ------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .sq-architect-body, .sq-review, .sq-two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sq-tool-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .navbar .logo-text { display: none; }
  .sq-home, .sq-runs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "form" "trace" "result"; }
  .sq-tool-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sq-event { grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .sq-event-type { display: none; }
}

/* --- Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.ov-page { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; max-width: 1600px; }
.ov-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 340px; gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.ov-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; min-width: 0; }
.ov-side .dash-tree-card .tree-pane { height: min(46vh, 420px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ov-side .dash-tree-card .tree-body { flex: 1; overflow: auto; }
.ov-side .card-head p { margin: 0.2rem 0 0; }

.ov-agents { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem; min-width: 0; }
.ov-agents-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; }
.ov-agents-head h3 { margin: 0 0 0.2rem; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.ov-agents-head p { margin: 0; }

.ov-create { padding: 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg-elev); }
.ov-create-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem 0.8rem; }
.ov-create-grid label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
.ov-create-grid .form-input, .ov-create-grid .cb-select { width: 100%; }
.ov-create-wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.ov-create-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; }
.ov-create-actions p { margin: 0 auto 0 0; }

.ov-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
.ov-search { position: relative; flex: 1 1 240px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.ov-search .icon { position: absolute; left: 0.65rem; color: var(--text-muted); pointer-events: none; }
.ov-search .form-input { width: 100%; height: 34px; padding-left: 2.1rem; border-radius: 7px; }
.ov-toolbar .sq-segmented label { padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.ov-count {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 1.4em;
  padding: 0 0.35em;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.ov-groups { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
.ov-group { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; }
.ov-group > summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
  background: var(--bg-elev);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  list-style: none;
}
.ov-group > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.ov-group > summary::before { content: "▸"; transition: transform 0.12s; }
.ov-group[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.ov-agent-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

.ov-agent {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}
.ov-agent:first-child { border-top: none; }
.ov-agent:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025); }
.ov-avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35);
}
.ov-avatar-prompt-creation { background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); }
.ov-avatar-codebuilder { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.32); }
.ov-agent-main { min-width: 0; }
.ov-agent-title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; min-width: 0; }
.ov-agent-title strong { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ov-agent-title code { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.72rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.ov-agent-main p { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ov-agent-meta {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 56px 66px 150px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.ov-tools { padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 999px; cursor: help; }
.ov-model { max-width: 150px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }
.ov-agent-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.15rem; }
.ov-agent-actions [data-act="open"] { min-width: 82px; }
.ov-agent-actions .ov-delete:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--danger); }
.ov-empty { padding: 2rem 1rem; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); border: 1px dashed var(--border-color); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.ov-empty p { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; }

.ov-settings { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; align-items: start; }
.ov-settings .root-management { margin-top: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding-top: 1rem; }
.ov-settings h3 { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-size: 1rem; }
.ov-settings .root-management-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.ov-settings .root-path-list { margin: 0.5rem 0; }
.ov-add-source { margin-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-color); padding-top: 0.6rem; }
.ov-add-source > summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--primary); font-size: 0.86rem; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.ov-add-source .form-input { width: 100%; }

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .ov-agent { grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
  .ov-agent-meta { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .ov-layout, .ov-settings { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
```
