  const toolsList = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-list');
  const toolsFilter = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-filter');
  const toolsCount = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-count');
  const toolsError = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-error');
  const toolsMode = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-mode');
  const toolsAgentMode = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-agent-mode');
  const toolsConfirm = container.querySelector('#editor-tools-confirm');
  const saveDialog = container.querySelector('#editor-save-dialog');
  const saveDirectory = container.querySelector('#editor-save-directory');
  const saveFilename = container.querySelector('#editor-save-filename');
  const saveError = container.querySelector('#editor-save-error');
  const saveConfirm = container.querySelector('#editor-save-confirm');
  let saveDialogFiles = new Set();
  let suppressEditorChanges = false;
  let workspaceTree;
  const editorReady = attachCodeBuilderEditor(editorMount, '', 'plaintext').then(instance => {
    state.editor = instance;
    instance.onChange(() => {
      if (suppressEditorChanges) return;
      if (!state.dirty) { state.dirty = true; dirtyBadge.classList.remove('hidden'); }
      updateBytes();
    });
    if (state.path) {
      suppressEditorChanges = true;
      instance.setValue(state.content || '');
      instance.setLanguage(languageForPath(state.path));
      suppressEditorChanges = false;
    }
    instance.focus();
    updateBytes();
    return instance;
  });

  function setStatus(element, text, tone = 'muted') {
    element.textContent = text;
    element.className = `small text-${tone}`;
  }

  function libraryRow(name, path, actions) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'prompt-library-item';
    const file = document.createElement('div');
    file.className = 'prompt-library-file';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = name;
    title.title = name;
    const location = document.createElement('span');
    location.className = 'text-muted small';
    location.textContent = path;
    location.title = path;
    file.append(title, location);
    const buttons = document.createElement('div');
    buttons.className = 'prompt-library-actions';
    buttons.append(...actions);
    row.append(file, buttons);
    return row;
  }

  function libraryButton(label, ariaLabel, onClick, className = 'btn btn-sm') {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.className = className;
    button.textContent = label;
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', ariaLabel);
    button.addEventListener('click', () => onClick(button));
    return button;
  }

  async function loadPromptLibrary() {
    libraryList.replaceChildren();
    setStatus(libraryStatus, 'Loading prompts…');
    try {
      const environments = ['workspace', 'codebuilder', 'prompt-creation'];
      const results = await Promise.all(environments.map(environment => Api.getAgents(environment)));
      const prompts = results
        .flatMap((data, index) => (data.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment: environments[index] })))
        .sort((left, right) => String(left.name || left.id).localeCompare(String(right.name || right.id)));
      if (!prompts.length) {
        setStatus(libraryStatus, 'No prompts found in the app library.');
        return;
      }
      setStatus(libraryStatus, `${prompts.length} prompt${prompts.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in library/`);
      for (const prompt of prompts) {
        const name = prompt.name || prompt.id;
        const path = prompt.path || `library/${prompt.id}.md`;
        const tools = libraryButton('Tools', `Choose tools for ${name}`,
          () => openToolsDialog('prompt', prompt.id, name));
        const edit = libraryButton('Edit', `Edit ${name}`, () => openFile(path, false));
        const remove = libraryButton('Delete', `Delete ${name}`, async button => {
          if (!confirm(`Delete prompt "${name}" from the app library?`)) return;
          button.disabled = true;
          try {
            await Api.deleteAgent(prompt.id, prompt.environment);
            if (state.path === path) clearEditor();
            await loadPromptLibrary();
          } catch (err) {
            setStatus(libraryStatus, `Could not delete prompt: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
            button.disabled = false;
          }
        }, 'btn btn-sm btn-danger');
        libraryList.appendChild(libraryRow(name, path, [tools, edit, remove]));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(libraryStatus, `Could not load app library: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    }
  }

  async function loadSubagentLibrary() {
    subagentList.replaceChildren();
    setStatus(subagentStatus, 'Loading sub-agents…');
    try {
      const catalog = await Api.getOrchestrationCatalog();
      const subagents = [...(catalog.subagents || [])]
        .sort((left, right) => String(left.name || left.id).localeCompare(String(right.name || right.id)));
      if (!subagents.length) {
        setStatus(subagentStatus, 'No sub-agent definitions were found.');
        return;
      }
      setStatus(subagentStatus, `${subagents.length} sub-agent${subagents.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} in subAgentLibrary/`);
      for (const agent of subagents) {
        const name = agent.name || agent.id;
        const path = `subAgentLibrary/${agent.id}.yaml`;
        const tools = libraryButton('Tools', `Choose tools for ${name}`,
          () => openToolsDialog('subagent', agent.id, name));
        const edit = libraryButton('Edit', `Edit ${name}`, () => openFile(path, false));
        const remove = libraryButton('Delete', `Delete ${name}`, async button => {
          if (!confirm(`Delete sub-agent "${name}" (${path})? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
          button.disabled = true;
          try {
            await Api.deleteSubagent(agent.id);
            if (state.path === path) clearEditor();
            await loadSubagentLibrary();
          } catch (err) {
            setStatus(subagentStatus, `Could not delete sub-agent: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
            button.disabled = false;
          }
        }, 'btn btn-sm btn-danger');
        subagentList.appendChild(libraryRow(name, path, [tools, edit, remove]));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(subagentStatus, `Could not load sub-agents: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    }
  }

  // --- Tools dialog ---------------------------------------------------------
  let toolCatalog = null;
  let toolsTarget = null;

  // The catalog sends each description as a list of lines; older entries may be a plain string.
  const toolSummary = tool => (Array.isArray(tool.description) ? tool.description.join(' ') : String(tool.description || '')).trim();

  const CATALOG_LABELS = {
    tools: 'Files',
    file_manager: 'File manager',
    editor: 'Editor',
    workspace: 'Workspace',
    codebuilder: 'CodeBuilder',
    core_engine: 'Core engine',
    orchestration: 'Orchestration',
    ragMemory: 'Knowledge (RAG)',
    scratchpadMemory: 'Scratchpad memory'
  };
  const catalogLabel = provider => CATALOG_LABELS[provider]
    || String(provider || 'Other').replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2')
      .replace(/^./, c => c.toUpperCase());

  function renderToolOptions(catalog, selected) {
    const known = new Set(catalog.map(tool => tool.name));
    // Keep tools the file lists but the catalog lacks, so saving never drops them silently.
    const missing = selected.filter(name => !known.has(name)).map(name => ({ name, missing: true }));
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const tool of catalog) {
      const label = catalogLabel(tool.provider);
      if (!groups.has(label)) groups.set(label, []);
      groups.get(label).push(tool);
    }
    const sections = [...groups.entries()]
      .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right))
      .map(([label, tools]) => [label, tools.sort((left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name))]);
    if (missing.length) sections.unshift(['Not registered', missing]);
    toolsList.replaceChildren(...sections.map(([label, tools]) => renderToolGroup(label, tools, selected)));
    // Unfold the group holding call_subagent when it is already on, so its sub-agent picker is visible.
    const callSubagent = toolsList.querySelector(`input[name="tools"][value="${SUBAGENT_TOOL}"]`);
    if (callSubagent?.checked) callSubagent.closest('.editor-tool-group').open = true;
    updateToolsCount();
  }

  const SUBAGENT_TOOL = 'call_subagent';

  function renderSubagentPanel() {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'editor-subagent-panel';
    const intro = document.createElement('p');
    intro.className = 'small text-muted';
    intro.textContent = 'Choose which sub-agents this prompt may call, and tell it when to call each one. '
      + 'Saved to the prompt\'s "## Sub-agents" section.';
    panel.appendChild(intro);
    const chosen = new Map((toolsTarget.subagents || []).map(entry => [entry.id, entry.usage]));
    const available = (toolsTarget.availableSubagents || [])
      .filter(agent => !(toolsTarget.kind === 'subagent' && agent.id === toolsTarget.agentId));
    // Entries the prompt names but the library no longer has: shown unchecked so saving drops them.
    const known = new Set(available.map(agent => agent.id));
    const gone = [...chosen.keys()].filter(id => !known.has(id)).map(id => ({ id, gone: true }));
    if (!available.length && !gone.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('p');
      empty.className = 'small text-muted';
      empty.textContent = 'No sub-agents in subAgentLibrary/ yet. Create one with + New in the Sub-agent Library.';
      panel.appendChild(empty);
    }
    for (const agent of [...gone, ...available]) {
      const choice = document.createElement('div');
      choice.className = 'editor-subagent-choice';
      const label = document.createElement('label');
      label.className = 'editor-subagent-check';
      const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
      checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
      checkbox.name = 'subagents';
      checkbox.value = agent.id;
      checkbox.checked = !agent.gone && chosen.has(agent.id);
      const copy = document.createElement('span');
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = agent.name || agent.id;
      const detail = document.createElement('span');
      detail.className = agent.gone ? 'text-danger small' : 'text-muted small';
      detail.textContent = agent.gone
        ? `${agent.id}: no longer in subAgentLibrary/, so it will be removed when you save`
        : [agent.id, agent.description].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      copy.append(title, detail);
      label.append(checkbox, copy);
      const usage = document.createElement('textarea');
      usage.className = 'form-input editor-subagent-usage';
      usage.rows = 3;
      usage.maxLength = 2000;
      usage.dataset.subagent = agent.id;
      usage.value = chosen.get(agent.id) || '';
      usage.placeholder = `When should it call ${agent.name || agent.id}, and what should it pass? `
        + 'e.g. "Call it when the user asks about indexed notes; pass the question as task_prompt."';
      usage.setAttribute('aria-label', `When to use ${agent.name || agent.id}`);
      choice.append(label, usage);
      panel.appendChild(choice);
    }
    return panel;
  }

  function syncSubagentPanel() {
    const panel = toolsList.querySelector('.editor-subagent-panel');
    if (!panel) return;
    const option = panel.previousElementSibling;
    const enabled = option.querySelector('input[name="tools"]').checked;
    panel.classList.toggle('hidden', !enabled || option.classList.contains('hidden'));
    panel.querySelectorAll('.editor-subagent-choice').forEach(choice => {
      choice.querySelector('.editor-subagent-usage')
        .classList.toggle('hidden', !choice.querySelector('input[name="subagents"]').checked);
    });
  }

  function renderToolGroup(label, tools, selected) {
    const group = document.createElement('details');
    group.className = 'editor-tool-group';
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    const groupCheck = document.createElement('input');
    groupCheck.type = 'checkbox';
    groupCheck.className = 'editor-tool-group-check';
    groupCheck.setAttribute('aria-label', `Select all ${label} tools`);
    // Clicking the checkbox must not also fold the section.
    groupCheck.addEventListener('click', event => event.stopPropagation());
    groupCheck.addEventListener('change', () => {
      group.querySelectorAll('.editor-tool-option:not(.hidden) input[name="tools"]')
        .forEach(input => { input.checked = groupCheck.checked; });
      updateToolsCount();
    });
    const title = document.createElement('span');
    title.className = 'editor-tool-group-title';
    title.textContent = label;
    const count = document.createElement('span');
    count.className = 'editor-tool-group-count text-muted small';
    summary.append(groupCheck, title, count);
    group.append(summary, ...tools.flatMap(tool => tool.name === SUBAGENT_TOOL && !tool.missing
      ? [renderToolOption(tool, selected), renderSubagentPanel()]
      : [renderToolOption(tool, selected)]));
    return group;
  }

  function renderToolOption(tool, selected) {
    const label = document.createElement('label');
    label.className = 'editor-tool-option';
    const summary = toolSummary(tool);
    label.dataset.search = `${tool.name} ${summary}`.toLowerCase();
    const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
    checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
    checkbox.name = 'tools';
    checkbox.value = tool.name;
    checkbox.checked = selected.includes(tool.name);
    const copy = document.createElement('span');
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = tool.name;
    copy.appendChild(title);
    if (tool.missing) {
      const note = document.createElement('span');
      note.className = 'text-danger small';
      note.textContent = 'Not registered: this tool is missing from the tool catalog';
      copy.appendChild(note);
    } else if (summary) {
      const description = document.createElement('span');
      description.className = 'text-muted small';
      description.textContent = summary;
      copy.appendChild(description);
    }
    label.append(checkbox, copy);
    return label;
  }

  function updateToolsCount() {
    const checked = toolsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="tools"]:checked').length;
    const total = toolsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="tools"]').length;
    toolsCount.textContent = `${checked} of ${total} selected`;
    toolsList.querySelectorAll('.editor-tool-group').forEach(group => {
      const inputs = [...group.querySelectorAll('input[name="tools"]')];
      const on = inputs.filter(input => input.checked).length;
      const groupCheck = group.querySelector('.editor-tool-group-check');
      groupCheck.checked = on === inputs.length;
      groupCheck.indeterminate = on > 0 && on < inputs.length;
      group.querySelector('.editor-tool-group-count').textContent = `${on}/${inputs.length}`;
    });
    if (toolsTarget?.mode === 'chat' && checked && !toolsAgentMode.dataset.touched) toolsAgentMode.checked = true;
    syncSubagentPanel();
  }

  async function openToolsDialog(kind, agentId, name) {
    toolsTarget = null;
    container.querySelector('#editor-tools-title').textContent = `Tools for ${name}`;
    container.querySelector('#editor-tools-path').textContent = 'Loading…';
    toolsFilter.value = '';
    toolsList.replaceChildren();
    toolsError.classList.add('hidden');
    toolsMode.classList.add('hidden');
    toolsAgentMode.checked = false;
    delete toolsAgentMode.dataset.touched;
    toolsConfirm.disabled = true;
    toolsDialog.showModal();
    try {
      const [catalog, current, availableSubagents] = await Promise.all([
        toolCatalog ? Promise.resolve(toolCatalog) : Api.getTools().then(data => data.tools || []),
        Api.getAgentTools(kind, agentId),
        // A broken sub-agent file must not block editing tools; the picker just shows none.
        Api.getOrchestrationCatalog().then(data => data.subagents || []).catch(() => [])
      ]);
      toolCatalog = catalog;
      toolsTarget = { kind, agentId, ...current, availableSubagents };
      container.querySelector('#editor-tools-path').textContent = current.path;
      toolsMode.classList.toggle('hidden', current.mode !== 'chat');
      renderToolOptions(catalog, current.tools);
      toolsConfirm.disabled = false;
      toolsFilter.focus();
    } catch (err) {
      container.querySelector('#editor-tools-path').textContent = '';
      toolsError.textContent = `Could not load tools: ${err.message}`;
      toolsError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  }

  toolsFilter.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const query = toolsFilter.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    toolsList.querySelectorAll('.editor-tool-option').forEach(option => {
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', Boolean(query) && !option.dataset.search.includes(query));
    });
    toolsList.querySelectorAll('.editor-tool-group').forEach(group => {
      group.classList.toggle('hidden', !group.querySelector('.editor-tool-option:not(.hidden)'));
      // Groups start collapsed; a search unfolds the matches and clearing it folds them back.
      group.open = Boolean(query);
    });
    syncSubagentPanel();
  });

  // The dialog is centred, so it grows on both sides: scale the drag by two to track the pointer.
  const toolsGrip = container.querySelector('.editor-tools-grip');
  const toolsSizeKey = 'novous2.editor.tools-dialog-size';
  try {
    const size = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(toolsSizeKey) || 'null');
    if (size?.width && size?.height) {
      toolsDialog.style.width = `${size.width}px`;
      toolsDialog.style.height = `${size.height}px`;
    }
  } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
  toolsGrip.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    toolsGrip.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    const startX = event.clientX;
    const startY = event.clientY;
    const startWidth = toolsDialog.offsetWidth;
    const startHeight = toolsDialog.offsetHeight;
    const onMove = moveEvent => {
      const width = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 32, Math.max(360, startWidth + (moveEvent.clientX - startX) * 2));
      const height = Math.min(window.innerHeight - 32, Math.max(360, startHeight + (moveEvent.clientY - startY) * 2));
      toolsDialog.style.width = `${width}px`;
      toolsDialog.style.height = `${height}px`;
    };
    const onUp = () => {
      toolsGrip.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
      toolsGrip.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
      toolsGrip.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(toolsSizeKey, JSON.stringify({
          width: toolsDialog.offsetWidth, height: toolsDialog.offsetHeight
        }));
      } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
    };
    toolsGrip.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
    toolsGrip.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
    toolsGrip.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
  });
  function setVisibleTools(checked) {
    toolsList.querySelectorAll('.editor-tool-option:not(.hidden) input[name="tools"]')
      .forEach(input => { input.checked = checked; });
    updateToolsCount();
  }
  container.querySelector('#editor-tools-select-all').addEventListener('click', () => setVisibleTools(true));
  container.querySelector('#editor-tools-clear-all').addEventListener('click', () => setVisibleTools(false));
  toolsList.addEventListener('change', event => {
    if (!event.target.classList.contains('editor-tool-group-check')) updateToolsCount();
  });
  toolsAgentMode.addEventListener('change', () => { toolsAgentMode.dataset.touched = 'true'; });
  container.querySelector('#editor-tools-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => toolsDialog.close());
  container.querySelector('#editor-tools-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!toolsTarget) return;
    const tools = [...toolsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="tools"]:checked')].map(input => input.value);
    const mode = toolsTarget.mode === 'chat' && toolsAgentMode.checked ? 'agent' : null;
    toolsConfirm.disabled = true;
    try {
      const subagents = tools.includes(SUBAGENT_TOOL)
        ? [...toolsList.querySelectorAll('input[name="subagents"]:checked')].map(input => ({
          id: input.value,
          usage: toolsList.querySelector(`.editor-subagent-usage[data-subagent="${CSS.escape(input.value)}"]`).value.trim()
        }))
        : [];
      const saved = await Api.setAgentTools(toolsTarget.kind, toolsTarget.agentId, tools, mode, subagents);
      toolsDialog.close();
      if (toolsTarget.kind === 'prompt') await loadPromptLibrary();
      else await loadSubagentLibrary();
      if (state.path === saved.path) {
        if (state.dirty) alert(`Tools were saved to ${saved.path}, but your unsaved edits in the editor are older than that change. Reload before saving to avoid overwriting the tools.`);
        else await openFile(saved.path, false);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toolsError.textContent = `Could not save tools: ${err.message}`;
      toolsError.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
      toolsConfirm.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  container.querySelector('#editor-new-prompt').addEventListener('click', () => {
    createPromptForm.classList.toggle('hidden');
    if (!createPromptForm.classList.contains('hidden')) createPromptName.focus();
  });
  container.querySelector('#editor-cancel-new-prompt').addEventListener('click', () => {
    createPromptForm.reset();
    delete createPromptId.dataset.edited;
    createPromptForm.classList.add('hidden');
  });
  createPromptName.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (!createPromptId.dataset.edited) createPromptId.value = slugify(createPromptName.value);
  });
  createPromptId.addEventListener('input', () => {
    createPromptId.dataset.edited = 'true';
  });
  createPromptForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = createPromptName.value.trim();
    const id = createPromptId.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(id)) {
      setStatus(libraryStatus, 'Enter a prompt name and a valid file name.', 'danger');
      return;
    }
    const submit = createPromptForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    submit.disabled = true;
    try {
      const created = await Api.createAgent(id, name, '', 'chat', '', 'prompt-creation');
      createPromptForm.reset();
      delete createPromptId.dataset.edited;
      createPromptForm.classList.add('hidden');
      await loadPromptLibrary();
      await openFile(created.path || `library/${id}.md`, false);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(libraryStatus, `Could not create prompt: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      submit.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  const createSubagentForm = container.querySelector('#editor-new-subagent-form');
  const createSubagentName = container.querySelector('#editor-new-subagent-name');
  const createSubagentId = container.querySelector('#editor-new-subagent-id');
  container.querySelector('#editor-new-subagent').addEventListener('click', () => {
    createSubagentForm.classList.toggle('hidden');
    if (!createSubagentForm.classList.contains('hidden')) createSubagentName.focus();
  });
  container.querySelector('#editor-cancel-new-subagent').addEventListener('click', () => {
    createSubagentForm.reset();
    delete createSubagentId.dataset.edited;
    createSubagentForm.classList.add('hidden');
  });
  createSubagentName.addEventListener('input', () => {
    if (!createSubagentId.dataset.edited) createSubagentId.value = slugify(createSubagentName.value);
  });
  createSubagentId.addEventListener('input', () => {
    createSubagentId.dataset.edited = 'true';
  });
  createSubagentForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const name = createSubagentName.value.trim();
    const id = createSubagentId.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(id)) {
      setStatus(subagentStatus, 'Enter a sub-agent name and a valid file name.', 'danger');
      return;
    }
    const description = container.querySelector('#editor-new-subagent-description').value.trim();
    const submit = createSubagentForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    submit.disabled = true;
    try {
      const created = await Api.createSubagent(id, name, description);
      createSubagentForm.reset();
      delete createSubagentId.dataset.edited;
      createSubagentForm.classList.add('hidden');
      await loadSubagentLibrary();
      await openFile(created.path, false);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(subagentStatus, `Could not create sub-agent: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      submit.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  function clearEditor() {
    state.path = null;
    state.content = '';
    state.managedPath = false;
    state.editor?.setValue('');
    pathLabel.textContent = 'No file open';
    dirtyBadge.classList.add('hidden');
    state.dirty = false;
    updateBytes();
  }

  async function openFile(path, managedFile = false) {
    if (state.dirty && !confirm('Discard unsaved changes?')) return;
    try {
      const data = managedFile ? await Api.readManagedFile(path) : await Api.readFile(path);
      state.path = data.path;
      state.content = data.content;
      state.managedPath = managedFile;
      state.dirty = false;
      pathLabel.textContent = data.path;
      dirtyBadge.classList.add('hidden');
      await editorReady;
      suppressEditorChanges = true;
      state.editor.setLanguage(languageForPath(data.path));
      state.editor.setValue(data.content);
      state.editor.setHighlightedLines(initialFile?.previewLines || []);
      suppressEditorChanges = false;
      updateBytes();
      updatePos();
      state.editor.focus();
    } catch (err) {
      suppressEditorChanges = false;
      alert(err.message);
    }
  }

  function languageForPath(path) {
    const extension = path.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
    return ({
      c: 'c', cc: 'cpp', cpp: 'cpp', cs: 'csharp', css: 'css', go: 'go',
      h: 'cpp', htm: 'html', html: 'html', java: 'java', js: 'javascript',
      json: 'json', jsx: 'javascript', md: 'markdown', mjs: 'javascript',
      py: 'python', rb: 'ruby', rs: 'rust', sh: 'shell', sql: 'sql',
      ts: 'typescript', tsx: 'typescript', txt: 'plaintext', xml: 'xml',
      yaml: 'yaml', yml: 'yaml'
    })[extension] || 'plaintext';
  }

  workspaceTree = renderTree(container.querySelector('#editor-tree'), {
    onBeforeDelete: path => {
      const deletesOpenFile = state.path === path || state.path?.startsWith(`${path}/`);
      return !deletesOpenFile || !state.dirty ||
        confirm('This item contains the open file with unsaved changes. Delete anyway?');
    },
    onDelete: path => {
      if (state.path === path || state.path?.startsWith(`${path}/`)) clearEditor();
    }
  });
  const onFileSelected = event => {
    const path = event.detail && event.detail.path;
    if (typeof path === 'string' && path) openFile(path, true);
  };
  fileSelectionListeners.set(container, onFileSelected);
  window.addEventListener('novous:file-selected', onFileSelected);
  editorReady.then(instance => instance.onPosition(updatePos));

  async function openSaveDialog() {
    try {
      const managedSave = state.managedPath || !state.path;
      const tree = managedSave
        ? await Api.getManagedFileTree()
        : await Api.getFileTree();
      const folders = [];
      const files = new Set();
      function collect(node) {
        if (node.type === 'directory') {
          if (node.path) folders.push(node.path);
          (node.children || []).forEach(collect);
        } else {
          files.add(node.path);
        }
      }
      collect(tree);
      // Library files live outside the workspace tree; keep their folder selectable.
      const openDirectory = (state.path || '').split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/');
      if (!managedSave && openDirectory && !folders.includes(openDirectory)) folders.push(openDirectory);
      folders.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

      saveDirectory.replaceChildren();
      const rootOption = document.createElement('option');
      rootOption.value = '';
      rootOption.textContent = '/ (workspace root)';
      saveDirectory.appendChild(rootOption);
      folders.forEach(path => {
        const option = document.createElement('option');
        option.value = path;
        option.textContent = path;
        saveDirectory.appendChild(option);
      });

      const currentParts = (state.path || '').split('/');
      const currentFilename = currentParts.pop() || 'untitled.txt';
      const currentDirectory = currentParts.join('/');
      saveDirectory.value = folders.includes(currentDirectory) ? currentDirectory : '';
      saveFilename.value = currentFilename;
      saveError.textContent = '';
      saveError.classList.add('hidden');
      saveDialog.showModal();
      saveFilename.focus();
      saveFilename.select();
      saveDialogFiles = files;
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Could not open the workspace save picker: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async function saveFile() {
    if (!saveDialog.open) {
      await openSaveDialog();
      return;
    }

    const filename = saveFilename.value.trim();
    if (!filename || filename === '.' || filename === '..' || /[\\/]/.test(filename)) {
      saveError.textContent = 'Enter a file name without folder separators.';
      saveError.classList.remove('hidden');
      saveFilename.focus();
      return;
    }

    const targetPath = [saveDirectory.value, filename].filter(Boolean).join('/');
    if (saveDialogFiles.has(targetPath) && targetPath !== state.path &&
        !confirm(`"${targetPath}" already exists. Overwrite it?`)) {
      return;
    }

    saveConfirm.disabled = true;
    try {
      await editorReady;
      const content = state.editor.getValue();
      const managedSave = state.managedPath || !state.path;
      if (managedSave) await Api.writeManagedFile(targetPath, content);
      else await Api.writeFile(targetPath, content);
      state.path = targetPath;
      state.content = content;
      state.managedPath = managedSave;
      state.editor.setLanguage(languageForPath(targetPath));
      state.dirty = false;
      dirtyBadge.classList.add('hidden');
      pathLabel.textContent = targetPath;
      updateBytes();
      saveDialog.close();
      workspaceTree.reload();
      if (!managedSave && targetPath.startsWith('library/')) loadPromptLibrary();
      if (!managedSave && targetPath.startsWith('subAgentLibrary/')) loadSubagentLibrary();
      if (!managedSave && targetPath.startsWith('library/') && targetPath.endsWith('.md')) {
        await showToolFit(targetPath);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      saveError.textContent = `Save failed: ${err.message}`;
      saveError.classList.remove('hidden');
    } finally {
      saveConfirm.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // After saving an agent, say whether its tools fit the installed models.
  async function showToolFit(path) {
    const agentId = path.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/, '');
    try {
      const report = await Api.getAgentToolFit(agentId);
      if (report.warnings.length) {
        setStatus(toolFitLabel, report.warnings.join(' '), 'warning');
      } else {
        setStatus(toolFitLabel, 'All tools fit the installed models.', 'success');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(toolFitLabel, `Could not check tools: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    }
  }

  function updateBytes() {
    bytesLabel.textContent = `${new Blob([state.editor?.getValue() || '']).size} bytes`;
  }

  function updatePos() {
    const position = state.editor?.getPosition();
    if (position) posLabel.textContent = `Ln ${position.lineNumber}, Col ${position.column}`;
  }

  container.querySelector('#editor-save').addEventListener('click', openSaveDialog);
  container.querySelector('#editor-save-form').addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    saveFile();
  });
  container.querySelector('#editor-save-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => saveDialog.close());
  container.querySelector('#editor-reload').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.path) openFile(state.path, state.managedPath);
  });
  editorReady.then(instance => instance.setSaveHandler(saveFile));

  // --- Resizable side panels ------------------------------------------------
  const layout = container.querySelector('.editor-layout');
  const panels = {
    left: { element: container.querySelector('.editor-sidebar'), width: 250, restore: 250 },
    right: { element: container.querySelector('.editor-library'), width: 280, restore: 280 }
  };
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(panelWidthStorageKey) || '{}');
    for (const side of Object.keys(panels)) {
      if (Number.isFinite(saved[side]?.width)) panels[side].width = saved[side].width;
      if (Number.isFinite(saved[side]?.restore)) panels[side].restore = saved[side].restore;
    }
  } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }

  function setPanelWidth(side, width) {
    const panel = panels[side];
    const other = panels[side === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left'];
    // A hidden layout has no width yet; skip clamping instead of collapsing everything.
    const maxWidth = layout.clientWidth
      ? Math.max(0, layout.clientWidth - other.width - (RESIZER_WIDTH * 2) - MIN_EDITOR_WIDTH)
      : Infinity;
    let nextWidth = Math.round(Math.min(maxWidth, Math.max(0, width)));
    if (nextWidth < COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD) nextWidth = 0;
    else panel.restore = nextWidth;
    panel.width = nextWidth;
    panel.element.classList.toggle('editor-panel-collapsed', nextWidth === 0);
    layout.style.setProperty(`--editor-${side}-width`, `${nextWidth}px`);
    const resizer = container.querySelector(`.editor-resizer[data-panel="${side}"]`);
    resizer.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(nextWidth));
    if (Number.isFinite(maxWidth)) resizer.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maxWidth));
    resizer.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', nextWidth === 0);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(panelWidthStorageKey, JSON.stringify({
        left: { width: panels.left.width, restore: panels.left.restore },
        right: { width: panels.right.width, restore: panels.right.restore }
      }));
    } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
  }

  function togglePanel(side) {
    const panel = panels[side];
    setPanelWidth(side, panel.width ? 0 : (panel.restore || 250));
  }

  container.querySelectorAll('.editor-resizer').forEach(resizer => {
    const side = resizer.dataset.panel;
    resizer.setAttribute('aria-valuemin', '0');
    resizer.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
      if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 820px)').matches) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      resizer.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      layout.classList.add('is-resizing');
      const bounds = layout.getBoundingClientRect();
      const onMove = moveEvent => {
        setPanelWidth(side, side === 'left'
          ? moveEvent.clientX - bounds.left
          : bounds.right - moveEvent.clientX);
      };
      const onUp = () => {
        layout.classList.remove('is-resizing');
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
        resizer.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
      };
      resizer.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
      resizer.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
      resizer.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
    });
    resizer.addEventListener('dblclick', () => togglePanel(side));
    resizer.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      // Arrow keys move the handle; the panel grows toward the editor.
      const grow = side === 'left' ? 'ArrowRight' : 'ArrowLeft';
      const shrink = side === 'left' ? 'ArrowLeft' : 'ArrowRight';
      const width = panels[side].width;
      if (event.key === grow) setPanelWidth(side, Math.max(width + 20, COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD));
      else if (event.key === shrink) setPanelWidth(side, width - 20);
      else if (event.key === 'Home') setPanelWidth(side, 0);
      else if (event.key === 'End') setPanelWidth(side, layout.clientWidth);
      else if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') togglePanel(side);
      else return;
      event.preventDefault();
    });
  });
  setPanelWidth('left', panels.left.width);
  setPanelWidth('right', panels.right.width);

  loadPromptLibrary();
  loadSubagentLibrary();

  if (initialFile?.path) openFile(initialFile.path, initialFile.managedFile === true);
}

export function createIcon(name) {
  const markup = ICON_MARKUP[name];
  if (!markup) throw new Error(`Unknown icon: ${name}`);

  const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
  svg.setAttribute('width', '16');
  svg.setAttribute('height', '16');
  svg.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
  svg.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
  svg.setAttribute('stroke-width', '2');
  svg.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
  svg.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
  svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  svg.classList.add('chat-icon');
  svg.innerHTML = markup;
  return svg;
}

/** The same icon as markup, for HTML templates. */
export function iconSvg(name, size = 16) {
  const markup = ICON_MARKUP[name];
  if (!markup) throw new Error(`Unknown icon: ${name}`);
  return `<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${size}" height="${size}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"`
    + ` stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${markup}</svg>`;
}

## `frontend/static/js/markdown.js`
````javascript
const DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS = /\.(pdf|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;
const PREVIEWABLE_LANGUAGES = new Set(['html', 'htm', 'svg']);

function safeUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, window.location.href);
    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function createLink(label, href) {
  const url = safeUrl(href);
  if (!url) return document.createTextNode(label);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.textContent = label;
  link.href = url.href;
  link.target = '_blank';
  link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
  if (DOCUMENT_EXTENSIONS.test(url.pathname + url.search)) {
    link.className = 'md-doc-button btn btn-sm';
    link.textContent = `📄 View ${label}`;
    link.title = url.href;
  }
  return link;
}

export function appendMarkdownInline(parent, text) {
  const pattern = /(`[^`]+`|https?:\/\/[^\s<>"'`]+|\*\*[^*]+\*\*|(?<![\w])__[^_]+__(?![\w])|\*[^*]+\*|(?<![\w])_[^_]+_(?![\w])|~~[^~]+~~|\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\))/g;
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match;

  while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null) {
    parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex, match.index)));
    const token = match[0];
    let element;

    if (token.startsWith('`')) {
      element = document.createElement('code');
      element.textContent = token.slice(1, -1);
    } else if (token.startsWith('**') || token.startsWith('__')) {
      element = document.createElement('strong');
      element.textContent = token.slice(2, -2);
    } else if (token.startsWith('~~')) {
      element = document.createElement('del');
      element.textContent = token.slice(2, -2);
    } else if (token.startsWith('*') || token.startsWith('_')) {
      element = document.createElement('em');
      element.textContent = token.slice(1, -1);
    } else if (match[2] !== undefined) {
      element = createLink(match[2], match[3]);
    } else {
      const trimmed = token.replace(/[.,;:!?)\]]+$/, '');
      element = createLink(trimmed, trimmed);
      parent.appendChild(element);
      element = document.createTextNode(token.slice(trimmed.length));
    }

    parent.appendChild(element);
    lastIndex = pattern.lastIndex;
  }

  parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex)));
}

function createCodeBlock(code, rawLanguage) {
  const language = (rawLanguage || '').trim().split(/\s+/, 1)[0].toLowerCase();
  const block = document.createElement('div');
  block.className = 'md-code-block';

  const header = document.createElement('div');
  header.className = 'md-code-header';
  const label = document.createElement('span');
  label.className = 'md-code-language';
  label.textContent = language || 'text';
  const actions = document.createElement('div');
  actions.className = 'md-code-actions';

  const copyButton = document.createElement('button');
  copyButton.type = 'button';
  copyButton.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-ghost';
  copyButton.textContent = 'Copy';
  copyButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
      copyButton.textContent = 'Copied!';
    } catch {
      copyButton.textContent = 'Copy failed';
    }
    setTimeout(() => { copyButton.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 2000);
  });
  actions.appendChild(copyButton);

  const pre = document.createElement('pre');
  const codeElement = document.createElement('code');
  if (language) codeElement.className = `language-${language}`;
  codeElement.textContent = code;
  pre.appendChild(codeElement);

  let frame = null;
  if (PREVIEWABLE_LANGUAGES.has(language)) {
    const previewButton = document.createElement('button');
    previewButton.type = 'button';
    previewButton.className = 'btn btn-sm';
    previewButton.textContent = 'Preview page';
    previewButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (frame) {
        frame.remove();
        frame = null;
        pre.hidden = false;
        previewButton.textContent = 'Preview page';
        return;
      }
      frame = document.createElement('iframe');
      frame.className = 'md-html-preview';
      frame.title = 'HTML preview';
      // No same-origin access: scripts in the reply cannot touch the app.
      frame.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts');
      frame.srcdoc = language === 'svg'
        ? `<!doctype html><body style="margin:0">${code}</body>`
        : code;
      pre.hidden = true;
      block.appendChild(frame);
      previewButton.textContent = 'Show code';
    });
    actions.appendChild(previewButton);
  }

  header.append(label, actions);
  block.append(header, pre);
  return block;
}

export function appendMarkdown(parent, markdown) {
  const lines = String(markdown ?? '').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').split('\n');
  let paragraph = [];
  let list = null;
  let codeLines = null;
  let codeLanguage = '';
  const isTableDelimiter = line =>
    /^\s*\|?\s*:?-{3,}:?\s*(\|\s*:?-{3,}:?\s*)+\|?\s*$/.test(line);
  const splitTableRow = line =>
    line.trim().replace(/^\|/, '').replace(/\|$/, '').split('|').map(cell => cell.trim());

  const flushParagraph = () => {
    if (!paragraph.length) return;
    const block = document.createElement('p');
    paragraph.forEach((line, index) => {
      if (index) block.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
      appendMarkdownInline(block, line);
    });
    parent.appendChild(block);
    paragraph = [];
  };
  const flushList = () => {
    if (list) parent.appendChild(list);
    list = null;
  };

  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const line = lines[index];
    const fence = line.match(/^\s*```([^`]*)$/);
    if (codeLines) {
      if (fence) {
        parent.appendChild(createCodeBlock(codeLines.join('\n'), codeLanguage));
        codeLines = null;
      } else {
        codeLines.push(line);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (fence) {
      flushParagraph();
      flushList();
      codeLines = [];
      codeLanguage = fence[1];
      continue;
    }
    if (!line.trim()) {
      flushParagraph();
      flushList();
      continue;
    }

    if (/^\s{0,3}(?:---+|___+|\*\*\*+)\s*$/.test(line)) {
      flushParagraph();
      flushList();
      parent.appendChild(document.createElement('hr'));
      continue;
    }

    if (line.includes('|') && lines[index + 1] && isTableDelimiter(lines[index + 1])) {
      flushParagraph();
      flushList();
      const headers = splitTableRow(line);
      const table = document.createElement('table');
      table.className = 'prompt-markdown-table';
      const thead = document.createElement('thead');
      const headerRow = document.createElement('tr');
      headers.forEach(text => {
        const cell = document.createElement('th');
        cell.scope = 'col';
        appendMarkdownInline(cell, text);
        headerRow.appendChild(cell);
      });
      thead.appendChild(headerRow);
      table.appendChild(thead);

      const tbody = document.createElement('tbody');
      for (index += 2; index < lines.length && lines[index].includes('|'); index += 1) {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        splitTableRow(lines[index]).forEach((text, cellIndex) => {
          const cell = document.createElement('td');
          if (headers[cellIndex]) appendMarkdownInline(cell, text);
          row.appendChild(cell);
        });
        tbody.appendChild(row);
      }
      table.appendChild(tbody);
      parent.appendChild(table);
      index -= 1;
      continue;
    }

    const heading = line.match(/^\s{0,3}(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$/);
    if (heading) {
      flushParagraph();
      flushList();
      const element = document.createElement(`h${heading[1].length}`);
      appendMarkdownInline(element, heading[2]);
      parent.appendChild(element);
      continue;
    }

    const item = line.match(/^\s{0,3}([-*+]|\d+[.)])\s+(.+)$/);
    if (item) {
      flushParagraph();
      const ordered = /^\d/.test(item[1]);
      if (!list || (list.tagName === 'OL') !== ordered) {
        flushList();
        list = document.createElement(ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul');
      }
      const element = document.createElement('li');
      const task = item[2].match(/^\[([ xX])\]\s+(.+)$/);
      if (task) {
        const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
        checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
        checkbox.checked = task[1].toLowerCase() === 'x';
        checkbox.disabled = true;
        checkbox.setAttribute('aria-label', checkbox.checked ? 'Completed task' : 'Incomplete task');
        element.classList.add('prompt-markdown-task');
        element.append(checkbox, document.createTextNode(' '));
        appendMarkdownInline(element, task[2]);
      } else {
        appendMarkdownInline(element, item[2]);
      }
      list.appendChild(element);
      continue;
    }

    flushList();
    const quote = line.match(/^\s{0,3}>\s?(.*)$/);
    if (quote) {
      flushParagraph();
      const blockquote = document.createElement('blockquote');
      appendMarkdownInline(blockquote, quote[1]);
      parent.appendChild(blockquote);
      continue;
    }

    paragraph.push(line.trim());
  }

  if (codeLines) parent.appendChild(createCodeBlock(codeLines.join('\n'), codeLanguage));
  flushParagraph();
  flushList();
}

import { Api } from './api.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from './markdown.js';

function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

export function renderPromptCreationView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="prompt-creation-flow">
      <section class="card prompt-chat-card" aria-labelledby="pc-chat-title">
        <div class="codebuilder-chat-heading">
          <h2 id="pc-chat-title">Chat Agent</h2>
          <span id="pc-chat-status" class="text-muted small">Loading agents…</span>
          <span class="prompt-chat-font-controls" role="group" aria-label="Chat text size">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" id="pc-font-smaller" title="Smaller text" aria-label="Decrease chat text size">A−</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" id="pc-font-larger" title="Larger text" aria-label="Increase chat text size">A+</button>
          </span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small prompt-chat-note">
          Chat with an available agent to clarify and shape your prompt. Responses use cleaner Markdown formatting when possible.
        </p>
        <div id="pc-chat-messages" class="codebuilder-chat-messages" aria-live="polite">
          <div class="codebuilder-chat-message system">Describe the prompt you want to create, and we’ll work through it together.</div>
        </div>
        <form id="pc-chat-form" class="codebuilder-chat-form">
          <label class="codebuilder-model-picker">
            <span class="text-muted small">Agent</span>
            <select id="pc-chat-agent" class="form-select" aria-label="Choose chat agent">
              <option value="">Loading agents…</option>
            </select>
            <span class="text-muted small">Model</span>
            <select id="pc-chat-model" class="form-select" aria-label="Choose model">
              <option value="">Loading models…</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <textarea id="pc-chat-input" class="form-input" rows="3"
                    placeholder="What should this prompt help its agent do?"
                    aria-label="Message to chat agent"></textarea>
          <div class="codebuilder-chat-actions">
            <button id="pc-chat-clear" class="btn btn-sm" type="button">Clear</button>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" disabled>Send</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>`;

  const chatAgentSel = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-agent');
  const chatModelSel = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-model');
  const chatInput = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-input');
  const chatMessages = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-messages');
  const chatStatus = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-status');
  const chatForm = container.querySelector('#pc-chat-form');
  const flow = container.querySelector('.prompt-creation-flow');

  let promptAgents = [];
  let selectedChatAgent = null;
  let chatPending = false;

  async function loadPromptAgents() {
    try {
      const [workspaceData, codeBuilderData, promptData] = await Promise.all([
        Api.getAgents(),
        Api.getCodeBuilderAgents(),
        Api.getAgents('prompt-creation')
      ]);
      const label = environment => ({ codebuilder: 'CodeBuilder', 'prompt-creation': 'Prompt Creation' })[environment] || 'Workspace';
      const agents = [
        ...(workspaceData.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment: 'workspace' })),
        ...(codeBuilderData.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment: 'codebuilder' })),
        ...(promptData.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment: 'prompt-creation' }))
      ];
      promptAgents = agents;
      chatAgentSel.innerHTML = agents.length
        ? agents.map(a => `<option value="${esc(a.environment)}:${esc(a.id)}">${esc(a.name)} — ${label(a.environment)}</option>`).join('')
        : '<option value="">No agents available</option>';
      let lastAgent = null;
      try { lastAgent = localStorage.getItem('novous2.prompt-creation.lastChatAgent'); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
      selectedChatAgent = agents.find(agent => `${agent.environment}:${agent.id}` === lastAgent)
        || agents.find(agent => agent.environment === 'workspace') || agents[0] || null;
      if (selectedChatAgent) {
        chatAgentSel.value = `${selectedChatAgent.environment}:${selectedChatAgent.id}`;
        chatStatus.textContent = `Agent: ${selectedChatAgent.name}`;
      } else {
        chatStatus.textContent = 'No agents available.';
      }

      await loadPromptChatModels();
      updateChatControls();
    } catch (err) {
      chatAgentSel.innerHTML = `<option value="">${esc(err.message)}</option>`;
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Could not load agents.';
    }
  }

  function updateChatControls() {
    const sendButton = chatForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    sendButton.disabled = chatPending || !selectedChatAgent || !chatModelSel.value || chatModelSel.disabled;
    chatInput.disabled = chatPending;
    chatAgentSel.disabled = chatPending || !promptAgents.length;
  }

  function appendChatMessage(role, content) {
    const message = document.createElement('div');
    message.className = `codebuilder-chat-message ${role}`;
    if (role === 'assistant') {
      message.classList.add('prompt-rich-markdown');
      appendMarkdown(message, content);
    } else {
      message.textContent = content;
    }
    chatMessages.appendChild(message);
    chatMessages.scrollTop = chatMessages.scrollHeight;
  }

  const chatFontKey = 'novous2.prompt-creation.chat-font-size';
  let chatFontSize = 14;
  try {
    const storedSize = Number(localStorage.getItem(chatFontKey));
    if (Number.isFinite(storedSize) && storedSize >= 11 && storedSize <= 32) chatFontSize = storedSize;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Could not load saved chat text size.', error);
  }
  function setChatFontSize(size) {
    chatFontSize = Math.min(32, Math.max(11, size));
    flow.style.setProperty('--prompt-chat-font-size', `${chatFontSize}px`);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(chatFontKey, String(chatFontSize));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Could not save chat text size.', error);
    }
  }
  setChatFontSize(chatFontSize);
  container.querySelector('#pc-font-smaller').addEventListener('click', () => setChatFontSize(chatFontSize - 1));
  container.querySelector('#pc-font-larger').addEventListener('click', () => setChatFontSize(chatFontSize + 2));

  async function loadPromptChatModels() {
    chatModelSel.disabled = true;
    chatModelSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Loading models…</option>';
    try {
      const data = await Api.getModels();
      const models = (data.models || []).slice().sort();
      if (!models.length) {
        chatModelSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No installed models</option>';
        chatStatus.textContent = data.error || 'No installed models detected.';
        updateChatControls();
        return;
      }
      chatModelSel.innerHTML = models.map(model =>
        `<option value="${esc(model)}">${esc(model)}</option>`
      ).join('');
      const preferred = selectedChatAgent?.model || data.default;
      chatModelSel.value = models.includes(preferred) ? preferred : models[0];
      chatModelSel.disabled = false;
      updateChatControls();
    } catch (err) {
      chatModelSel.innerHTML = `<option value="">${esc(err.message)}</option>`;
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Could not load models.';
      updateChatControls();
    }
  }

  loadPromptAgents();

  chatAgentSel.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const [environment, agentId] = chatAgentSel.value.split(':', 2);
    try { localStorage.setItem('novous2.prompt-creation.lastChatAgent', chatAgentSel.value); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
    selectedChatAgent = promptAgents.find(agent =>
      agent.environment === environment && agent.id === agentId
    ) || null;
    chatMessages.replaceChildren();
    if (selectedChatAgent) {
      appendChatMessage('system', `Chatting with ${selectedChatAgent.name}.`);
      chatStatus.textContent = `Agent: ${selectedChatAgent.name}`;
    } else {
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Select an agent to start.';
    }
    updateChatControls();
    loadPromptChatModels();
  });

  chatModelSel.addEventListener('change', updateChatControls);

  chatForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (!message || chatPending || !selectedChatAgent || !chatModelSel.value) return;

    appendChatMessage('user', message);
    chatInput.value = '';
    chatPending = true;
    chatStatus.textContent = `Waiting for ${selectedChatAgent.name}…`;
    updateChatControls();
    const sessionId = `prompt-creation-${selectedChatAgent.environment}-${selectedChatAgent.id}`;
    try {
      const response = await Api.sendMessage(
        `${message}\n\nWhen you write a prompt, reply with only the prompt as a Markdown document: one "# Title" line, a one-sentence description, then "## " headings named only for what they contain (for example "## Role", never "## Section: Role" or "## Role Section") each followed by plain-text instructions. No preamble or closing commentary.`,
        selectedChatAgent.id,
        chatModelSel.value,
        sessionId,
        selectedChatAgent.environment
      );
      const reply = String(response.reply || '').trim();
      appendChatMessage('assistant', reply || 'The agent returned an empty response.');
      chatStatus.textContent = `${selectedChatAgent.name} · ${response.model || chatModelSel.value}`;
    } catch (err) {
      appendChatMessage('system', `Request failed: ${err.message}`);
      chatStatus.textContent = 'Request failed.';
    } finally {
      chatPending = false;
      updateChatControls();
      chatInput.focus();
    }
  });

  chatInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' && !event.shiftKey) {
      event.preventDefault();
      chatForm.requestSubmit();
    }
  });

  container.querySelector('#pc-chat-clear').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (selectedChatAgent) {
      const sessionId = `prompt-creation-${selectedChatAgent.environment}-${selectedChatAgent.id}`;
      try {
        await Api.resetChat(sessionId);
      } catch (err) {
        chatStatus.textContent = `Could not clear chat: ${err.message}`;
        return;
      }
    }
    chatMessages.replaceChildren();
    appendChatMessage('system', selectedChatAgent
      ? `Chat cleared. Continue with ${selectedChatAgent.name}.`
      : 'Chat cleared.');
    updateChatControls();
    chatInput.focus();
  });
}

## `frontend/static/js/rag_warnings.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Knowledge-source scan warnings (e.g. Google Docs links that cannot be indexed),
 * rendered as a warning line with an expandable list of the affected files.
 */
export function ragWarningNodes(warnings) {
  return (warnings || []).map(warning => {
    const block = document.createElement('div');
    block.className = 'rag-warning small text-warning';
    block.setAttribute('role', 'note');
    const message = document.createElement('span');
    message.textContent = `⚠ ${warning.message}`;
    block.appendChild(message);
    const paths = warning.paths || [];
    if (paths.length) {
      const details = document.createElement('details');
      const summary = document.createElement('summary');
      summary.textContent = `Show ${paths.length} file(s)`;
      const list = document.createElement('ul');
      paths.forEach(path => {
        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.textContent = path.split('/').pop();
        item.title = path;
        list.appendChild(item);
      });
      details.append(summary, list);
      block.appendChild(details);
    }
    return block;
  });
}

## `frontend/static/js/sandbox_ui.js`
```javascript
// Shared UI for the isolated test environment (install missing packages, reset).

async function call(method, url, body) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = payload.detail;
    throw new Error(typeof detail === 'string' ? detail : (detail?.message || `Request failed (${response.status})`));
  }
  return payload;
}

export const Sandbox = {
  check: (source, modules = []) => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/check', { source, modules }),
  install: packages => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/install', { packages }),
  reset: () => call('POST', '/api/sandbox/reset')
};

export function missingModulesFromOutput(text) {
  const names = [...String(text || '').matchAll(/No module named '([A-Za-z_][\w]*)/g)].map(m => m[1]);
  return [...new Set(names)];
}

export function dialog(title, buildBody) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'question-dialog-overlay';
  const modal = document.createElement('div');
  modal.className = 'card question-dialog';
  modal.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
  modal.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'question-dialog-head';
  const heading = document.createElement('h3');
  heading.textContent = title;
  head.appendChild(heading);
  modal.appendChild(head);
  overlay.appendChild(modal);
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  const close = () => overlay.remove();
  buildBody(modal, close);
  return close;
}

// Resolves true when packages were installed, false when cancelled or failed.
export function promptInstall(missing) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    dialog('Install missing packages?', (modal, close) => {
      const text = document.createElement('p');
      text.className = 'question-dialog-prompt';
      text.textContent = 'This code needs packages that are not in the test environment. ' +
        'Installing runs third-party code from PyPI. Edit the list if a package name is different.';
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.className = 'form-input question-dialog-input';
      input.value = missing.map(item => item.package).join(' ');
      input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Packages to install (space separated)');
      const log = document.createElement('pre');
      log.className = 'tool-workbench-output';
      log.hidden = true;
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
      const cancel = document.createElement('button');
      cancel.type = 'button';
      cancel.className = 'btn';
      cancel.textContent = 'Cancel';
      const install = document.createElement('button');
      install.type = 'button';
      install.className = 'btn btn-primary';
      install.textContent = 'Install';
      actions.append(cancel, install);
      modal.append(text, input, log, actions);
      input.focus();

      cancel.addEventListener('click', () => { close(); resolve(false); });
      install.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const packages = input.value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (!packages.length) return;
        install.disabled = cancel.disabled = input.disabled = true;
        install.textContent = 'Installing…';
        log.hidden = false;
        log.textContent = `pip install ${packages.join(' ')}\n`;
        try {
          const result = await Sandbox.install(packages);
          log.textContent += result.output || '';
          if (result.ok) {
            setTimeout(() => { close(); resolve(true); }, 600);
            return;
          }
          log.textContent += '\nInstall failed.';
        } catch (err) {
          log.textContent += `\nError: ${err.message}`;
        }
        install.disabled = cancel.disabled = input.disabled = false;
        install.textContent = 'Retry';
        cancel.textContent = 'Close';
      });
    });
  });
}

// Detects missing packages for the code and the run output, then offers to install them.
// Returns true when something was installed so the caller can re-run.
export async function offerInstallForRun(source, outputText) {
  const named = missingModulesFromOutput(outputText);
  if (!named.length) return false;
  let missing;
  try {
    missing = (await Sandbox.check(source, named)).missing;
  } catch {
    missing = named.map(module => ({ module, package: module }));
  }
  if (!missing.length) return false;
  return promptInstall(missing);
}

export async function offerInstallBeforeRun(source) {
  let missing;
  try {
    missing = (await Sandbox.check(source, [])).missing;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  return missing.length ? promptInstall(missing) : false;
}

export async function confirmReset() {
  if (!confirm('Reset the test environment? All packages installed for testing will be removed.')) return null;
  return Sandbox.reset();
}

```

## `frontend/static/js/scratchpad_reader.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Reader controls shared by the Agent and Code scratchpads: adjustable text size,
 * find, expand/collapse, a pop-out window, and saving as Markdown or a standalone HTML page.
 *
 * Content opts in by marking each searchable block with `data-reader-item`.
 */
import { Api } from './api.js';
import { iconSvg } from './icons.js';

const SIZE_STEP = 0.1;
const SIZE_MIN = 0.7;
const SIZE_MAX = 1.6;
const SIZE_DEFAULT = 0.9;

function readStoredSize(key) {
  try {
    const value = Number(localStorage.getItem(key));
    return value >= SIZE_MIN && value <= SIZE_MAX ? value : SIZE_DEFAULT;
  } catch {
    return SIZE_DEFAULT;
  }
}

function storeSize(key, value) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(key, String(value)); } catch { /* storage unavailable */ }
}

function button(label, title, icon) {
  const element = document.createElement('button');
  element.type = 'button';
  element.className = 'cb-btn';
  element.title = title;
  element.setAttribute('aria-label', title);
  element.innerHTML = icon ? `${iconSvg(icon)}<span></span>` : '<span></span>';
  element.querySelector('span').textContent = label;
  return element;
}

/** A copy of the content without app-only controls, every entry visible. */
function staticCopy(content) {
  const copy = content.cloneNode(true);
  copy.removeAttribute('id');
  copy.querySelectorAll('.md-code-actions, iframe, .reader-empty-filter').forEach(node => node.remove());
  copy.querySelectorAll('[hidden]').forEach(node => node.removeAttribute('hidden'));
  // Labels (section shortcuts, map file names) stay as text; other controls are dropped.
  copy.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(node => {
    if (!node.matches('.reader-nav button, .scratchpad-file-link')) {
      node.remove();
      return;
    }
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = node.className;
    span.textContent = node.textContent;
    if (node.title) span.title = node.title;
    node.replaceWith(span);
  });
  copy.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(node => node.removeAttribute('id'));
  return copy;
}

const STANDALONE_CSS = `
:root { color-scheme: dark; --bg: #121316; --card: #1e2025; --elev: #262a31; --text: #e2e8f0;
  --muted: #8b94a7; --border: #2e323b; --primary: #3b82f6; --accent: #8b5cf6; --success: #22c55e;
  --warning: #f59e0b; --danger: #ef4444; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  :root { color-scheme: light; --bg: #f6f7f9; --card: #ffffff; --elev: #f0f2f5; --text: #1c2129;
    --muted: #5d6675; --border: #d9dde3; --primary: #2563eb; --accent: #7c3aed; --success: #15803d;
    --warning: #b45309; --danger: #b91c1c; }
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
  font: 1rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }
header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--card); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; }
header p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
.tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; }
.tools button { padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; color: var(--text); background: var(--elev); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 6px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; }
main { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem; font-size: var(--reader-size, 0.95rem); }
main > div { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
section { min-width: 0; }
h2, h3, h4 { margin: 0.4rem 0 0.5rem; line-height: 1.3; }
details > summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
pre { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.7rem; margin: 0.5rem 0; background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font: 0.9em/1.5 Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; }
code { font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.92em; }
table { border-collapse: collapse; } th, td { padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
.text-muted { color: var(--muted); } .text-danger { color: var(--danger); } .text-warning { color: var(--warning); }
.small { font-size: 0.85em; }
.badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.45rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 600; }
.badge-success { color: var(--success); } .badge-danger { color: var(--danger); } .badge-warning { color: var(--warning); }
.scratchpad-read, .codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; }
.scratchpad-result { background: var(--elev); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="code"] { border-left-color: var(--success); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="test"] { border-left-color: var(--warning); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="fix"] { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry[data-kind="note"] { border-left-color: var(--muted); }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-entry-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; font-size: 0.85em; }
.codebuilder-scratchpad-kind { padding: 0 0.4rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; }
.reader-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; }
.reader-nav a, .reader-nav span { padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem; color: var(--primary); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.85em; }
.scratchpad-tree-list { list-style: none; padding-left: 1.15rem; margin: 0.2rem 0; }
.scratchpad-file-link { color: var(--primary); }
.md-code-block { margin: 0.5rem 0; } .md-code-header { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8em; }
`;

const STANDALONE_SCRIPT = `
const main = document.querySelector('main');
let size = Number(getComputedStyle(main).getPropertyValue('--reader-size')) || 0.95;
const setSize = value => { size = Math.min(1.8, Math.max(0.7, value)); main.style.setProperty('--reader-size', size + 'rem'); };
document.querySelector('[data-smaller]').onclick = () => setSize(size - 0.1);
document.querySelector('[data-larger]').onclick = () => setSize(size + 0.1);
document.querySelector('[data-expand]').onclick = () => main.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => { d.open = true; });
document.querySelector('[data-collapse]').onclick = () => main.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => { d.open = false; });
`;

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

/** A self-contained page (styles and its own size/expand controls inline) of the current content. */
export function buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, sizeRem) {
  const exported = new Date().toLocaleString();
  return `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title>
<style>${STANDALONE_CSS}</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <div><h1>${escapeHtml(title)}</h1><p>Exported ${escapeHtml(exported)}</p></div>
  <div class="tools">
    <button type="button" data-smaller title="Smaller text">A−</button>
    <button type="button" data-larger title="Larger text">A+</button>
    <button type="button" data-expand>Expand all</button>
    <button type="button" data-collapse>Collapse all</button>
  </div>
</header>
<main style="--reader-size: ${sizeRem}rem">${staticCopy(content).outerHTML}</main>
<script>${STANDALONE_SCRIPT}</script>
</body>
</html>`;
}

/**
 * Attach reader controls to ``toolbar`` for the scratchpad rendered into ``content``.
 * ``getMarkdown`` returns (or resolves to) the Markdown export; ``filenameBase`` names saved files.
 * Call ``refresh()`` on the returned controller after re-rendering the content.
 */
export function setupScratchpadReader({ content, toolbar, prefsKey, title, getMarkdown, filenameBase, onError }) {
  const sizeKey = `${prefsKey}readerSize`;
  let size = readStoredSize(sizeKey);
  content.classList.add('scratchpad-reader');
  const applySize = () => content.style.setProperty('--reader-size', `${size.toFixed(2)}rem`);
  applySize();

  const sizeGroup = document.createElement('div');
  sizeGroup.className = 'cb-group';
  sizeGroup.setAttribute('role', 'group');
  sizeGroup.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Scratchpad text size');
  const smaller = button('A−', 'Smaller text');
  const larger = button('A+', 'Larger text');
  sizeGroup.append(smaller, larger);
  const resize = delta => {
    size = Math.min(SIZE_MAX, Math.max(SIZE_MIN, Math.round((size + delta) * 100) / 100));
    applySize();
    storeSize(sizeKey, size);
  };
  smaller.addEventListener('click', () => resize(-SIZE_STEP));
  larger.addEventListener('click', () => resize(SIZE_STEP));

  const find = document.createElement('input');
  find.type = 'search';
  find.className = 'form-input reader-find';
  find.placeholder = 'Find…';
  find.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Find in scratchpad');
  const findCount = document.createElement('span');
  findCount.className = 'small text-muted reader-find-count';
  findCount.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

  const expand = button('Expand all', 'Expand every entry');
  const collapse = button('Collapse all', 'Collapse every entry');
  const setOpen = open => content.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(details => { details.open = open; });
  expand.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(true));
  collapse.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));

  const popOut = button('Pop out', 'Open in a separate, resizable window', 'file-code');
  const saveMd = button('Save .md', 'Save as a Markdown file', 'save');
  const saveHtml = button('Save .html', 'Save as a web page you can open in any browser', 'save-as');

  const stamp = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const report = error => {
    if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return;
    onError?.(error);
  };
  popOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const html = buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, size);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' }));
    const opened = window.open(url, '_blank', 'popup,width=1000,height=800');
    if (!opened) report(new Error('The browser blocked the pop-out window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.'));
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
  });
  saveMd.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    saveMd.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.saveTextFile(await getMarkdown(), `${filenameBase}-${stamp()}.md`, 'md');
    } catch (error) {
      report(error);
    } finally {
      saveMd.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  saveHtml.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    saveHtml.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.saveTextFile(buildStandaloneHtml(title, content, size), `${filenameBase}-${stamp()}.html`, 'html');
    } catch (error) {
      report(error);
    } finally {
      saveHtml.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  const applyFilter = () => {
    const query = find.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const items = [...content.querySelectorAll('[data-reader-item]')];
    let shown = 0;
    items.forEach(item => {
      const match = !query || item.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(query);
      item.hidden = !match;
      if (match) {
        shown += 1;
        if (query) {
          if (item.tagName === 'DETAILS') item.open = true;
          item.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(details => { details.open = true; });
        }
      }
    });
    content.querySelector('.reader-empty-filter')?.remove();
    findCount.textContent = query ? `${shown} of ${items.length}` : '';
    if (query && !shown) {
      const empty = document.createElement('p');
      empty.className = 'text-muted reader-empty-filter';
      empty.textContent = `Nothing matches "${find.value.trim()}".`;
      content.prepend(empty);
    }
  };
  find.addEventListener('input', applyFilter);

  toolbar.classList.add('reader-toolbar');
  toolbar.append(sizeGroup, find, findCount, expand, collapse, popOut, saveMd, saveHtml);
  return { refresh: applyFilter };
}

/**
 * Shared app-shell state and navigation. Views import from here instead of app.js so the
 * router and its views never import each other.
 */
import { Api } from './api.js';

export const AppState = {
  activeTab: 'squads',
  agents: [],
  project: null,
  health: null,
  currentPath: '',
  ragScanJob: null
};

export function esc(value) {
  return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
  }[c]));
}

/** Ask the shell to open another section; app.js owns the actual routing. */
export function navigate(tab, payload = null) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:navigate', { detail: { tab, payload } }));
}

export function openInEditor(path) {
  navigate('editor', { path, managedFile: false });
}

export async function refreshAgents() {
  const data = await Api.getAgents();
  AppState.agents = data.agents || [];
  return AppState.agents;
}

export async function refreshProject() {
  AppState.project = await Api.getProjectState();
  return AppState.project;
}

export function updateHealthBadge(health) {
  const badge = document.getElementById('health-badge');
  if (!badge || !health) return;
  const ok = health.ollama?.reachable;
  badge.className = 'badge ' + (ok ? 'badge-success' : 'badge-warning');
  badge.textContent = ok ? 'Engine Ready' : 'Ollama Offline';
}
