## `frontend/static/js/codebuilder/codebuilder_editor.js`
```javascript
const MONACO_VS_PATH = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/monaco-editor@0.52.2/min/vs';
let monacoPromise;

export function loadMonaco() {
  if (window.monaco?.editor) return Promise.resolve(window.monaco);
  if (monacoPromise) return monacoPromise;

  monacoPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof window.require !== 'function') {
      reject(new Error('The Monaco Editor loader is unavailable.'));
      return;
    }

    window.require.config({ paths: { vs: MONACO_VS_PATH } });
    window.require(['vs/editor/editor.main'], () => {
      if (!window.monaco?.editor) {
        reject(new Error('Monaco Editor failed to initialize.'));
        return;
      }
      resolve(window.monaco);
    }, reject);
  });
  return monacoPromise;
}

function createTextareaEditor(element, initialValue) {
  const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
  textarea.className = 'codebuilder-textarea';
  textarea.value = initialValue;
  textarea.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Python source code');
  element.replaceChildren(textarea);
  let runHandler = null;
  let saveHandler = null;
  let changeHandler = null;
  let positionHandler = null;
  textarea.addEventListener('input', () => changeHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('keyup', () => positionHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('click', () => positionHandler?.());
  textarea.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') {
        event.preventDefault();
        runHandler?.();
      } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 's' && saveHandler) {
        event.preventDefault();
        saveHandler?.();
      }
    }
  });

  return {
    getValue: () => textarea.value,
    setValue: (value) => { textarea.value = value; changeHandler?.(); },
    setLanguage: () => {},
    getPosition: () => {
      const lines = textarea.value.slice(0, textarea.selectionStart).split('\n');
      return { lineNumber: lines.length, column: lines[lines.length - 1].length + 1 };
    },
    setDiagnostics: () => {},
    setHighlightedLines: (lines) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(lines) || !lines.length) return;
      const sourceLines = textarea.value.split('\n');
      const targetLine = Math.max(1, Math.min(lines[0], sourceLines.length));
      const lineStart = sourceLines.slice(0, targetLine - 1).join('\n').length
        + (targetLine > 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const lineEnd = lineStart + sourceLines[targetLine - 1].length;
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(lineStart, lineEnd);
    },
    setChangeView: () => {},
    setRunHandler: (handler) => { runHandler = handler; },
    setSaveHandler: (handler) => { saveHandler = handler; },
    onChange: (handler) => { changeHandler = handler; },
    onPosition: (handler) => { positionHandler = handler; },
    revealLine: (line) => {
      const lineStart = textarea.value.split('\n').slice(0, Math.max(0, line - 1)).join('\n').length;
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.setSelectionRange(lineStart, lineStart);
    },
    focus: () => textarea.focus(),
    setReadOnly: (readOnly) => { textarea.readOnly = !!readOnly; },
    revealEnd: () => { textarea.scrollTop = textarea.scrollHeight; },
    dispose: () => textarea.remove(),
  };
}

export async function attachCodeBuilderEditor(
  element,
  initialValue = "print('Hello from Novous CodeBuilder!')\n",
  language = 'python'
) {
  if (!element) {
    throw new Error('The CodeBuilder editor container was not found.');
  }

  try {
    const monaco = await loadMonaco();
    const editor = monaco.editor.create(element, {
      value: initialValue,
      language,
      theme: 'vs-dark',
      automaticLayout: true,
      ariaLabel: 'Python code editor',
      accessibilitySupport: 'auto',
      bracketPairColorization: { enabled: true },
      cursorBlinking: 'smooth',
      detectIndentation: false,
      folding: true,
      fontSize: 14,
      fontFamily: "'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', Consolas, monospace",
      fontLigatures: true,
      glyphMargin: true,
      formatOnPaste: true,
      guides: { bracketPairs: true, indentation: true },
      lineNumbers: 'on',
      minimap: { enabled: true, scale: 0.8 },
      padding: { top: 12, bottom: 12 },
      renderLineHighlight: 'all',
      scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
      smoothScrolling: true,
      stickyScroll: { enabled: true },
      tabSize: 4,
      insertSpaces: true,
      wordWrap: 'off',
    });
    let runHandler = null;
    let saveHandler = null;
    let changeHandler = null;
    let positionHandler = null;
    editor.onDidChangeModelContent(() => changeHandler?.());
    editor.onDidChangeCursorPosition(() => positionHandler?.());
    editor.addAction({
      id: 'codebuilder.runPython',
      label: 'Run Python',
      keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.Enter],
      run: () => runHandler?.(),
    });
    let saveAction = null;
    let highlightDecorations = [];

    return {
      getValue: () => editor.getValue(),
      setValue: (value) => { editor.setValue(value); },
      setLanguage: (nextLanguage) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (model) monaco.editor.setModelLanguage(model, nextLanguage);
      },
      getPosition: () => editor.getPosition(),
      focus: () => editor.focus(),
      setRunHandler: (handler) => { runHandler = handler; },
      setSaveHandler: (handler) => {
        saveAction?.dispose();
        saveHandler = handler;
        if (handler) {
          saveAction = editor.addAction({
            id: 'codebuilder.save',
            label: 'Save',
            keybindings: [monaco.KeyMod.CtrlCmd | monaco.KeyCode.KeyS],
            run: () => saveHandler?.(),
          });
        }
      },
      onChange: (handler) => { changeHandler = handler; },
      onPosition: (handler) => { positionHandler = handler; },
      revealLine: (line) => {
        editor.revealLineInCenter(line);
        editor.setPosition({ lineNumber: line, column: 1 });
        editor.focus();
      },
      setDiagnostics: (items) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (!model) return;
        monaco.editor.setModelMarkers(model, 'codebuilder', items.map(item => ({
          severity: item.severity === 'warning'
            ? monaco.MarkerSeverity.Warning
            : item.severity === 'info'
              ? monaco.MarkerSeverity.Info
              : monaco.MarkerSeverity.Error,
          message: item.message,
          startLineNumber: item.line || 1,
          endLineNumber: item.line || 1,
          startColumn: item.column || 1,
          endColumn: (item.column || 1) + 1,
        })));
      },
      setHighlightedLines: (lines, kind = 'preview') => {
        const applied = kind === 'applied';
        const error = kind === 'error';
        highlightDecorations = editor.deltaDecorations(
          highlightDecorations,
          (Array.isArray(lines) ? lines : [])
            .filter(line => Number.isInteger(line) && line > 0)
            .map(line => ({
              range: new monaco.Range(line, 1, line, 1),
              options: {
                isWholeLine: true,
                className: applied
                  ? 'code-change-applied-line'
                  : error
                    ? 'code-change-error-line'
                    : 'code-change-preview-line',
                glyphMarginClassName: applied
                  ? 'code-change-applied-glyph'
                  : error
                    ? 'code-change-error-glyph'
                    : 'code-change-preview-glyph',
                overviewRuler: {
                  color: applied ? '#22c55e' : error ? '#ef4444' : '#facc15',
                  position: monaco.editor.OverviewRulerLane.Right
                }
              }
            }))
        );
        if (lines?.length) editor.revealLineInCenter(lines[0]);
      },
      setChangeView: (lines, compact = true) => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (typeof editor.setHiddenAreas !== 'function' || !model) return;
        if (!compact || !Array.isArray(lines) || !lines.length) {
          editor.setHiddenAreas([]);
          return;
        }
        const visible = new Set();
        lines.forEach(line => {
          for (let current = Math.max(1, line - 2); current <= line + 2; current += 1) {
            if (current <= model.getLineCount()) visible.add(current);
          }
        });
        const hidden = [];
        let start = null;
        for (let line = 1; line <= model.getLineCount() + 1; line += 1) {
          if (line <= model.getLineCount() && !visible.has(line)) {
            if (start === null) start = line;
          } else if (start !== null) {
            hidden.push(new monaco.Range(start, 1, line - 1, 1));
            start = null;
          }
        }
        editor.setHiddenAreas(hidden);
      },
      setReadOnly: (readOnly) => editor.updateOptions({ readOnly: !!readOnly }),
      revealEnd: () => {
        const model = editor.getModel();
        if (model) editor.revealLine(model.getLineCount());
      },
      dispose: () => editor.dispose(),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Monaco Editor could not be loaded; using the basic Python editor instead.', error);
    return createTextareaEditor(element, initialValue);
  }
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/codebuilder/files_ui.js`
```javascript
import { dialog } from '../sandbox_ui.js';
import { renderTree } from '../tree.js';
import { Api } from '../api.js';

async function call(method, url, body) {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(typeof payload.detail === 'string' ? payload.detail : `Request failed (${response.status}).`);
  }
  return payload;
}

const Files = {
  list: () => call('GET', '/api/codebuilder/files'),
  read: path => call('GET', `/api/codebuilder/files/read?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`),
  save: (folder, name, content, overwrite) =>
    call('POST', '/api/codebuilder/files/save', { folder, name, content, overwrite }),
  runCommand: (path, content) => call('POST', '/api/codebuilder/files/run-command', { path, content })
};

function button(label, className = 'btn') {
  const el = document.createElement('button');
  el.type = 'button';
  el.className = className;
  el.textContent = label;
  return el;
}

// Save, Save As, Open and Run-in-terminal for the editor. `openTerminalWith(command)` prefills the terminal.
export function setupFileControls({ editor, status, label, buttons, openTerminalWith }) {
  let currentPath = '';
  let managedPath = ''; // set when the open file came from the file manager (saved through it too)
  let savedValue = editor.getValue();

  const isDirty = () => editor.getValue() !== savedValue;
  const nameOf = path => path.split(/[\\/]/).pop();

  const refreshLabel = () => {
    if (!label) return;
    label.textContent = currentPath ? `${nameOf(currentPath)}${isDirty() ? ' ●' : ''}` : (isDirty() ? 'Unsaved ●' : 'Untitled');
    label.title = currentPath || 'Not saved to a file yet';
  };

  const markSaved = (path) => {
    currentPath = path;
    savedValue = editor.getValue();
    refreshLabel();
  };

  const writeFile = async (folder, name, overwrite = false) => {
    const result = await Files.save(folder, name, editor.getValue(), overwrite);
    if (result.saved) {
      managedPath = '';
      markSaved(result.path);
      status.textContent = `Saved ${result.path}`;
      return result;
    }
    if (result.exists && confirm(`${result.name} already exists. Replace it?`)) {
      return writeFile(folder, name, true);
    }
    return null;
  };

  const saveAs = () => new Promise(resolve => {
    Files.list().then(info => {
      dialog('Save as', (modal, close) => {
        const nameInput = document.createElement('input');
        nameInput.className = 'form-input question-dialog-input';
        nameInput.placeholder = 'file name, e.g. app.py';
        nameInput.value = currentPath ? nameOf(currentPath) : '';
        nameInput.setAttribute('aria-label', 'File name');
        const folderSelect = document.createElement('select');
        folderSelect.className = 'form-select';
        folderSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Folder');
        info.folders.forEach(folder => {
          const option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = folder;
          option.textContent = folder;
          folderSelect.appendChild(option);
        });
        folderSelect.value = currentPath
          ? currentPath.slice(0, Math.max(currentPath.lastIndexOf('\\'), currentPath.lastIndexOf('/')))
          : info.default_folder;
        if (!folderSelect.value) folderSelect.value = info.default_folder;
        const error = document.createElement('p');
        error.className = 'text-danger small';
        const actions = document.createElement('div');
        actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
        const cancel = button('Cancel');
        const save = button('Save', 'btn btn-primary');
        actions.append(cancel, save);
        modal.append(nameInput, folderSelect, error, actions);
        nameInput.focus();
        cancel.addEventListener('click', () => { close(); resolve(null); });
        const submit = async () => {
          if (!nameInput.value.trim()) { error.textContent = 'Enter a file name.'; return; }
          save.disabled = true;
          try {
            const result = await writeFile(folderSelect.value, nameInput.value);
            if (result) { close(); resolve(result); }
          } catch (err) {
            error.textContent = err.message;
          }
          save.disabled = false;
        };
        save.addEventListener('click', submit);
        nameInput.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') submit(); });
      });
    }).catch(err => { status.textContent = err.message; resolve(null); });
  });

  const save = async () => {
    if (managedPath) {
      try {
        await Api.writeManagedFile(managedPath, editor.getValue());
        markSaved(managedPath);
        status.textContent = `Saved ${managedPath}`;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:fs-changed'));
        return { saved: true, path: managedPath };
      } catch (err) {
        status.textContent = `Save failed: ${err.message}`;
        return null;
      }
    }
    if (!currentPath) return saveAs();
    const folder = currentPath.slice(0, Math.max(currentPath.lastIndexOf('\\'), currentPath.lastIndexOf('/')));
    try {
      return await writeFile(folder, nameOf(currentPath), true);
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = `Save failed: ${err.message}`;
      return null;
    }
  };

  const open = async () => {
    if (isDirty() && !confirm('Discard unsaved changes in the editor?')) return;
    dialog('Open from file manager', (modal, close) => {
      modal.classList.add('is-resizable');
      const treeHost = document.createElement('div');
      treeHost.className = 'codebuilder-open-tree';
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'question-dialog-actions';
      const cancel = button('Cancel');
      cancel.addEventListener('click', close);
      actions.appendChild(cancel);
      modal.append(treeHost, actions);

      renderTree(treeHost, {
        manageRoots: true,
        onSelect: async (path, type) => {
          if (type !== 'file') return;
          try {
            const opened = await Api.readManagedFile(path);
            editor.setValue(opened.content);
            managedPath = opened.path;
            markSaved(opened.path);
            status.textContent = `Opened ${opened.path}`;
            close();
          } catch (err) {
            status.textContent = `Could not open ${path}: ${err.message}`;
          }
        }
      });
    });
  };

  const loadManagedPath = async (path, expectedEditorValue = null) => {
    if (isDirty() && editor.getValue() !== expectedEditorValue) {
      status.textContent = 'Save or discard your unsaved editor changes before viewing an orchestration file.';
      return false;
    }
    const opened = await Api.readManagedFile(path);
    editor.setValue(opened.content);
    managedPath = opened.path;
    currentPath = '';
    markSaved(opened.path);
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('novous:fs-changed'));
    return true;
  };

  const runInTerminal = async () => {
    const saved = await save();
    if (!saved && !currentPath) return;
    try {
      const { command } = await Files.runCommand(currentPath, editor.getValue());
      openTerminalWith?.(command);
      status.textContent = 'Press Enter in the terminal to run';
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = err.message;
    }
  };

  buttons.save?.addEventListener('click', save);
  buttons.saveAs?.addEventListener('click', saveAs);
  buttons.open?.addEventListener('click', open);
  buttons.runTerminal?.addEventListener('click', runInTerminal);
  editor.setSaveHandler?.(save);
  refreshLabel();

  return {
    refreshLabel,
    save,
    saveAs,
    open,
    loadManagedPath,
    isDirty,
    getCurrentPath: () => managedPath || currentPath,
  };
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/agents_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Agents section: the library of primary agents (library/*.md) and sub-agents
 * (subAgentLibrary/*.yaml), which squads use them, their tools, and creating new ones.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate, openInEditor } from '../shell.js';

let kindFilter = 'all';
let search = '';

export function renderAgentsView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Agents</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Primary agents lead or join squads; sub-agents are background workers that hand results back.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">+ New agent</button>
      </header>
      <form class="card sq-create-card hidden" data-role="create">
        <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Agent kind">
          <label><input type="radio" name="kind" value="agent" checked> Primary agent <span class="text-muted small">library/*.md</span></label>
          <label><input type="radio" name="kind" value="subagent"> Sub-agent <span class="text-muted small">subAgentLibrary/*.yaml</span></label>
        </div>
        <div class="form-row mt-2">
          <input class="form-input" name="agent_id" placeholder="id (e.g. reviewer)" maxlength="64" required>
          <input class="form-input" name="name" placeholder="Display name" maxlength="100">
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <input class="form-input" name="description" placeholder="What it does" maxlength="500">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Create</button>
        </div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="create-error" role="alert"></p>
      </form>
      <div class="sq-toolbar">
        <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Filter by kind">
          ${['all', 'agent', 'subagent'].map(kind => `
            <label><input type="radio" name="filter" value="${kind}" ${kindFilter === kind ? 'checked' : ''}>
              ${kind === 'all' ? 'All' : kind === 'agent' ? 'Primary' : 'Sub-agents'}</label>`).join('')}
        </div>
        <input class="form-input sq-search" type="search" placeholder="Search agents or tools" value="${esc(search)}" aria-label="Search agents">
      </div>
      <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
      <div class="sq-agent-grid" data-role="grid"><p class="text-muted small">Loading agents…</p></div>
    </div>`;

  const grid = container.querySelector('[data-role="grid"]');
  const errorBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
  const createForm = container.querySelector('[data-role="create"]');
  let overview = { agents: [], squads: [], tools: [] };

  function squadsUsing(agentId) {
    return overview.squads.filter(squad =>
      squad.primary_agent === agentId || squad.subagents.includes(agentId));
  }

  function render() {
    const term = search.toLowerCase();
    const shown = overview.agents.filter(agent =>
      (kindFilter === 'all' || agent.kind === kindFilter) &&
      (!term || [agent.id, agent.name, agent.description, ...agent.tools].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(term)));
    grid.innerHTML = shown.map(agent => {
      const squads = squadsUsing(agent.id);
      const available = overview.tools.filter(tool => !agent.tools.includes(tool.name));
      return `
        <article class="card sq-agent-card" data-agent="${esc(agent.id)}">
          <div class="sq-inspector-head">
            <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
            <span class="badge ${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'primary' : 'sub-agent'}</span>
            <span class="badge">${esc(agent.mode)}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || 'No description.')}</p>
          <div class="sq-chip-row">
            ${agent.tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
              <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-detach="${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
              || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
          </div>
          <select class="form-select" data-attach aria-label="Attach a tool to ${esc(agent.name)}">
            <option value="">+ Attach tool…</option>
            ${available.map(tool => `<option value="${esc(tool.name)}">${esc(tool.name)} · ${esc(tool.provider)}</option>`).join('')}
          </select>
          <p class="small text-muted">${squads.length
            ? `In squads: ${squads.map(s => `<button type="button" class="sq-link" data-open-squad="${esc(s.squad_id)}">${esc(s.name)}</button>`).join(', ')}`
            : 'Not in any squad yet.'}</p>
          <div class="sq-inspector-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="edit">Edit prompt</button>
            ${agent.kind === 'agent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="chat">Chat</button>' : ''}
            ${agent.kind === 'subagent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-act="delete">Delete</button>' : ''}
          </div>
        </article>`;
    }).join('') || '<p class="text-muted">No agents match.</p>';
  }

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    render();
  }

  function showError(message) {
    errorBox.textContent = message;
    errorBox.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  async function updateAgent(request) {
    showError('');
    try {
      const updated = await request;
      const index = overview.agents.findIndex(agent => agent.id === updated.id);
      if (index >= 0) overview.agents[index] = updated;
      render();
    } catch (err) {
      showError(err.message);
    }
  }

  container.addEventListener('change', event => {
    if (event.target.name === 'filter') { kindFilter = event.target.value; render(); }
    const card = event.target.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (card && event.target.hasAttribute('data-attach') && event.target.value) {
      updateAgent(Api.attachAgentTool(card.dataset.agent, event.target.value));
    }
  });
  container.querySelector('.sq-search').addEventListener('input', event => {
    search = event.target.value;
    render();
  });

  container.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    if (button.dataset.act === 'toggle-create') { createForm.classList.toggle('hidden'); return; }
    if (button.dataset.openSquad) { navigate('squads', { squadId: button.dataset.openSquad }); return; }
    const card = button.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (!card) return;
    const agent = overview.agents.find(a => a.id === card.dataset.agent);
    if (button.dataset.detach) updateAgent(Api.detachAgentTool(agent.id, button.dataset.detach));
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'edit') openInEditor(agent.path);
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'chat') navigate('chat', agent.id);
    else if (button.dataset.act === 'delete') {
      if (!confirm(`Delete sub-agent "${agent.id}"? Its YAML file will be removed.`)) return;
      try {
        await Api.deleteSubagent(agent.id);
        await load();
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
      }
    }
  });

  createForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(createForm);
    const createError = createForm.querySelector('[data-role="create-error"]');
    createError.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      const id = String(data.get('agent_id')).trim();
      await Api.createSquadMember(data.get('kind'), id, String(data.get('name')).trim() || id, String(data.get('description')).trim());
      createForm.reset();
      createForm.classList.add('hidden');
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      createError.textContent = err.message;
      createError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  });

  load().catch(err => {
    grid.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger">Could not load agents: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/architect_canvas.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squad Architect canvas: draws a squad's lead, members and pattern-specific flow as inline SVG.
 *   sequential  lead → m1 → m2 → … → lead (synthesis)
 *   fanout      lead → every member in parallel → lead
 *   router      lead → route decision → chosen members → lead
 */
import { esc } from '../shell.js';

const NODE_W = 156;
const NODE_H = 58;
const GAP = 28;
const LEAD_Y = 24;
const MEMBER_Y = 210;

function clip(text, max) {
  const value = String(text || '');
  return value.length > max ? `${value.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : value;
}

function nodeSvg(node, x, y, { role, selected }) {
  const tools = node.tools?.length || 0;
  const subtitle = role === 'lead'
    ? `lead · ${tools} tool${tools === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
    : `${node.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'} · ${tools} tool${tools === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
  return `
    <g class="sq-node sq-node-${role === 'lead' ? 'lead' : node.kind}${selected ? ' is-selected' : ''}"
       data-node-id="${esc(node.id)}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${esc(node.name || node.id)} (${esc(subtitle)})">
      <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${NODE_W}" height="${NODE_H}" rx="10"></rect>
      <text class="sq-node-title" x="${x + 12}" y="${y + 24}">${esc(clip(node.name || node.id, 19))}</text>
      <text class="sq-node-sub" x="${x + 12}" y="${y + 43}">${esc(subtitle)}</text>
    </g>`;
}

function edge(x1, y1, x2, y2, cls = '') {
  const midY = (y1 + y2) / 2;
  return `<path class="sq-edge ${cls}" d="M${x1},${y1} C${x1},${midY} ${x2},${midY} ${x2},${y2}" marker-end="url(#sq-arrow)"></path>`;
}

export function renderArchitectCanvas(host, blueprint, { selectedId = null, onSelect = () => {} } = {}) {
  const members = (blueprint.members || []).filter(Boolean);
  const pattern = blueprint.pattern || 'sequential';
  const count = Math.max(members.length, 1);
  const width = Math.max(560, count * NODE_W + (count + 1) * GAP);
  const height = MEMBER_Y + NODE_H + 70;
  const leadX = (width - NODE_W) / 2;
  const leadBottom = LEAD_Y + NODE_H;
  const leadCenter = width / 2;
  const startX = (width - (members.length * NODE_W + (members.length - 1) * GAP)) / 2;
  const memberX = index => startX + index * (NODE_W + GAP);

  const edges = [];
  const extras = [];
  if (members.length) {
    if (pattern === 'sequential') {
      edges.push(edge(leadCenter - 30, leadBottom, memberX(0) + NODE_W / 2, MEMBER_Y));
      members.forEach((_, i) => {
        if (i === members.length - 1) return;
        const y = MEMBER_Y + NODE_H / 2;
        edges.push(`<path class="sq-edge" d="M${memberX(i) + NODE_W},${y} L${memberX(i + 1)},${y}" marker-end="url(#sq-arrow)"></path>`);
      });
      const last = memberX(members.length - 1) + NODE_W / 2;
      edges.push(edge(last, MEMBER_Y, leadCenter + 30, leadBottom, 'sq-edge-return'));
      members.forEach((_, i) => {
        extras.push(`<text class="sq-step" x="${memberX(i) + NODE_W - 16}" y="${MEMBER_Y - 8}">${i + 1}</text>`);
      });
    } else if (pattern === 'fanout') {
      members.forEach((_, i) => {
        const cx = memberX(i) + NODE_W / 2;
        edges.push(edge(leadCenter - 12, leadBottom, cx - 12, MEMBER_Y));
        edges.push(edge(cx + 12, MEMBER_Y, leadCenter + 12, leadBottom, 'sq-edge-return'));
      });
      extras.push(`<text class="sq-pattern-label" x="${leadCenter}" y="${(leadBottom + MEMBER_Y) / 2}">parallel</text>`);
    } else {
      const dy = (leadBottom + MEMBER_Y) / 2;
      extras.push(`<polygon class="sq-router" points="${leadCenter},${dy - 18} ${leadCenter + 26},${dy} ${leadCenter},${dy + 18} ${leadCenter - 26},${dy}"></polygon>`);
      extras.push(`<text class="sq-pattern-label" x="${leadCenter + 34}" y="${dy + 4}" text-anchor="start">route</text>`);
      edges.push(`<path class="sq-edge" d="M${leadCenter},${leadBottom} L${leadCenter},${dy - 18}" marker-end="url(#sq-arrow)"></path>`);
      members.forEach((_, i) => {
        edges.push(edge(leadCenter, dy + 18, memberX(i) + NODE_W / 2, MEMBER_Y, 'sq-edge-optional'));
      });
    }
  }

  host.innerHTML = `
    <svg class="sq-canvas" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="group" aria-label="Squad structure">
      <defs>
        <marker id="sq-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" class="sq-arrow-head"></path>
        </marker>
      </defs>
      ${edges.join('')}
      ${extras.join('')}
      ${blueprint.lead ? nodeSvg(blueprint.lead, leadX, LEAD_Y, { role: 'lead', selected: selectedId === blueprint.lead.id }) : ''}
      ${members.map((m, i) => nodeSvg(m, memberX(i), MEMBER_Y, { role: 'member', selected: selectedId === m.id })).join('')}
      ${members.length ? '' : `<text class="sq-empty" x="${leadCenter}" y="${MEMBER_Y + 30}">No members yet — the lead works alone.</text>`}
    </svg>`;

  const select = target => {
    const node = target.closest('[data-node-id]');
    if (node) onSelect(node.dataset.nodeId);
  };
  host.querySelector('svg').addEventListener('click', event => select(event.target));
  host.querySelector('svg').addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
      event.preventDefault();
      select(event.target);
    }
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/builder_steps.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Step-by-step squad builder: Basics → Lead → Members → Tools → Review & save.
 * Works on a local draft and only writes through the Squad Architect API on save.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate } from '../shell.js';
import { renderArchitectCanvas } from './architect_canvas.js';
import { PATTERN_INFO } from './run_client.js';

const STEPS = ['Basics', 'Lead agent', 'Members', 'Tools', 'Review'];
const LEAD_HANDOFF = 'read_agent_scratchpad';
const MEMBER_HANDOFF = 'write_agent_scratchpad';

function sameList(a = [], b = []) {
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((value, i) => value === b[i]);
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} host
 * @param {{overview: object, initial?: object|null, onSaved: Function, onCancel: Function}} options
 */
export function renderBuilder(host, { overview, initial = null, onSaved, onCancel }) {
  let agents = overview.agents || [];
  const toolCatalog = overview.tools || [];
  const byId = () => Object.fromEntries(agents.map(agent => [agent.id, agent]));

  const draft = {
    squad_id: initial?.squad_id || null,
    name: initial?.name || '',
    description: initial?.description || '',
    pattern: initial?.pattern || 'sequential',
    max_parallel: initial?.max_parallel || 2,
    lead: initial?.lead?.id || '',
    members: (initial?.members || []).filter(Boolean).map(member => member.id),
    tools: {},
    lead_delegates: Boolean(
      initial?.lead?.tools?.includes('call_subagent') && initial?.lead?.allowed_subagents?.length
    )
  };
  const dedicated = Boolean(initial?.dedicated_pipeline);
  let step = 0;
  let validation = null;

  const toolsFor = id => draft.tools[id] ?? [...(byId()[id]?.tools || [])];
  const nodeFor = id => ({ ...byId()[id], tools: toolsFor(id) });

  function payload() {
    const spec = id => {
      const changed = draft.tools[id] && !sameList(draft.tools[id], byId()[id]?.tools || []);
      return changed ? { agent_id: id, tools: draft.tools[id] } : { agent_id: id };
    };
    return {
      squad_id: draft.squad_id,
      name: draft.name.trim(),
      description: draft.description.trim(),
      pattern: draft.pattern,
      max_parallel: Number(draft.max_parallel) || 2,
      lead: spec(draft.lead),
      members: draft.members.map(spec),
      lead_delegates: draft.lead_delegates
    };
  }

  function canAdvance() {
    if (step === 0) return draft.name.trim().length > 0;
    if (step === 1) return Boolean(draft.lead);
    return true;
  }

  function render() {
    host.innerHTML = `
      <div class="sq-builder card">
        <div class="card-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${draft.squad_id ? `Edit squad · ${esc(draft.name)}` : 'New squad'}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">Design who works together, how they interact, and what tools they carry.</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="cancel">Close</button>
        </div>
        <ol class="sq-stepper">
          ${STEPS.map((label, i) => `
            <li class="${i === step ? 'is-current' : i < step ? 'is-done' : ''}">
              <button type="button" data-step="${i}" ${i > step && !canAdvance() ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                <span class="sq-step-num">${i + 1}</span>${esc(label)}
              </button>
            </li>`).join('')}
        </ol>
        <div class="sq-step-body">${stepBody()}</div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="sq-builder-nav">
          <button type="button" class="btn" data-act="back" ${step === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>Back</button>
          <span class="spacer"></span>
          ${step < STEPS.length - 1
            ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="next" ${canAdvance() ? '' : 'disabled'}>Next: ${esc(STEPS[step + 1])}</button>`
            : `<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="save" ${validation?.ok ? '' : 'disabled'}>Save squad</button>`}
        </div>
      </div>`;
    if (step === 4) afterReviewRender();
  }

  function stepBody() {
    if (step === 0) {
      return `
        <label class="sq-field"><span>Squad name</span>
          <input class="form-input" data-field="name" maxlength="80" value="${esc(draft.name)}" placeholder="e.g. Research Squad"></label>
        <label class="sq-field"><span>What does this squad do?</span>
          <input class="form-input" data-field="description" maxlength="500" value="${esc(draft.description)}"></label>
        <div class="sq-field"><span>Interaction pattern</span>
          <div class="sq-choice-grid">
            ${Object.entries(PATTERN_INFO).map(([key, info]) => `
              <label class="sq-choice ${draft.pattern === key ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
                <input type="radio" name="pattern" value="${key}" ${draft.pattern === key ? 'checked' : ''}
                  ${dedicated && key !== 'sequential' ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                <strong>${esc(info.label)}</strong>
                <span class="text-muted small">${esc(info.summary)}</span>
              </label>`).join('')}
          </div>
          ${dedicated ? '<p class="text-muted small">This squad runs its own dedicated pipeline, so it stays sequential.</p>' : ''}
        </div>
        ${draft.pattern === 'fanout' ? `
          <label class="sq-field sq-field-inline"><span>Members running at once</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" min="1" max="4" data-field="max_parallel" value="${esc(draft.max_parallel)}">
            <span class="text-muted small">Keep this low on a local Ollama host.</span></label>` : ''}`;
    }
    if (step === 1) {
      const primaries = agents.filter(agent => agent.kind === 'agent');
      return `
        <p class="text-muted small">The lead is a primary agent. It receives the request, ${draft.pattern === 'router' ? 'decides which members run, ' : ''}and writes the final answer from its members' work.</p>
        <div class="sq-choice-grid">
          ${primaries.map(agent => `
            <label class="sq-choice ${draft.lead === agent.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
              <input type="radio" name="lead" value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${draft.lead === agent.id ? 'checked' : ''}>
              <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
              <span class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || agent.id)}</span>
              <span class="sq-chip-row">${(agent.tools || []).slice(0, 4).map(t => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(t)}</span>`).join('')}</span>
            </label>`).join('') || '<p class="text-muted">No primary agents yet.</p>'}
        </div>
        ${createMemberForm('agent')}`;
    }
    if (step === 2) {
      const candidates = agents.filter(agent => agent.id !== draft.lead);
      const group = (kind, title, hint) => `
        <h4 class="sq-group-title">${title} <span class="text-muted small">${hint}</span></h4>
        <div class="sq-choice-grid">
          ${candidates.filter(agent => agent.kind === kind).map(agent => `
            <label class="sq-choice ${draft.members.includes(agent.id) ? 'is-selected' : ''}">
              <input type="checkbox" name="member" value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${draft.members.includes(agent.id) ? 'checked' : ''}>
              <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
              <span class="text-muted small">${esc(agent.description || agent.id)}</span>
            </label>`).join('') || '<p class="text-muted small">None available.</p>'}
        </div>`;
      return `
        <div class="sq-two-col">
          <div>
            ${group('subagent', 'Sub-agents', 'background workers that hand results to the lead')}
            ${group('agent', 'Primary agents', 'peers that work alongside the lead')}
            ${createMemberForm('subagent')}
          </div>
          <aside class="sq-order card">
            <h4>${draft.pattern === 'sequential' ? 'Run order' : 'Members'}</h4>
            ${draft.members.length ? `<ol class="sq-order-list">
              ${draft.members.map((id, i) => `
                <li><span>${esc(byId()[id]?.name || id)}</span>
                  <span class="sq-order-actions">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-move="${i}:-1" ${i === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="Move up">↑</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-move="${i}:1" ${i === draft.members.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} aria-label="Move down">↓</button>
                  </span></li>`).join('')}
            </ol>` : '<p class="text-muted small">Pick members on the left.</p>'}
            <label class="sq-toggle">
              <input type="checkbox" data-field="lead_delegates" ${draft.lead_delegates ? 'checked' : ''}>
              <span>Lead may also call sub-agent members directly with <code>call_subagent</code> (restricted to this squad)</span>
            </label>
          </aside>
        </div>`;
    }
    if (step === 3) {
      const ids = [draft.lead, ...draft.members];
      return `
        <p class="text-muted small">Tools decide what each agent can do. Assigning tools switches a chat-mode agent to agent mode.
          Need something new? <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="build-tool">Build a tool in the workbench</button></p>
        <div class="sq-tool-table">
          ${ids.map((id, index) => toolRow(id, index === 0)).join('')}
        </div>`;
    }
    return `
      <div class="sq-review">
        <div class="sq-canvas-host" data-role="preview"></div>
        <div class="sq-validation" data-role="validation"><p class="text-muted small">Checking blueprint…</p></div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function toolRow(id, isLead) {
    const tools = toolsFor(id);
    const agent = byId()[id] || { id, name: id, kind: 'agent' };
    const handoff = isLead ? LEAD_HANDOFF : agent.kind === 'subagent' ? MEMBER_HANDOFF : null;
    const missingHandoff = handoff && !tools.includes(handoff);
    const available = toolCatalog.filter(tool => !tools.includes(tool.name));
    return `
      <div class="sq-tool-row">
        <div class="sq-tool-owner">
          <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
          <span class="badge ${isLead ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${isLead ? 'lead' : agent.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sq-chip-row">
          ${tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
            <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-remove-tool="${esc(id)}|${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
            || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
        </div>
        <div class="sq-tool-add">
          <select class="form-select" data-add-tool="${esc(id)}" aria-label="Add a tool to ${esc(agent.name)}">
            <option value="">+ Add tool…</option>
            ${available.map(tool => `<option value="${esc(tool.name)}" title="${esc(tool.description || '')}">${esc(tool.name)} · ${esc(tool.provider)}</option>`).join('')}
          </select>
          ${missingHandoff ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-quick-tool="${esc(id)}|${handoff}">Add ${handoff}</button>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function createMemberForm(defaultKind) {
    return `
      <details class="sq-create">
        <summary>Create a new ${defaultKind === 'agent' ? 'primary agent' : 'agent or sub-agent'}</summary>
        <div class="form-row mt-2">
          <select class="form-select" data-new="kind" aria-label="Kind">
            <option value="subagent" ${defaultKind === 'subagent' ? 'selected' : ''}>Sub-agent (subAgentLibrary/*.yaml)</option>
            <option value="agent" ${defaultKind === 'agent' ? 'selected' : ''}>Primary agent (library/*.md)</option>
          </select>
          <input class="form-input" data-new="id" placeholder="id (e.g. summarizer)" maxlength="64">
          <input class="form-input" data-new="name" placeholder="Display name" maxlength="100">
        </div>
        <div class="form-row">
          <input class="form-input" data-new="description" placeholder="What it does" maxlength="500">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="create-member">Create</button>
        </div>
      </details>`;
  }

  async function afterReviewRender() {
    const preview = host.querySelector('[data-role="preview"]');
    renderArchitectCanvas(preview, {
      pattern: draft.pattern,
      lead: nodeFor(draft.lead),
      members: draft.members.map(nodeFor)
    });
    const box = host.querySelector('[data-role="validation"]');
    try {
      validation = await Api.validateSquadBlueprint(payload());
    } catch (err) {
      validation = { ok: false, errors: [err.message], warnings: [] };
    }
    box.innerHTML = `
      <h4>${validation.ok ? '✓ Ready to save' : 'Fix before saving'}</h4>
      ${validation.errors.map(e => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(e)}</p>`).join('')}
      ${validation.warnings.map(w => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-warn">${esc(w)}</p>`).join('')}
      ${!validation.errors.length && !validation.warnings.length ? '<p class="text-muted small">No issues found.</p>' : ''}
      <p class="text-muted small">Saving registers the squad and writes tool changes into the agents' definition files.</p>`;
    const save = host.querySelector('[data-act="save"]');
    if (save) save.disabled = !validation.ok;
  }

  function showError(message) {
    const box = host.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
    box.textContent = message;
    box.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  function setTools(id, tools) {
    draft.tools[id] = tools;
    validation = null;
    render();
  }

  host.addEventListener('input', event => {
    const field = event.target.dataset.field;
    if (!field) return;
    if (field === 'lead_delegates') draft.lead_delegates = event.target.checked;
    else draft[field] = event.target.value;
    const next = host.querySelector('[data-act="next"]');
    if (next) next.disabled = !canAdvance();
  });

  host.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.name === 'pattern') { draft.pattern = target.value; render(); }
    else if (target.name === 'lead') {
      draft.lead = target.value;
      draft.members = draft.members.filter(id => id !== draft.lead);
      render();
    } else if (target.name === 'member') {
      draft.members = target.checked
        ? [...draft.members, target.value]
        : draft.members.filter(id => id !== target.value);
      render();
    } else if (target.dataset.addTool && target.value) {
      setTools(target.dataset.addTool, [...toolsFor(target.dataset.addTool), target.value]);
    }
  });

  host.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    showError('');
    if (button.dataset.step !== undefined) { step = Number(button.dataset.step); render(); return; }
    if (button.dataset.move) {
      const [index, delta] = button.dataset.move.split(':').map(Number);
      const list = [...draft.members];
      [list[index], list[index + delta]] = [list[index + delta], list[index]];
      draft.members = list;
      render();
      return;
    }
    if (button.dataset.removeTool) {
      const [id, tool] = button.dataset.removeTool.split('|');
      setTools(id, toolsFor(id).filter(name => name !== tool));
      return;
    }
    if (button.dataset.quickTool) {
      const [id, tool] = button.dataset.quickTool.split('|');
      setTools(id, [...toolsFor(id), tool]);
      return;
    }
    const act = button.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'cancel') onCancel();
    else if (act === 'back') { step -= 1; render(); }
    else if (act === 'next' && canAdvance()) { step += 1; render(); }
    else if (act === 'build-tool') navigate('tools');
    else if (act === 'create-member') {
      const form = button.closest('.sq-create');
      const value = key => form.querySelector(`[data-new="${key}"]`).value.trim();
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        const created = await Api.createSquadMember(value('kind'), value('id'), value('name') || value('id'), value('description'));
        agents = (await Api.getSquadsOverview()).agents || agents;
        if (step === 1 && created.kind === 'agent') draft.lead = created.id;
        else if (created.id !== draft.lead && !draft.members.includes(created.id)) draft.members.push(created.id);
        render();
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    } else if (act === 'save') {
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        const saved = await Api.saveSquadBlueprint(payload());
        onSaved(saved.blueprint, saved.warnings || []);
      } catch (err) {
        showError(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  });

  render();
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/run_client.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squad run client: starts an orchestration run and follows its SSE telemetry stream.
 * Shared by the Runs section and anything else that launches a squad.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';

export const PATTERN_INFO = {
  sequential: {
    label: 'Sequential',
    summary: 'Members run one after another, then the lead synthesizes from the scratchpad.'
  },
  fanout: {
    label: 'Fan-out',
    summary: 'Members work on the same task in parallel (bounded), and the lead merges every output.'
  },
  router: {
    label: 'Router',
    summary: 'The lead picks which members should handle the task; only those run.'
  }
};

/**
 * Start a run and stream its events. Resolves once the run is accepted.
 * @returns {Promise<{traceId: string, squadId: string, close: () => void}>}
 */
export async function startSquadRun({
  squadId, query, pattern = null, parameters = {}, onEvent = () => {}, onComplete = () => {}, onClosed = () => {}
}) {
  const started = await Api.startOrchestrationRun(squadId, query, 'all', parameters, pattern);
  const source = new EventSource(`/api/orchestration/stream/${encodeURIComponent(started.trace_id)}`);
  const seen = new Set();
  let finished = false;
  source.addEventListener('telemetry', message => {
    const event = JSON.parse(message.data);
    if (seen.has(event.sequence)) return;
    seen.add(event.sequence);
    onEvent(event);
    if (event.event_type === 'RUN_COMPLETE') {
      finished = true;
      source.close();
      onComplete(started.trace_id, event.data || {});
    }
  });
  source.addEventListener('error', () => {
    if (source.readyState === EventSource.CLOSED && !finished) onClosed();
  });
  return { traceId: started.trace_id, squadId: started.squad_id, close: () => source.close() };
}

/** One readable line per telemetry event; prompts and tool arguments are never in the stream. */
export function describeEvent(event) {
  const detail = event.data || {};
  const text = [
    `${event.sender} → ${event.receiver}`,
    detail.summary || '',
    detail.tool_name ? `tool=${detail.tool_name}` : '',
    detail.status ? `status=${detail.status}` : '',
    detail.duration_ms !== undefined ? `${detail.duration_ms}ms` : '',
    detail.path ? `path=${detail.path}` : '',
    detail.error || ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return {
    time: new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(),
    type: event.event_type,
    text,
    status: detail.status || ''
  };
}

/** Code-change preview carried by an event, if any (the editor can review those lines). */
export function codeChangeFromEvent(event) {
  const detail = event.data || {};
  if (!['CODE_CHANGE_PREVIEW', 'CODE_CHANGE_APPLIED'].includes(event.event_type) || !detail.path) return null;
  return {
    path: detail.path,
    changedLines: Array.isArray(detail.changed_lines) ? detail.changed_lines : [],
    fileExists: detail.file_exists !== false
  };
}

```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/runs_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Runs section: start a squad run (optionally overriding its pattern), follow the live
 * trace, then inspect the final answer, routing / fan-out details, steps and scratchpad.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate } from '../shell.js';
import { appendMarkdown } from '../markdown.js';
import { createAgentMeters, runHealthHtml } from '../agent_meters.js';
import { PATTERN_INFO, codeChangeFromEvent, describeEvent, startSquadRun } from './run_client.js';

let activeRun = null;
const recentRuns = [];
let lastSquadId = null;
let markdownTexts = [];

function markdownSlot(text, className = '') {
  markdownTexts.push(String(text ?? ''));
  return `<div class="sq-md prompt-rich-markdown ${className}" data-md="${markdownTexts.length - 1}"></div>`;
}

export function stopRunStream() {
  activeRun?.close();
  activeRun = null;
}

function stepRows(steps = []) {
  return steps.map(step => `
    <tr class="${step.status === 'ERROR' ? 'is-error' : ''}">
      <td>${step.step_number}</td><td>${esc(step.agent_id)}</td><td>${esc(step.phase)}</td>
      <td>${esc(step.status)}</td><td>${esc(step.error_reason || step.details)}</td>
    </tr>`).join('');
}

function payloadSections(payload) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    return payload == null ? '' : `<h4>Result payload</h4><pre class="sq-pre">${esc(JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2))}</pre>`;
  }
  const parts = [];
  if (payload.routing) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Routing decision</h4>
      <p>Chose <strong>${esc(payload.routing.chosen.join(', '))}</strong>${payload.routing.skipped?.length ? `, skipped ${esc(payload.routing.skipped.join(', '))}` : ''}.</p>
      ${payload.routing.reason ? `<p class="text-muted small">${esc(payload.routing.reason)}</p>` : ''}`);
  }
  const outputs = payload.fanout_results || payload.member_results;
  if (outputs && Object.keys(outputs).length) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Member outputs</h4>${Object.entries(outputs).map(([id, text]) => `
      <details class="sq-output"><summary>${esc(id)}</summary>${markdownSlot(text)}</details>`).join('')}`);
  }
  if (payload.fanout_errors && Object.keys(payload.fanout_errors).length) {
    parts.push(`<h4>Member errors</h4>${Object.entries(payload.fanout_errors).map(([id, error]) =>
      `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(id)}: ${esc(error)}</p>`).join('')}`);
  }
  const rest = payload.routing || payload.fanout_results ? payload.scratchpad_payload : payload;
  if (rest != null) parts.push(`<h4>Scratchpad payload</h4><pre class="sq-pre">${esc(JSON.stringify(rest, null, 2))}</pre>`);
  return parts.join('');
}

export function renderRunsView(container, payload = null) {
  if (payload?.squadId) lastSquadId = payload.squadId;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Runs</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Run a squad on a real request and watch how its agents hand work to each other.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-runs">
        <section class="card sq-run-form">
          <label class="sq-field"><span>Squad</span>
            <select class="form-select" data-role="squad"><option>Loading…</option></select></label>
          <label class="sq-field"><span>Pattern for this run</span>
            <select class="form-select" data-role="pattern"></select></label>
          <label class="sq-field hidden" data-role="parallel-field"><span>Members at once</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" min="1" max="4" value="2" data-role="parallel"></label>
          <p class="text-muted small" data-role="squad-summary"></p>
          <label class="sq-field"><span>Request</span>
            <textarea class="form-input" rows="5" data-role="query" placeholder="Describe the work for this squad"></textarea></label>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="run">▶ Run squad</button>
          <p class="small" data-role="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
          <h4 class="mt-3">This session</h4>
          <ul class="sq-recent" data-role="recent"></ul>
        </section>
        <section class="card sq-trace">
          <div class="card-head">
            <h3>Live trace</h3>
            <span class="text-muted small">Prompts, tool arguments and document text are never streamed.</span>
          </div>
          <div class="agent-meters" data-role="agents"></div>
          <ol class="sq-timeline" data-role="timeline"><li class="text-muted small">Start a run to see its trace.</li></ol>
        </section>
        <section class="card sq-result" data-role="result">
          <h3>Result</h3>
          <p class="text-muted small">The final answer and every hand-off appear here when the run completes.</p>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const squadSelect = container.querySelector('[data-role="squad"]');
  const patternSelect = container.querySelector('[data-role="pattern"]');
  const parallelField = container.querySelector('[data-role="parallel-field"]');
  const parallelInput = container.querySelector('[data-role="parallel"]');
  const summary = container.querySelector('[data-role="squad-summary"]');
  const query = container.querySelector('[data-role="query"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');
  const timeline = container.querySelector('[data-role="timeline"]');
  const meters = createAgentMeters(container.querySelector('[data-role="agents"]'));
  meters.reset();
  const resultBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="result"]');
  const recent = container.querySelector('[data-role="recent"]');
  const runButton = container.querySelector('[data-act="run"]');
  let squads = [];
  let codeChange = null;

  const currentSquad = () => squads.find(squad => squad.squad_id === squadSelect.value);

  function setStatus(text, kind = 'muted') {
    status.textContent = text;
    status.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  function syncSquad() {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    if (!squad) return;
    lastSquadId = squad.squad_id;
    const dedicated = squad.squad_id === 'code-squad';
    patternSelect.innerHTML = `
      <option value="">Squad default · ${esc(PATTERN_INFO[squad.default_pattern]?.label || squad.default_pattern)}</option>
      ${dedicated ? '' : Object.entries(PATTERN_INFO).map(([key, info]) => `<option value="${key}">${esc(info.label)}</option>`).join('')}`;
    parallelInput.value = squad.max_parallel || 2;
    syncPattern();
  }

  function syncPattern() {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    const pattern = patternSelect.value || squad?.default_pattern;
    parallelField.classList.toggle('hidden', pattern !== 'fanout');
    summary.textContent = squad
      ? `${squad.primary_agent} leads ${squad.subagents.join(', ') || 'no members'}. ${PATTERN_INFO[pattern]?.summary || ''}`
      : '';
  }

  function renderRecent() {
    recent.innerHTML = recentRuns.map(run => `
      <li><button type="button" class="sq-link" data-trace="${esc(run.traceId)}">${esc(run.squadName)}</button>
        <span class="badge ${run.status === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : run.status === 'running' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-success'}">${esc(run.status)}</span>
        <span class="text-muted small">${esc(run.pattern)} · ${esc(run.time)}</span></li>`).join('')
      || '<li class="text-muted small">No runs yet.</li>';
  }

  function addTimelineEvent(event) {
    meters.onEvent(event);
    if (timeline.querySelector('.text-muted')) timeline.replaceChildren();
    const line = describeEvent(event);
    const item = document.createElement('li');
    item.className = `sq-event sq-event-${line.type.toLowerCase()}${line.status === 'error' ? ' is-error' : ''}`;
    item.innerHTML = `<span class="sq-event-time">${esc(line.time)}</span>
      <span class="sq-event-type">${esc(line.type.replaceAll('_', ' ').toLowerCase())}</span>
      <span class="sq-event-text">${esc(line.text)}</span>`;
    timeline.appendChild(item);
    while (timeline.children.length > 300) timeline.firstElementChild.remove();
    timeline.scrollTop = timeline.scrollHeight;
    const change = codeChangeFromEvent(event);
    if (change) codeChange = change;
  }

  async function showResult(traceId) {
    resultBox.innerHTML = '<h3>Result</h3><p class="text-muted small">Loading…</p>';
    let result;
    try {
      result = await Api.getOrchestrationRunResult(traceId);
    } catch (err) {
      resultBox.innerHTML = `<h3>Result</h3><p class="text-danger small">${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
      return;
    }
    markdownTexts = [];
    resultBox.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-head">
        <h3>Result</h3>
        <span class="badge ${result.status === 'error' ? 'badge-danger' : 'badge-success'}">${esc(result.status)}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="text-muted small">${esc(PATTERN_INFO[result.pattern]?.label || result.pattern)} · trace ${esc(result.trace_id)}</p>
      ${runHealthHtml(result.agent_stats)}
      <h4>Final answer</h4>
      ${markdownSlot(result.final_answer || '(No final answer returned.)', 'sq-answer')}
      ${payloadSections(result.result_payload)}
      <h4>Execution steps</h4>
      <table class="sq-steps"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Agent</th><th>Phase</th><th>Status</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${stepRows(result.execution_trace)}</tbody></table>
      <div class="sq-inspector-actions mt-2">
        ${result.scratchpad_snapshot && Object.keys(result.scratchpad_snapshot).length
          ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="scratchpad">View scratchpad</button>' : ''}
        ${codeChange?.fileExists && codeChange.changedLines.length
          ? `<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="review">Review ${codeChange.changedLines.length} changed lines · ${esc(codeChange.path)}</button>` : ''}
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="open-squad">Open squad</button>
      </div>
      <pre class="sq-pre hidden" data-role="scratchpad"></pre>`;
    resultBox.dataset.squad = result.squad_id || '';
    resultBox.querySelectorAll('[data-md]').forEach(slot => {
      appendMarkdown(slot, markdownTexts[Number(slot.dataset.md)]);
    });
    resultBox.dataset.trace = traceId;
    meters.setFromStats(result.agent_stats);
  }

  resultBox.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const act = event.target.closest('button')?.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'scratchpad') {
      const box = resultBox.querySelector('[data-role="scratchpad"]');
      try {
        box.textContent = JSON.stringify(await Api.getOrchestrationRunScratchpad(resultBox.dataset.trace), null, 2);
      } catch (err) {
        box.textContent = err.message;
      }
      box.classList.toggle('hidden');
    } else if (act === 'review') {
      navigate('editor', { path: codeChange.path, managedFile: true, previewLines: codeChange.changedLines });
    } else if (act === 'open-squad' && resultBox.dataset.squad) {
      navigate('squads', { squadId: resultBox.dataset.squad });
    }
  });

  recent.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const trace = event.target.closest('[data-trace]')?.dataset.trace;
    if (trace) showResult(trace);
  });
  squadSelect.addEventListener('change', syncSquad);
  patternSelect.addEventListener('change', syncPattern);

  runButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const squad = currentSquad();
    const text = query.value.trim();
    if (!squad) return;
    if (!text) { setStatus('Enter a request first.', 'danger'); query.focus(); return; }
    stopRunStream();
    codeChange = null;
    timeline.replaceChildren();
    meters.reset();
    runButton.disabled = true;
    setStatus('Starting run…');
    const pattern = patternSelect.value || null;
    const parameters = (pattern || squad.default_pattern) === 'fanout'
      ? { max_parallel: Number(parallelInput.value) || 2 } : {};
    const record = {
      squadName: squad.name, pattern: pattern || squad.default_pattern, status: 'running',
      time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), traceId: ''
    };
    try {
      activeRun = await startSquadRun({
        squadId: squad.squad_id,
        query: text,
        pattern,
        parameters,
        onEvent: addTimelineEvent,
        onComplete: async (traceId, detail) => {
          activeRun = null;
          record.status = detail.status === 'error' ? 'error' : 'success';
          renderRecent();
          setStatus(`Run ${detail.status || 'complete'} in ${detail.duration_ms ?? '?'} ms`, detail.status === 'error' ? 'danger' : 'success');
          await showResult(traceId);
        },
        onClosed: () => setStatus('Trace stream closed before completion. Open the run below once it finishes.', 'warning')
      });
      record.traceId = activeRun.traceId;
      recentRuns.unshift(record);
      recentRuns.splice(20);
      renderRecent();
      setStatus(`Running · trace ${activeRun.traceId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(`Could not start run: ${err.message}`, 'danger');
    } finally {
      runButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  renderRecent();
  Api.getOrchestrationSquads().then(data => {
    squads = data.squads || [];
    squadSelect.innerHTML = squads.map(squad =>
      `<option value="${esc(squad.squad_id)}" ${squad.squad_id === lastSquadId ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(squad.name)}</option>`).join('')
      || '<option value="">No squads yet</option>';
    runButton.disabled = !squads.length;
    syncSquad();
  }).catch(err => setStatus(`Could not load squads: ${err.message}`, 'danger'));
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/squads/squads_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Squads home: every registered squad, the Squad Architect canvas for the selected one,
 * and an inspector for the selected agent (tools, delegation, editor and chat shortcuts).
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc, navigate, openInEditor } from '../shell.js';
import { renderArchitectCanvas } from './architect_canvas.js';
import { renderBuilder } from './builder_steps.js';
import { PATTERN_INFO } from './run_client.js';

let selectedSquadId = null;
let selectedNodeId = null;

function healthBadge(status = 'healthy') {
  const cls = status === 'healthy' ? 'badge-success' : status === 'degraded' ? 'badge-warning' : 'badge-danger';
  return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function metricsLine(metrics = {}) {
  return `${metrics.total_runs || 0} runs · ${metrics.successful_runs || 0} ok · ${metrics.failed_runs || 0} failed · avg ${Math.round(metrics.average_duration_ms || 0)} ms`;
}

export function renderSquadsView(container, payload = null) {
  if (payload?.squadId) selectedSquadId = payload.squadId;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Squads</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Put agents together, choose how they interact, give them tools, then run them.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="new">+ New squad</button>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-home">
        <aside class="sq-list" data-role="list" aria-label="Squads"><p class="text-muted small">Loading squads…</p></aside>
        <section class="sq-detail" data-role="detail"></section>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  const list = container.querySelector('[data-role="list"]');
  const detail = container.querySelector('[data-role="detail"]');
  let overview = { squads: [], agents: [], tools: [] };

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    if (!overview.squads.some(squad => squad.squad_id === selectedSquadId)) {
      selectedSquadId = overview.squads[0]?.squad_id || null;
    }
    renderList();
    if (payload?.builder === 'new') openBuilder(null);
    else await renderDetail();
  }

  function renderList() {
    list.innerHTML = overview.squads.map(squad => `
      <button type="button" class="sq-card ${squad.squad_id === selectedSquadId ? 'is-selected' : ''}" data-squad="${esc(squad.squad_id)}">
        <span class="sq-card-head"><strong>${esc(squad.name)}</strong>${healthBadge(squad.metrics?.last_status)}</span>
        <span class="sq-card-flow">
          <span class="badge badge-accent">${esc(PATTERN_INFO[squad.default_pattern]?.label || squad.default_pattern)}</span>
          ${esc(squad.primary_agent)} → ${squad.subagents.length} member${squad.subagents.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </span>
        <span class="text-muted small">${esc(metricsLine(squad.metrics))}</span>
      </button>`).join('') || `
      <div class="sq-empty-state">
        <p>No squads yet.</p>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" data-act="new">Build your first squad</button>
      </div>`;
  }

  async function renderDetail() {
    if (!selectedSquadId) {
      detail.innerHTML = `<div class="card sq-empty-state"><p class="text-muted">Select or create a squad to see its structure.</p></div>`;
      return;
    }
    detail.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">Loading blueprint…</p>';
    let blueprint;
    try {
      blueprint = await Api.getSquadBlueprint(selectedSquadId);
    } catch (err) {
      detail.innerHTML = `<div class="error-panel">Could not load squad: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    const nodes = [blueprint.lead, ...blueprint.members].filter(Boolean);
    if (!nodes.some(node => node.id === selectedNodeId)) selectedNodeId = blueprint.lead?.id || null;
    const missing = blueprint.members.filter(member => !member).length;

    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card sq-architect">
        <div class="sq-architect-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${esc(blueprint.name)}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(blueprint.description || 'No description.')}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="sq-architect-actions">
            <label class="sq-inline-select">
              <span class="small text-muted">Pattern</span>
              <select class="form-select" data-role="pattern" ${blueprint.dedicated_pipeline ? 'disabled' : ''}>
                ${Object.entries(PATTERN_INFO).map(([key, info]) =>
                  `<option value="${key}" ${blueprint.pattern === key ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(info.label)}</option>`).join('')}
              </select>
            </label>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="edit">Edit in builder</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" data-act="run">▶ Run</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-act="delete">Delete</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small sq-pattern-note">${esc(PATTERN_INFO[blueprint.pattern]?.summary || '')}
          ${blueprint.dedicated_pipeline ? ' This squad uses its dedicated Plan → Build → Test → Fix pipeline.' : ''}
          ${missing ? ` <span class="text-danger">${missing} member definition(s) are missing.</span>` : ''}</p>
        <div class="sq-architect-body">
          <div class="sq-canvas-host" data-role="canvas"></div>
          <aside class="sq-inspector" data-role="inspector"></aside>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small">${esc(metricsLine(blueprint.metrics))}</p>
      </div>`;

    const canvas = detail.querySelector('[data-role="canvas"]');
    const draw = () => renderArchitectCanvas(canvas, blueprint, {
      selectedId: selectedNodeId,
      onSelect: id => { selectedNodeId = id; draw(); renderInspector(); }
    });
    const inspector = detail.querySelector('[data-role="inspector"]');

    function renderInspector() {
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      if (!node) { inspector.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted small">Select an agent.</p>'; return; }
      const isLead = node.id === blueprint.lead?.id;
      const available = overview.tools.filter(tool => !node.tools.includes(tool.name));
      inspector.innerHTML = `
        <div class="sq-inspector-head">
          <strong>${esc(node.name)}</strong>
          <span class="badge ${isLead ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${isLead ? 'lead' : node.kind === 'subagent' ? 'sub-agent' : 'agent'}</span>
          <span class="badge">${esc(node.mode)}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-muted small">${esc(node.description || 'No description.')}</p>
        <code class="small">${esc(node.path)}</code>
        <h4>Tools</h4>
        <div class="sq-chip-row">
          ${node.tools.map(tool => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(tool)}
            <button type="button" class="sq-chip-x" data-detach="${esc(tool)}" aria-label="Remove ${esc(tool)}">×</button></span>`).join('')
            || '<span class="text-muted small">No tools</span>'}
        </div>
        <select class="form-select mt-2" data-role="attach" aria-label="Attach a tool">
          <option value="">+ Attach tool…</option>
          ${available.map(tool => `<option value="${esc(tool.name)}">${esc(tool.name)} · ${esc(tool.provider)}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
        ${node.allowed_subagents?.length ? `
          <h4>May call</h4>
          <div class="sq-chip-row">${node.allowed_subagents.map(id => `<span class="sq-chip">${esc(id)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="inspector-error"></p>
        <div class="sq-inspector-actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="open-editor">Edit prompt</button>
          ${node.kind === 'agent' ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="chat">Chat</button>' : ''}
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="tools">Build a tool</button>
        </div>`;

    }

    async function applyToSelected(request) {
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      try {
        Object.assign(node, await request);
        draw();
        renderInspector();
      } catch (err) {
        const error = inspector.querySelector('[data-role="inspector-error"]');
        error.textContent = err.message;
        error.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    }
    inspector.addEventListener('change', event => {
      if (event.target.dataset.role === 'attach' && event.target.value) {
        applyToSelected(Api.attachAgentTool(selectedNodeId, event.target.value));
      }
    });
    inspector.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('button');
      const node = nodes.find(n => n.id === selectedNodeId);
      if (!button || !node) return;
      if (button.dataset.detach) applyToSelected(Api.detachAgentTool(node.id, button.dataset.detach));
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'open-editor') openInEditor(node.path);
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'chat') navigate('chat', node.id);
      else if (button.dataset.act === 'tools') navigate('tools', { attachTo: node.id });
    });

    detail.querySelector('[data-role="pattern"]').addEventListener('change', async event => {
      try {
        await Api.updateSquad(blueprint.squad_id, { default_pattern: event.target.value });
        await load();
      } catch (err) {
        alert(`Could not change pattern: ${err.message}`);
      }
    });
    detail.querySelector('.sq-architect-actions').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const act = event.target.closest('button')?.dataset.act;
      if (act === 'edit') openBuilder(blueprint);
      else if (act === 'run') navigate('runs', { squadId: blueprint.squad_id });
      else if (act === 'delete') {
        if (!confirm(`Delete squad "${blueprint.name}"? Only the registration and its metrics are removed; agent files stay.`)) return;
        try {
          await Api.deleteOrchestrationSquad(blueprint.squad_id);
          selectedSquadId = null;
          await load();
        } catch (err) {
          alert(`Could not delete squad: ${err.message}`);
        }
      }
    });

    draw();
    renderInspector();
  }

  function openBuilder(initial) {
    payload = null;
    const host = document.createElement('div');
    detail.replaceChildren(host);
    renderBuilder(host, {
      overview,
      initial,
      onCancel: () => renderDetail(),
      onSaved: async (blueprint, warnings) => {
        selectedSquadId = blueprint.squad_id;
        selectedNodeId = blueprint.lead?.id || null;
        await load();
        if (warnings.length) {
          detail.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',
            `<div class="sq-msg sq-msg-warn">Saved with notes: ${warnings.map(esc).join(' · ')}</div>`);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  container.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const squadButton = event.target.closest('[data-squad]');
    if (squadButton) {
      selectedSquadId = squadButton.dataset.squad;
      selectedNodeId = null;
      renderList();
      renderDetail();
      return;
    }
    if (event.target.closest('[data-act="new"]')) openBuilder(null);
  });

  load().catch(err => {
    list.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load squads: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```
