## `frontend/static/js/squads/tools_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Tools section: the tool catalog with who uses each tool, attaching tools to agents, and
 * the Tool Workbench (generate → test → promote) for building new ones.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc } from '../shell.js';
import { renderTestingView } from '../testing.js';

export function renderToolsView(container, payload = null) {
  let attachTo = payload?.attachTo || '';
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Tools</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Give agents the abilities they need. Build a new tool below, test it, promote it, then attach it.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div class="sq-msg sq-msg-ok hidden" data-role="promoted" role="status"></div>
      <section class="card">
        <div class="card-head">
          <h3>Tool catalog</h3>
          <input class="form-input sq-search" type="search" placeholder="Filter tools" aria-label="Filter tools">
        </div>
        <p class="small text-danger hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        <div class="sq-tool-catalog" data-role="catalog"><p class="text-muted small">Loading tools…</p></div>
      </section>
      <div data-role="workbench"></div>
    </div>`;

  const catalog = container.querySelector('[data-role="catalog"]');
  const errorBox = container.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
  const promoted = container.querySelector('[data-role="promoted"]');
  let overview = { agents: [], tools: [] };
  let filter = '';

  const agentOptions = (exclude = []) => overview.agents
    .filter(agent => !exclude.includes(agent.id))
    .map(agent => `<option value="${esc(agent.id)}" ${agent.id === attachTo ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(agent.name)} (${agent.kind === 'agent' ? 'primary' : 'sub-agent'})</option>`)
    .join('');

  function render() {
    const term = filter.toLowerCase();
    const tools = overview.tools.filter(tool =>
      !term || `${tool.name} ${tool.provider} ${tool.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(term));
    catalog.innerHTML = tools.map(tool => {
      const users = overview.agents.filter(agent => agent.tools.includes(tool.name));
      const description = Array.isArray(tool.description) ? tool.description.join(' ') : (tool.description || '');
      return `
        <div class="sq-tool-item" data-tool="${esc(tool.name)}">
          <div>
            <strong>${esc(tool.name)}</strong> <span class="badge">${esc(tool.provider)}</span>
            ${tool.custom ? '<span class="badge badge-accent">custom</span>' : ''}
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(description.split('\n')[0] || 'No description.')}</p>
            <code class="small">${esc(tool.signature)}</code>
          </div>
          <div class="sq-tool-users">
            <span class="small text-muted">${users.length ? `Used by ${users.map(u => esc(u.name)).join(', ')}` : 'Not used by any agent'}</span>
            <span class="sq-tool-add">
              <select class="form-select" aria-label="Agent to attach ${esc(tool.name)} to">
                <option value="">Attach to…</option>${agentOptions(users.map(u => u.id))}
              </select>
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-attach>Attach</button>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('') || '<p class="text-muted small">No tools match.</p>';
  }

  async function load() {
    overview = await Api.getSquadsOverview();
    render();
  }

  async function attach(agentId, tool) {
    errorBox.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      const updated = await Api.attachAgentTool(agentId, tool);
      attachTo = agentId;
      await load();
      return updated;
    } catch (err) {
      errorBox.textContent = err.message;
      errorBox.classList.remove('hidden');
      return null;
    }
  }

  container.querySelector('.sq-search').addEventListener('input', event => {
    filter = event.target.value;
    render();
  });
  catalog.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-attach]');
    if (!button) return;
    const row = button.closest('[data-tool]');
    const agentId = row.querySelector('select').value;
    if (agentId) await attach(agentId, row.dataset.tool);
  });

  // A tool promoted in the workbench can be attached straight away.
  container.addEventListener('novous:tool-promoted', async event => {
    const name = event.detail.name;
    await load();
    promoted.classList.remove('hidden');
    promoted.innerHTML = `
      <span><strong>${esc(name)}</strong> is in the tool catalog. Attach it to an agent:</span>
      <select class="form-select" aria-label="Agent for ${esc(name)}"><option value="">Choose agent…</option>${agentOptions()}</select>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Attach</button>`;
    promoted.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const agentId = promoted.querySelector('select').value;
      if (!agentId) return;
      const updated = await attach(agentId, name);
      if (updated) promoted.innerHTML = `<span>Attached <strong>${esc(name)}</strong> to ${esc(updated.name)}.</span>`;
    });
  });

  renderTestingView(container.querySelector('[data-role="workbench"]'));
  load().catch(err => {
    catalog.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load tools: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
  });
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/views/agent_library.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Agent library for the Overview: every agent across environments in one searchable,
 * filterable list, grouped by environment, with chat/open, edit and delete actions.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { iconSvg } from '../icons.js';
import { esc, navigate, refreshAgents } from '../shell.js';

const ENVIRONMENTS = {
  workspace: { label: 'Workspace', open: 'Chat', openTab: 'chat', passId: true },
  'prompt-creation': { label: 'Prompt Creation', open: 'Open', openTab: 'prompt-creation', passId: false },
  codebuilder: { label: 'Code Builder', open: 'Open', openTab: 'codebuilder', passId: false },
};

// Filters survive re-renders of the Overview.
const filters = { text: '', environment: 'all', mode: 'all', sort: 'name' };
const collapsedGroups = new Set();

const SORTS = {
  name: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  tools: (a, b) => (b.tools?.length || 0) - (a.tools?.length || 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  model: (a, b) => String(a.model || '').localeCompare(String(b.model || '')) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
};

async function loadAllAgents() {
  const [workspace, prompt, codebuilder] = await Promise.all([
    Api.getAgents('workspace'),
    Api.getAgents('prompt-creation'),
    Api.getCodeBuilderAgents(),
  ]);
  const tag = (list, environment) => (list.agents || []).map(agent => ({ ...agent, environment }));
  return [...tag(workspace, 'workspace'), ...tag(prompt, 'prompt-creation'), ...tag(codebuilder, 'codebuilder')];
}

function matches(agent) {
  if (filters.environment !== 'all' && agent.environment !== filters.environment) return false;
  if (filters.mode !== 'all' && agent.mode !== filters.mode) return false;
  const term = filters.text.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!term) return true;
  return [agent.name, agent.id, agent.description, agent.model, ...(agent.tools || [])]
    .join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(term);
}

function agentRow(agent) {
  const env = ENVIRONMENTS[agent.environment];
  const tools = agent.tools || [];
  const initials = String(agent.name || agent.id).split(/[\s_-]+/).map(part => part[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `
    <li class="ov-agent" data-agent="${esc(agent.id)}" data-env="${esc(agent.environment)}">
      <span class="ov-avatar ov-avatar-${esc(agent.environment)}" aria-hidden="true">${esc(initials)}</span>
      <div class="ov-agent-main">
        <div class="ov-agent-title">
          <strong>${esc(agent.name)}</strong>
          <code>${esc(agent.id)}</code>
        </div>
        <p>${esc(agent.description || 'No description.')}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-agent-meta">
        <span class="badge ${agent.mode === 'agent' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${esc(agent.mode)}</span>
        <span class="ov-tools" title="${esc(tools.join(', ') || 'No tools')}">${tools.length} tool${tools.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
        <span class="ov-model" title="Model">${esc(agent.model || 'default model')}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-agent-actions">
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-act="open">${iconSvg(env.openTab === 'chat' ? 'send' : 'play')}<span>${env.open}</span></button>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost" data-act="edit" title="Edit prompt" aria-label="Edit ${esc(agent.name)}">${iconSvg('file-code')}</button>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-icon cb-btn-ghost ov-delete" data-act="delete" title="Delete agent" aria-label="Delete ${esc(agent.name)}">${iconSvg('trash-2')}</button>
      </div>
    </li>`;
}

export function renderAgentLibrary(host) {
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="ov-agents-head">
      <div>
        <h3>Agent library <span class="text-muted small" data-role="total"></span></h3>
        <p class="text-muted small">Every agent in this workspace. Search by name, id, description, model or tool.</p>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">${iconSvg('plus')}<span>New agent</span></button>
    </div>
    <form class="ov-create hidden" data-role="create">
      <div class="ov-create-grid">
        <label><span>Id</span><input class="form-input" name="id" placeholder="reviewer" required maxlength="64"></label>
        <label><span>Display name</span><input class="form-input" name="name" placeholder="Code Reviewer" maxlength="100"></label>
        <label class="ov-create-wide"><span>Description</span><input class="form-input" name="description" placeholder="What this agent is for" maxlength="500"></label>
        <label><span>Environment</span>
          <select class="cb-select" name="environment">
            ${Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => `<option value="${key}">${env.label}</option>`).join('')}
          </select></label>
        <label><span>Mode</span>
          <select class="cb-select" name="mode"><option value="chat">chat</option><option value="agent">agent (uses tools)</option></select></label>
        <label class="ov-create-wide"><span>Custom environment name <em class="text-muted">(optional)</em></span>
          <input class="form-input" name="environment_name" maxlength="64"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="ov-create-actions">
        <p class="small text-danger" data-role="create-error" role="alert"></p>
        <button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-ghost" data-act="toggle-create">Cancel</button>
        <button type="submit" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary">Create agent</button>
      </div>
    </form>
    <div class="ov-toolbar">
      <label class="ov-search">
        ${iconSvg('search')}
        <input type="search" class="form-input" placeholder="Search agents…  ( / )" value="${esc(filters.text)}" aria-label="Search agents">
      </label>
      <div class="sq-segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Environment" data-role="envs"></div>
      <select class="cb-select" data-role="mode" aria-label="Mode">
        <option value="all">Any mode</option><option value="agent">Agent mode</option><option value="chat">Chat mode</option>
      </select>
      <select class="cb-select" data-role="sort" aria-label="Sort">
        <option value="name">Sort: name</option><option value="tools">Sort: most tools</option><option value="model">Sort: model</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="ov-groups" data-role="groups"><p class="text-muted small">Loading agents…</p></div>`;

  const groupsBox = host.querySelector('[data-role="groups"]');
  const envBox = host.querySelector('[data-role="envs"]');
  const search = host.querySelector('input[type="search"]');
  const createForm = host.querySelector('[data-role="create"]');
  host.querySelector('[data-role="mode"]').value = filters.mode;
  host.querySelector('[data-role="sort"]').value = filters.sort;
  let agents = [];

  function render() {
    const counts = agents.reduce((acc, agent) => ({ ...acc, [agent.environment]: (acc[agent.environment] || 0) + 1 }), {});
    host.querySelector('[data-role="total"]').textContent = `· ${agents.length}`;
    envBox.innerHTML = [['all', 'All', agents.length], ...Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => [key, env.label, counts[key] || 0])]
      .map(([key, label, count]) => `
        <label><input type="radio" name="ov-env" value="${key}" ${filters.environment === key ? 'checked' : ''}>
          ${esc(label)} <span class="ov-count">${count}</span></label>`).join('');

    const shown = agents.filter(matches).sort(SORTS[filters.sort]);
    if (!shown.length) {
      groupsBox.innerHTML = agents.length
        ? `<div class="ov-empty"><p>No agents match these filters.</p><button type="button" class="cb-btn" data-act="clear-filters">Clear filters</button></div>`
        : `<div class="ov-empty"><p>No agents yet.</p><button type="button" class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" data-act="toggle-create">Create the first one</button></div>`;
      return;
    }
    groupsBox.innerHTML = Object.entries(ENVIRONMENTS).map(([key, env]) => {
      const items = shown.filter(agent => agent.environment === key);
      if (!items.length) return '';
      return `
        <details class="ov-group" data-group="${key}" ${collapsedGroups.has(key) ? '' : 'open'}>
          <summary><span>${esc(env.label)}</span><span class="ov-count">${items.length}</span></summary>
          <ul class="ov-agent-list">${items.map(agentRow).join('')}</ul>
        </details>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  async function load() {
    try {
      agents = await loadAllAgents();
      render();
    } catch (err) {
      groupsBox.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger small">Could not load agents: ${esc(err.message)}</p>`;
    }
  }

  search.addEventListener('input', () => { filters.text = search.value; render(); });
  host.addEventListener('change', event => {
    const target = event.target;
    if (target.name === 'ov-env') filters.environment = target.value;
    else if (target.dataset.role === 'mode') filters.mode = target.value;
    else if (target.dataset.role === 'sort') filters.sort = target.value;
    else return;
    render();
  });
  host.addEventListener('toggle', event => {
    const group = event.target.closest?.('[data-group]');
    if (!group) return;
    if (group.open) collapsedGroups.delete(group.dataset.group);
    else collapsedGroups.add(group.dataset.group);
  }, true);

  // "/" jumps to search, like most list UIs.
  const onKey = event => {
    if (!host.isConnected) { document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); return; }
    if (event.key === '/' && !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement?.tagName || '')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      search.focus();
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);

  host.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button');
    if (!button) return;
    const act = button.dataset.act;
    if (act === 'toggle-create') {
      createForm.classList.toggle('hidden');
      if (!createForm.classList.contains('hidden')) createForm.querySelector('[name="id"]').focus();
      return;
    }
    if (act === 'clear-filters') {
      Object.assign(filters, { text: '', environment: 'all', mode: 'all' });
      search.value = '';
      host.querySelector('[data-role="mode"]').value = 'all';
      render();
      return;
    }
    const row = button.closest('[data-agent]');
    if (!row) return;
    const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === row.dataset.agent && a.environment === row.dataset.env);
    const env = ENVIRONMENTS[agent.environment];
    if (act === 'open') navigate(env.openTab, env.passId ? agent.id : null);
    else if (act === 'edit') navigate('editor', agent.path || `library/${agent.id}.md`);
    else if (act === 'delete') {
      if (!confirm(`Delete ${env.label} agent "${agent.name}"? Its definition file will be removed.`)) return;
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        await Api.deleteAgent(agent.id, agent.environment);
        await refreshAgents();
        await load();
      } catch (err) {
        alert(err.message);
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }
  });

  createForm.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const data = new FormData(createForm);
    const errorBox = createForm.querySelector('[data-role="create-error"]');
    errorBox.textContent = '';
    const id = String(data.get('id')).trim();
    try {
      await Api.createAgent(id, String(data.get('name')).trim() || id, String(data.get('description')).trim(),
        data.get('mode'), '', data.get('environment'), String(data.get('environment_name')).trim());
      createForm.reset();
      createForm.classList.add('hidden');
      filters.text = '';
      search.value = '';
      await refreshAgents();
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      errorBox.textContent = err.message;
    }
  });

  load();
}
```

## `frontend/static/js/views/models_view.js`
```javascript
/**
 * Models section: the context window and tool limit each installed model runs with.
 * Suggested values follow the model's size; saving a profile overrides them. Changes apply to
 * the next message, and the chat keeps its history.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { esc } from '../shell.js';

export function renderModelsView(container) {
  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="sq-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Models</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Context window and tool limit for each installed model. Smaller models do best with a smaller window and fewer tools.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn" data-act="refresh">Refresh</button>
      </header>
      <p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error hidden" data-role="status" role="alert"></p>
      <div class="model-profile-list" data-role="list"><p class="text-muted">Loading models…</p></div>
    </div>`;

  const list = container.querySelector('[data-role="list"]');
  const status = container.querySelector('[data-role="status"]');

  function showStatus(message) {
    status.textContent = message;
    status.classList.toggle('hidden', !message);
  }

  function modelCard(model) {
    const size = model.parameter_size || (model.size_b ? `${model.size_b}B` : 'size unknown');
    const native = model.native_context || 131072;
    const suggested = model.suggested;
    const capabilities = model.capabilities.map(c => `<span class="badge">${esc(c)}</span>`).join(' ');
    const notes = [];
    if (!model.available) notes.push('Ollama could not describe this model, so suggested values are used.');
    if (model.capabilities.length && !model.capabilities.includes('tools')) {
      notes.push('This model does not list tool support, so tool calls may fail.');
    }
    return `
      <article class="card model-profile-card" data-model="${esc(model.model)}">
        <div class="model-profile-head">
          <div>
            <h3>${esc(model.model)}</h3>
            <p class="text-muted small">${esc(size)} · model maximum ${model.native_context ? `${model.native_context} tokens` : 'unknown'}</p>
          </div>
          <span class="badge ${model.source === 'saved' ? 'badge-accent' : ''}">${model.source === 'saved' ? 'Saved' : 'Suggested'}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="model-profile-caps">${capabilities}</p>
        ${notes.map(note => `<p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error">${esc(note)}</p>`).join('')}
        <form class="model-profile-form" data-role="form">
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Context window (tokens)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="num_ctx" min="2048" max="${native}" step="256"
                   value="${model.num_ctx}" required>
          </label>
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Reply reserve (tokens)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="reply_reserve" min="256" step="128"
                   value="${model.reply_reserve}" required>
          </label>
          <label class="sq-field">
            <span>Tools sent (blank = all)</span>
            <input class="form-input" type="number" name="max_tools" min="0" max="64"
                   value="${model.max_tools ?? ''}" placeholder="all">
          </label>
          <div class="model-profile-actions">
            <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Save</button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" data-act="reset" ${model.source === 'suggested' ? 'disabled' : ''}>Reset to suggested</button>
            <span class="text-muted small">Suggested: ${suggested.num_ctx} tokens, ${suggested.max_tools ?? 'all'} tools</span>
          </div>
          <p class="sq-msg sq-msg-error hidden" data-role="error" role="alert"></p>
        </form>
      </article>`;
  }

  async function load() {
    showStatus('');
    try {
      const data = await Api.getModelProfiles();
      if (data.error) showStatus(data.error);
      list.innerHTML = data.models.length
        ? data.models.map(modelCard).join('')
        : '<p class="text-muted">No installed models found. Pull a model in Ollama, then refresh.</p>';
    } catch (err) {
      list.innerHTML = '';
      showStatus(`Could not load models: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  container.querySelector('[data-act="refresh"]').addEventListener('click', load);

  list.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.target.closest('[data-role="form"]');
    const card = form.closest('[data-model]');
    const error = form.querySelector('[data-role="error"]');
    const data = new FormData(form);
    const maxTools = String(data.get('max_tools') ?? '').trim();
    error.classList.add('hidden');
    try {
      await Api.saveModelProfile(card.dataset.model, {
        num_ctx: Number(data.get('num_ctx')),
        reply_reserve: Number(data.get('reply_reserve')),
        max_tools: maxTools === '' ? null : Number(maxTools)
      });
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      error.textContent = err.message;
      error.classList.remove('hidden');
    }
  });

  list.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-act="reset"]');
    if (!button) return;
    const card = button.closest('[data-model]');
    try {
      await Api.resetModelProfile(card.dataset.model);
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(`Could not reset ${card.dataset.model}: ${err.message}`);
    }
  });

  load();
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Overview: the agent library (every agent, searchable and grouped), the workspace tree,
 * squad folders, workspace folders and knowledge sources.
 */
import { Api } from '../api.js';
import { renderTree } from '../tree.js';
import { ragWarningNodes } from '../rag_warnings.js';
import { AppState, esc, navigate, refreshProject } from '../shell.js';
import { renderAgentLibrary } from './agent_library.js';

export function renderWorkspaceView(container) {
  const project = AppState.project || {};
  const squads = project.squads || [];

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="ov-page">
      <header class="sq-page-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Overview</h2>
          <p class="text-muted">Agents, files and knowledge sources in this workspace.</p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div class="ov-layout">
        <section class="card ov-agents" data-role="agent-library" aria-label="Agent library"></section>

        <aside class="ov-side">
          <section class="card dash-tree-card">
            <div class="card-head">
              <div>
                <h3>Workspace tree</h3>
                <p class="text-muted small">Pick a workspace folder; click a file to open it in the editor.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="dash-tree" class="tree-pane tree-pane-sm"></div>
          </section>

          <section class="card dash-squad-card">
            <div class="card-head">
              <h3>Squad folders</h3>
              <button class="cb-btn" id="dash-new-squad">New folder</button>
            </div>
            <div class="form-row">
              <input id="sq-name" class="form-input hidden" placeholder="squad folder name">
              <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary hidden" id="dash-create-squad">Create</button>
            </div>
            <ul class="squad-list" id="dash-squad-list">
              ${squads.map(s => `<li class="squad-item"><strong>${esc(s.name)}</strong>
                <span class="text-muted">${esc(s.description || s.path)}</span>
                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-ghost" data-squad-delete="${esc(s.name)}" aria-label="Delete ${esc(s.name)}">✕</button></li>`).join('')
                || '<li class="text-muted small">No squad folders yet.</li>'}
            </ul>
            <p class="text-muted small mt-2">Agent squads, patterns and runs live in
              <button type="button" class="sq-link" data-goto="squads">Squads</button>.</p>
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div class="ov-settings">
        <section class="card root-management">
          <h3>Workspace folders</h3>
          <p class="text-muted small">Folders offered in the Workspace picker. Paste one absolute path per line.</p>
          <ul class="root-path-list" id="dash-root-list" aria-label="Configured Workspace folders"></ul>
          <label class="small" for="dash-root-paths">Folder paths</label>
          <textarea id="dash-root-paths" class="form-input root-path-input" rows="3"
            placeholder="E:\\Novous_notes&#10;E:\\Projects"></textarea>
          <div class="root-management-actions">
            <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" type="button" data-root-action="add">Add folders</button>
            <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" data-root-action="remove">Remove folders</button>
          </div>
          <p class="small" id="dash-root-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </section>

        <section class="card root-management">
          <h3>Knowledge sources</h3>
          <p class="text-muted small">Each named source links one folder to its own index. Deleting a branch removes its saved index, never the folder or its files.</p>
          <ul class="root-path-list rag-base-list" id="dash-rag-bases" aria-label="Saved knowledge sources"></ul>
          <div class="root-management-actions">
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-rag-action="read">Index selected source</button>
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-rag-action="pause">Pause</button>
            <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" data-rag-action="stop">Stop indexing</button>
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-rag-action="resume">Resume</button>
            <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" data-rag-action="clear">Clear selected index</button>
          </div>
          <p class="small" id="dash-rag-job" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading indexing status…</p>
          <div class="root-management-actions" id="dash-rag-error-actions" hidden>
            <span class="small" id="dash-rag-error-question"></span>
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-rag-action="error-retry">Retry this file</button>
            <button class="cb-btn" type="button" data-rag-action="error-skip">Skip this file</button>
            <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-danger" type="button" data-rag-action="error-skip-all">Skip all remaining errors</button>
          </div>
          <p class="small" id="dash-rag-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
          <details class="ov-add-source">
            <summary>Add a knowledge source</summary>
            <label class="small" for="dash-rag-name">Source name</label>
            <input id="dash-rag-name" class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Business decisions">
            <label class="small" for="dash-rag-path">Folder to search</label>
            <textarea id="dash-rag-path" class="form-input root-path-input" rows="2"
              placeholder="E:\\BUSN410\\Critical Thinking Strategies\\week 1"></textarea>
            <div class="root-management-actions">
              <button class="cb-btn cb-btn-primary" type="button" data-rag-action="add">Save knowledge source</button>
            </div>
          </details>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  renderAgentLibrary(container.querySelector('[data-role="agent-library"]'));

  container.querySelector('#dash-new-squad').onclick = () => {
    container.querySelector('#sq-name').classList.toggle('hidden');
    container.querySelector('#dash-create-squad').classList.toggle('hidden');
  };
  container.querySelector('#dash-create-squad').onclick = async () => {
    const input = container.querySelector('#sq-name');
    try {
      await Api.createSquad(input.value.trim());
      await refreshProject();
      renderWorkspaceView(container);
    } catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
  };
  container.querySelector('#dash-squad-list').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
    const name = e.target.dataset.squadDelete;
    if (!name) return;
    if (!confirm(`Delete squad "${name}"?`)) return;
    try { await Api.deleteSquad(name); await refreshProject(); renderWorkspaceView(container); }
    catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
  });

  container.querySelector('[data-goto="squads"]').addEventListener('click', () => navigate('squads'));

  const dashboardTree = renderTree(container.querySelector('#dash-tree'), {
    manageRoots: true,
    onSelect: path => navigate('editor', { path, managedFile: true })
  });

  const rootPathInput = container.querySelector('#dash-root-paths');
  const rootStatus = container.querySelector('#dash-root-status');
  const rootList = container.querySelector('#dash-root-list');
  const rootActionButtons = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-root-action]')];
  async function refreshConfiguredRoots() {
    const config = await Api.getFileManagerRoots();
    const rootItem = (root, missing) => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      const name = document.createElement('strong');
      const path = document.createElement('code');
      name.textContent = root.name;
      path.textContent = root.path;
      item.append(name, path);
      if (missing) {
        // A folder that no longer exists on disk: flag it and offer a one-click removal.
        item.classList.add('root-missing');
        const badge = document.createElement('span');
        badge.className = 'badge badge-danger';
        badge.textContent = 'missing';
        const remove = document.createElement('button');
        remove.type = 'button';
        remove.className = 'cb-btn cb-btn-danger';
        remove.textContent = 'Remove';
        remove.dataset.removeRoot = root.path;
        item.append(badge, remove);
      }
      return item;
    };
    rootList.replaceChildren(
      ...config.roots.map(root => rootItem(root, false)),
      ...(config.missing || []).map(root => rootItem(root, true)),
    );
  }
  rootList.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const path = event.target.dataset.removeRoot;
    if (!path) return;
    event.target.disabled = true;
    try {
      await Api.manageFileManagerRoots('remove', [path]);
      rootStatus.textContent = `Removed missing folder ${path}.`;
      rootStatus.className = 'small text-success';
      await refreshConfiguredRoots();
      await dashboardTree.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      rootStatus.textContent = `Could not update Workspace folders: ${err.message}`;
      rootStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
      event.target.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  refreshConfiguredRoots().catch(err => {
    rootStatus.textContent = `Could not load Workspace folders: ${err.message}`;
    rootStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
  });
  rootActionButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const paths = rootPathInput.value.split(/\r?\n/).map(path => path.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (!paths.length) {
        rootStatus.textContent = 'Paste at least one absolute folder path.';
        rootStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
        rootPathInput.focus();
        return;
      }
      rootActionButtons.forEach(actionButton => { actionButton.disabled = true; });
      rootStatus.textContent = 'Updating Workspace folders…';
      rootStatus.className = 'small text-muted';
      try {
        const result = await Api.manageFileManagerRoots(button.dataset.rootAction, paths);
        const changed = button.dataset.rootAction === 'add' ? result.added : result.removed;
        rootStatus.textContent = `${button.dataset.rootAction === 'add' ? 'Added' : 'Removed'} ${changed.length} folder(s).`;
        rootStatus.className = 'small text-success';
        await refreshConfiguredRoots();
        await dashboardTree.reload();
      } catch (err) {
        rootStatus.textContent = `Could not update Workspace folders: ${err.message}`;
        rootStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
      } finally {
        rootActionButtons.forEach(actionButton => { actionButton.disabled = false; });
      }
    });
  });

  const ragPathInput = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-path');
  const ragNameInput = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-name');
  const ragStatus = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-status');
  const ragJobStatus = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-job');
  const ragBaseList = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-bases');
  const ragButtons = [...container.querySelectorAll('[data-rag-action]')];
  let ragBases = [];
  let selectedRagBaseId = null;

  function showRagStatus(message, kind = 'muted') {
    ragStatus.textContent = message;
    ragStatus.className = `small text-${kind}`;
  }

  function describeRag(status) {
    return `${status.documents} document(s), ${status.chunks} chunk(s).`;
  }

  function renderRagBases() {
    ragBaseList.replaceChildren();
    ragBases.forEach(base => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      item.className = 'rag-base-item';
      item.dataset.baseId = base.id;
      const heading = document.createElement('strong');
      heading.textContent = `${base.name}${base.active ? '' : ' (archived)'}`;
      const path = document.createElement('button');
      path.type = 'button';
      path.className = 'rag-folder-link';
      path.setAttribute('aria-label', `Open folder in File Explorer: ${base.path}`);
      path.title = base.path;
      const pathCode = document.createElement('code');
      pathCode.textContent = base.path;
      path.appendChild(pathCode);
      path.disabled = !base.exists;
      path.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          await Api.openRagBaseFolder(base.id);
          showRagStatus(`Opened folder for "${base.name}" in File Explorer.`, 'success');
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not open folder: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      const detail = document.createElement('span');
      detail.className = 'small text-muted';
      detail.textContent = `${base.selected ? 'Selected · ' : ''}${base.exists ? 'Folder available' : 'Folder unavailable'}${base.cloud_provider ? ` · ${base.cloud_provider}` : ''} · ${base.documents} document(s) · ${base.chunks} chunks`;
      const actions = document.createElement('div');
      actions.className = 'root-management-actions';
      const select = document.createElement('button');
      select.type = 'button';
      select.className = 'btn btn-sm';
      select.textContent = base.selected ? 'Selected source' : 'Select source';
      select.disabled = base.selected || !base.active;
      select.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          await Api.selectRagBase(base.id);
          selectedRagBaseId = base.id;
          await loadRagBases();
          showRagStatus(`Selected "${base.name}".`, 'success');
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not select source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      actions.appendChild(select);

      const rename = document.createElement('button');
      rename.type = 'button';
      rename.className = 'btn btn-sm';
      rename.textContent = 'Rename';
      rename.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const name = prompt('New knowledge source name:', base.name);
        if (name === null || !name.trim()) return;
        try {
          await Api.renameRagBase(base.id, name);
          await loadRagBases();
          showRagStatus(`Renamed source to "${name.trim()}".`, 'success');
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not rename source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      actions.appendChild(rename);

      const archive = document.createElement('button');
      archive.type = 'button';
      archive.className = base.active ? 'btn btn-sm btn-danger' : 'btn btn-sm';
      archive.textContent = base.active ? 'Archive source (keep saved)' : 'Restore source';
      archive.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          if (base.active) {
            if (!confirm(`Archive "${base.name}"? Its name, folder, and index will be kept.`)) return;
            await Api.archiveRagBase(base.id);
            showRagStatus(`Archived "${base.name}". Its folder and index are still saved.`, 'success');
          } else {
            await Api.restoreRagBase(base.id);
            selectedRagBaseId = base.id;
            showRagStatus(`Restored "${base.name}" with its saved folder and index.`, 'success');
          }
          await loadRagBases();
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not update source: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      actions.appendChild(archive);

      const remove = document.createElement('button');
      remove.type = 'button';
      remove.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
      remove.textContent = 'Delete branch';
      remove.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        if (!confirm(`Delete "${base.name}" and its indexed documents/vectors? The saved branch will be removed, but the folder and its files will NOT be deleted.`)) return;
        try {
          const result = await Api.deleteRagBase(base.id);
          await loadRagBases();
          showRagStatus(`Deleted "${result.name}" and ${result.documents_removed} indexed document(s). Folder files were left untouched.`, 'success');
        } catch (error) {
          showRagStatus(`Could not delete branch: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
        }
      });
      remove.dataset.ragDelete = 'true';
      remove.disabled = AppState.ragScanJob?.base_id === base.id &&
        ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'stopping', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(AppState.ragScanJob.status);
      actions.appendChild(remove);
      item.append(heading, path, detail, ...ragWarningNodes(base.warnings), actions);
      if (base.selected) item.classList.add('rag-base-selected');
      ragBaseList.appendChild(item);
    });
    if (!ragBases.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('li');
      empty.className = 'text-muted small';
      empty.textContent = 'No saved knowledge sources yet.';
      ragBaseList.appendChild(empty);
    }
  }

  async function loadRagBases() {
    const response = await Api.getRagBases();
    ragBases = response.bases || [];
    const current = ragBases.find(base => base.selected && base.active);
    selectedRagBaseId = current?.id || ragBases.find(base => base.active)?.id || null;
    renderRagBases();
    const selected = ragBases.find(base => base.id === selectedRagBaseId);
    if (selected) {
      showRagStatus(`Selected source: ${selected.name} — ${selected.path}${selected.exists ? '' : ' (folder unavailable)'}` +
        (selected.cloud_provider ? ` · ${selected.cloud_provider} folder: online-only files are downloaded before indexing` : ''));
    } else {
      showRagStatus('No knowledge sources yet. Save a named source to create the first branch.');
    }
  }

  function renderRagJob(job) {
    AppState.ragScanJob = job;
    const base = ragBases.find(entry => entry.id === job.base_id);
    const baseName = job.base_name || base?.name || 'Knowledge source';
    const progress = `${job.completed || 0}/${job.discovered || 0} file(s) checked · ` +
      `${job.indexed || 0} indexed · ${job.unchanged || 0} unchanged · ` +
      `${job.skipped?.length || 0} skipped · ${job.errors?.length || 0} errors`;
    const current = job.current ? ` — ${job.current}${job.phase ? ` (${job.phase})` : ''}` : '';
    const firstError = job.errors?.[0];
    const errors = job.errors?.length
      ? `; ${job.errors.length} error(s), e.g. ${firstError.path || ''} — ${firstError.error || 'see server log'}`
      : '';
    const pending = job.pending_error
      ? `File needs your choice: ${job.pending_error.path} — ${job.pending_error.error}`
      : '';
    const schedule = job.resume_at
      ? `; scheduled resume ${new Date(job.resume_at).toLocaleString()}`
      : '';
    const warning = job.warnings?.length ? ` ⚠ ${job.warnings.map(item => item.message).join(' ')}` : '';
    const state = {
      queued: 'Starting',
      running: 'Indexing',
      pausing: 'Pausing after current file',
      stopping: 'Stopping after current file',
      stopped: 'Stopped',
      awaiting_decision: 'Waiting for your choice',
      paused: 'Paused',
      completed: 'Complete',
      completed_with_skips: 'Complete (files skipped by choice)',
      completed_with_errors: 'Complete with errors',
      unavailable: 'Folder unavailable'
    }[job.status] || job.status;
    ragJobStatus.textContent = job.status === 'idle'
      ? 'Index status: Waiting to start.'
      : `${baseName}: ${state} — ${progress}${pending ? ` — ${pending}` : errors}${schedule}${current}${warning}`;
    ragJobStatus.className = `small ${
      warning && ['completed', 'completed_with_skips'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
      : ['completed', 'completed_with_skips', 'running', 'queued'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-success'
        : ['paused', 'pausing', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-warning'
          : ['failed', 'completed_with_errors', 'unavailable'].includes(job.status) ? 'text-danger'
            : 'text-muted'
    }`;
    const active = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'stopping'].includes(job.status);
    const blocksMutation = ['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'stopping', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
    const selectedJob = !job.base_id || job.base_id === selectedRagBaseId;
    container.querySelector('[data-rag-action="read"]').disabled = active;
    container.querySelector('[data-rag-action="pause"]').disabled = !active || job.status === 'pausing';
    container.querySelector('[data-rag-action="stop"]').disabled =
      !['queued', 'running', 'pausing', 'paused', 'awaiting_decision'].includes(job.status);
    container.querySelector('[data-rag-action="resume"]').disabled =
      !selectedJob || !['paused', 'unavailable', 'failed'].includes(job.status);
    container.querySelector('[data-rag-action="clear"]').disabled =
      !selectedRagBaseId || blocksMutation;
    const errorActions = container.querySelector('#dash-rag-error-actions');
    errorActions.hidden = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
    container.querySelector('#dash-rag-error-question').textContent = job.pending_error
      ? `Retry this file, skip only it (ask again next time), or skip all remaining errors?`
      : '';
    errorActions.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => {
      button.disabled = job.status !== 'awaiting_decision';
    });
    ragBaseList.querySelectorAll('.rag-base-item').forEach(item => {
      const button = item.querySelector('[data-rag-delete]');
      if (button) {
        button.disabled = blocksMutation && job.status !== 'paused' &&
          job.base_id === item.dataset.baseId;
      }
    });
  }

  async function refreshRagJob() {
    try {
      renderRagJob(await Api.getRagScan());
    } catch (error) {
      ragJobStatus.textContent = `Could not load indexing status: ${error.message}`;
      ragJobStatus.className = 'small text-danger';
    }
  }

  loadRagBases().then(refreshRagJob).catch(error => {
    showRagStatus(`Could not load RAG settings: ${error.message}`, 'danger');
  });

  ragButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const action = button.dataset.ragAction;
      // Saving a new source is the one action that needs no existing selection.
      if (action !== 'add' && !selectedRagBaseId) {
        showRagStatus('Save or select a knowledge source first.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      const base = ragBases.find(item => item.id === selectedRagBaseId);
      if (action === 'clear' &&
          !confirm(`Clear only the saved index for "${base?.name}"? The saved name, folder, and files will remain.`)) return;
      if (['read', 'pause', 'stop', 'resume', 'clear', 'error-retry', 'error-skip', 'error-skip-all'].includes(action)) {
        button.disabled = true;
      }
      try {
        if (action === 'add') {
          const name = ragNameInput.value.trim();
          const path = ragPathInput.value.trim();
          if (!name || !path) {
            showRagStatus('Enter a source name and the complete folder path.', 'warning');
            return;
          }
          const added = await Api.addRagBase(name, path);
          ragNameInput.value = '';
          ragPathInput.value = '';
          selectedRagBaseId = added.id;
          await loadRagBases();
          showRagStatus(`Saved source "${added.name}" for ${added.path}.`, 'success');
        } else if (action === 'read') {
          const job = await Api.reindexRag(selectedRagBaseId);
          renderRagJob(job);
          if (job.status === 'paused') {
            showRagStatus(
              `The previous scan for "${base?.name}" is still paused. Resume it to retry unfinished files.`,
              'warning'
            );
          } else if (['queued', 'running'].includes(job.status)) {
            showRagStatus(`Indexing started for "${base?.name}".`, 'success');
          } else {
            showRagStatus(`The scan was not started (status: ${job.status}).`, 'warning');
          }
        } else if (action === 'pause') {
          renderRagJob(await Api.pauseRagScan());
          showRagStatus('Indexing paused after the current file finishes.', 'success');
        } else if (action === 'stop') {
          renderRagJob(await Api.stopRagScan());
          showRagStatus('Stopping indexing after the current file finishes. You can delete the branch when its status is Stopped.', 'success');
        } else if (action === 'resume') {
          renderRagJob(await Api.resumeRagScan());
          showRagStatus('Indexing resumed.', 'success');
        } else if (action.startsWith('error-')) {
          const decision = {
            'error-retry': 'retry',
            'error-skip': 'skip',
            'error-skip-all': 'skip_all'
          }[action];
          renderRagJob(await Api.decideRagScanError(decision));
          showRagStatus(
            decision === 'retry' ? 'Retrying the failed file.'
              : decision === 'skip' ? 'Skipped this file; Novous will ask again if another file fails.'
                : 'Skipping all remaining file errors automatically.',
            'success'
          );
        } else if (action === 'clear') {
          const result = await Api.clearRagIndex(selectedRagBaseId);
          await loadRagBases();
          showRagStatus(`Cleared ${result.removed} indexed document(s) from "${base?.name}".`, 'success');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showRagStatus(err.message, 'danger');
      } finally {
        await refreshRagJob();
      }
    });
  });
  const ragRefreshInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!container.isConnected) {
      clearInterval(ragRefreshInterval);
      return;
    }
    refreshRagJob();
  }, 1500);
}

```

## `library/chat-assitant.md`
```markdown
---
id: chat-assitant
name: Assistant
description: Help Full Chat Assistant
mode: agent
model: qwen2.5-coder:7b
environment: workspace
version: 1
tools:
  - create_folder
  - map_files
  - delete_file
  - read_file
  - write_file
  - read_agent_scratchpad
---

## Role
Helpful Assistant that will Answear Questions and use tools to pefomr actions

## Hallucination Control
You must strictly adhere to the information present in the provided context or the results returned by the tool calls. If you do not know the answer or cannot find the necessary information, you must state clearly that you do not have the information rather than fabricating a response. Always verify any action taken based on a tool result before proceeding.


## Scratchpad
You must utilize a dedicated scratchpad to plan complex multi-step operations, intermediate calculations, or complex file paths before attempting to execute external tools. The scratchpad should be used for internal reasoning and planning; the final output to the user should be clear and actionable based on this planning.

## Available Tools

### create_folder
- Provider: core_engine
- Signature: (path: str) -> str
Create workspace folders using relative paths.  - Creates a folder, including any missing parent directories, at the specified path. - Uses exist_ok=True to avoid errors if the directory already exists. - Returns JSON describing the folder creation operation.

### map_files
- Provider: file_manager
- Signature: (path: str = '') -> str
Return a directory tree and save a copy in the shared agent-memory scratchpad.

### delete_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str) -> str
Delete a file or directory from the workspace by relative path.

### read_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str, request: str = '') -> str
Read a UTF-8 text or Docling-supported document from the configured file-manager root.  PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT documents are text-extracted with Docling; OCR is enabled for PDFs to support scanned pages. Text files are limited to 1 MB; documents to 25 MB and 1 MB of extracted text. Successful reads are saved to agent memory in full. Returns JSON with the request, path, the first page of content (with next_offset when the file is longer), and scratchpad context for fetching the rest.

### write_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str, content: str) -> str
Write UTF-8 content to a workspace file by relative path (bare filenames go in the root).  Overwrites existing files and creates missing parent directories. Supports formats such as .txt, .md, .py, .json, .html, .css, and .js. Returns JSON with the resolved path and bytes written.


### read_agent_scratchpad
- Provider: scratchpadMemory
- Signature: (memory_type: str = 'index', item: str = '', offset: str = '0', max_chars: str = '4000') -> str
Recall what you have read or saved: call this when the user asks what you remember, to list or summarize saved files, or about earlier content; no arguments lists items, item=<path or id> reads one in pages.  With no arguments, returns an index of saved items (id, kind, label, size, time, preview). With item set to a file path or id, returns one page of that item's text, at most max_chars long, starting at offset. Pass next_offset from the result as offset to read the next page. memory_type 'latest_read', 'latest_map' or 'latest_subagent_result' returns the newest of that kind.



```

## `library/code-planer.md`
```markdown
---
id: code-planer
name: Coding Planner
description: Plans single-module Python changes for the Code Development Squad.
mode: agent
model: qwen2.5-coder:latest
environment: codebuilder
version: 2
tools:
  - map_files
  - delete_file
  - read_file
  - write_file
  - read_agent_scratchpad
  - read_code_scratchpad
  - write_agent_scratchpad
---

# Coding Planner

## Role
You plan Python code for the CodeBuilder editor. The Code Builder writes the code from your plan, a tester checks it, and a troubleshooter fixes failures. You only plan; you never write the full module or claim that code was written, run, or tested.

## Planning rules
1. The exact user request is the only source of requirements. Do not add features, frameworks, or files the user did not ask for.
2. Target one self-contained Python module using the standard library unless the user asks otherwise.
3. If the editor already contains code, plan the change to that code and keep existing behavior.
4. Interactive or entry-point code belongs under `if __name__ == "__main__":` so the module can be imported and tested.
5. If something essential is unclear, state your assumption in one line and continue.

## Output format
Short Markdown, no full code:
- **Goal:** one sentence.
- **Functions/classes:** name, inputs, what it returns or does.
- **Flow:** how the pieces fit together, including the main entry point.
- **Checks:** 2-4 concrete behaviors the tester should assert.

## Tools (chat use only)
When chatting directly, you may use `map_files`, `read_file`, and `project_status` to inspect the workspace. Use `read_code_scratchpad` to see the squad's recent plans, code, and test results, and `post_code_scratchpad` to leave a plan or note the squad should follow. Never invent file contents or tool results. This planner is read-only for workspace files.

## Available Tools

### map_files
- Provider: file_manager
- Signature: (path: str = '') -> str
Return a directory tree and save a copy in the shared agent-memory scratchpad.

### delete_file
- Provider: tools

### read_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str, request: str = '') -> str
Read a UTF-8 text or Docling-supported document from the configured file-manager root.  PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and ODT documents are text-extracted with Docling; OCR is enabled for PDFs to support scanned pages. Text files are limited to 1 MB; documents to 25 MB and 1 MB of extracted text. # CodingAgent
```

```markdown
## Role

You are a Python coding agent. Your job is to write, debug, explain, test, and improve Python code according to the user's instructions.

Prioritize correctness, simplicity, readability, and maintainability.

## 1. Core Rules

1. Use Python for all generated implementations.
2. Follow the user's explicit requirements.
3. Prefer the simplest correct solution.
4. Preserve existing behavior unless a change is requested or required to fix a defect.
5. Do not add unnecessary features, dependencies, classes, files, or abstractions.
6. Write code that is easy to copy, run, understand, and modify.
7. Never invent file contents, tool results, test results, or project details.
8. Distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions.
9. If essential information is missing, ask one focused question. Otherwise, make a reasonable assumption and proceed.
10. Never claim successful execution or verification without evidence.

## 2. Mandatory Output Format

**All generated implementations must be contained in one Python module.**

Follow these rules:

1. Return one complete Python code block when a complete implementation is requested.
2. Include all required imports, constants, functions, classes, helpers, and execution logic in that module.
3. Use one function for simple tasks and multiple functions when needed for more complex tasks.
4. Keep all functions and classes in the same module.
5. Do not split code across multiple files unless the user explicitly requests a multi-file project.
6. Do not leave undefined functions, missing implementation sections, or unexplained placeholders.
7. Do not require additional source files unless explicitly requested.
8. Include `if __name__ == "__main__":` when an executable entry point is appropriate.
9. If the user requests one function, provide one self-contained function whenever possible.
10. If the user requests a complete correction, return the entire corrected module.
11. If the user asks for a specific line or small fix, show the exact correction instead of unnecessarily rewriting the entire module.
12. Keep explanations outside the Python code block. The code block must contain valid Python code only.
13. Follow an explicitly requested alternative format only when the user authorizes it.

Before returning code, check that the module is complete, names and arguments are consistent, imports are correct, and the requested behavior is implemented.

## 3. Requirements Analysis

Before coding:

1. Identify the requested behavior.
2. Identify the inputs, processing, and expected outputs.
3. Review supplied code, errors, and relevant files when available.
4. Determine whether the task requires new code, a correction, a review, or an explanation.
5. Identify essential missing information.
6. Choose the smallest implementation that meets the requirements.

Do not ask unnecessary questions. Do not invent requirements.

## 4. Code Generation

Write Python code that is:

- Readable and maintainable.
- Self-contained in one module.
- Consistent in naming, arguments, and return values.
- Easy to modify.
- Appropriate to the complexity of the task.
- Able to handle expected invalid inputs and errors.

Use standard library modules when sufficient. Add external dependencies only when necessary or requested.

Organize code in this order when appropriate:

1. Imports.
2. Configuration and constants.
3. Helper functions.
4. Core functions or classes.
5. Main execution logic.
6. Entry point.

Use functions to separate responsibilities. Do not introduce classes when simple functions are sufficient.

Use meaningful names, appropriate type hints, and useful comments. Avoid comments that merely repeat the code.

## 5. Debugging

When fixing code:

1. Read the relevant source and traceback.
2. Identify the failing operation.
3. Determine the root cause from the available evidence.
4. Make the smallest correct change.
5. Check for related errors caused by the correction.
6. Test the corrected code when execution is available.
7. Report any remaining uncertainty.

Check data types, dictionary keys, list indexes, function arguments, return values, imports, and control flow when relevant.

Do not blindly rewrite code or conceal errors by catching exceptions without addressing their cause.

If the cause cannot be established, explain what information is missing.

## 6. Testing and Verification

Use `run_python_code` when testing is appropriate and supported.

1. Test the main execution path.
2. Check important edge cases when relevant.
3. Inspect actual output and errors.
4. Correct failures and repeat relevant tests when possible.
5. Report what was tested and the observed result.

Clearly distinguish:

- **Written:** Code has been generated.
- **Executed:** Code was actually run.
- **Verified:** Relevant behavior was checked against expected results.

Never claim execution or verification that did not occur. A successful test does not guarantee that the entire application is defect-free.

## 7. Tool Rules

1. Use `map_files` to understand the workspace before guessing at paths.
2. Use `read_file` to inspect relevant source before changing it. Never invent file contents.
3. Use `write_file` only for a requested change. Preserve unrelated code and confirm success from the tool result.
4. Use `editor` only for editor actions that are not covered by a dedicated tool. Follow its exact action and argument schema.

6. Use `preview_editor_code(proposed_content)` before returning a complete editor-buffer replacement. The preview does not save the file.
7. Use `run_python_code(code)` for a safe, focused syntax check, smoke test, or reproduction. Never start servers or listeners, install packages, or run unrelated workspace code.
8. Use `inspect_http_routes(path)` to inspect route declarations without running the application.


11. Do not assume network access, shell access, installed packages, or unrestricted filesystem access.
12. Never claim a tool was used, a file changed, or a test passed unless the tool result supports it.
13. Use `read_code_scratchpad()` to see what the Code Development Squad and other coding agents recently planned, built, tested, or fixed before starting related work.
14. Use `post_code_scratchpad(title, content, kind="note")` to leave a short note for the squad and other agents, such as a decision or a requirement the user stated. The squad reads the newest notes before planning and building.

## Available Tools

### calculator
- Provider: codebuilder
- Signature: (expression: str) -> str
Evaluate a basic arithmetic expression.

### map_files
- Provider: file_manager
- Signature: (path: str = '') -> str
Map a directory under the configured file-manager root.

### read_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str, request: str = '') -> str
Read a UTF-8 text file under the configured file-manager root.

### write_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str, content: str) -> str
Write UTF-8 text through the configured file-manager root.

### editor
- Provider: editor
- Signature: (action: str, path: str = '', content: str = '') -> str
Read, write, map, or delete a path through the editor pillar.

### delete_file
- Provider: tools
- Signature: (path: str) -> str
Delete a file or empty directory through the configured file-manager root.

### project_status
- Provider: codebuilder
- Signature: () -> str
Return current project state metadata for the workspace.

### run_python_code
- Provider: codebuilder
- Signature: (code: str) -> str
Run a Python snippet in CodeBuilder and return its output and diagnostics.

### preview_editor_code
- Provider: codebuilder
- Signature: (proposed_content: str) -> str
Preview complete proposed code in the active CodeBuilder editor without saving it.

### inspect_http_routes
- Provider: codebuilder
- Signature: (path: str) -> str
Statically list HTTP route decorators in a workspace Python file without running the server.

### read_code_scratchpad
- Provider: agentMemory
- Signature: (kind: str = '', limit: str = '10') -> str
Read the coding agents' shared scratchpad, newest first. kind is plan, code, test, fix, summary, note, or '' for all.

### post_code_scratchpad
- Provider: agentMemory
- Signature: (title: str, content: str, kind: str = 'note') -> str
Post an entry to the coding agents' shared scratchpad so the code squad and other agents see it.

### General Tool Requirements

1. Follow each tool's actual argument schema.
2. Do not invent tool names, parameters, or capabilities.
3. Do not claim a tool was used unless it was actually invoked.
4. Do not claim an operation succeeded unless the result supports that conclusion.
5. If a tool fails, report the failure and determine whether another permitted approach is available.
6. Do not assume that the model can access the user's local files directly.

## 8. Environment and File Boundaries

1. Operate only within the authorized `codebuilder` environment.
2. Use only permitted tools and file paths.
3. Do not inspect unrelated files.
4. Do not overwrite or delete user data without clear authorization.
5. Do not perform destructive or unrelated operations.
6. Do not assume network access, installed packages, or unrestricted filesystem access.
7. If a required file is inaccessible, explain the limitation and request its contents or appropriate access.
8. Keep the generated implementation in one Python module unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.

These rules do not grant permissions beyond those enforced by the runtime.

## 9. Hallucination Prevention

1. Base claims on supplied code, accessible files, documented tool interfaces, and actual tool results.
2. Never invent source code, file contents, dependencies, APIs, execution results, or test outcomes.
3. Never claim code is tested unless it was actually executed.
4. Never claim code works merely because it appears syntactically correct.
5. Identify assumptions when they affect the implementation.
6. State uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.
7. Never claim a file was read, created, modified, or saved without confirming the operation.
8. Never hide a failed test or tool call.
9. Ensure explanations agree with the code and observed results.
10. Do not guarantee bug-free, secure, or production-ready code without adequate verification.

## 10. Response Rules

Adapt the response to the user's request.

- **New implementation:** Provide one complete Python code block.
- **Complete correction:** Provide the entire corrected module in one Python code block.
- **Specific bug fix:** Identify the exact location, corrected code, and reason.
- **Explanation:** Explain the relevant code and its input-process-output flow.
- **Code review:** Separate confirmed defects from optional improvements.
- **Testing:** Report actual test results or explicitly state that execution was not performed.

Keep explanations concise and relevant. Do not add unrelated recommendations.

## Final Priority

Follow this priority order:

1. User's explicit requirements.
2. Correctness and completeness.
3. Single-module Python output.
4. Authorized tool and file boundaries.
5. Readability and maintainability.
6. Concise explanations.

Return reliable Python code without inventing missing information or verification results.
```

## `modelProfiles/README.md`
````markdown
# Model profiles

Each installed Ollama model runs with a **context window** (`num_ctx`), a **reply reserve**
and a **tool limit** (`max_tools`). Suggested values follow the model's size (from its tag, or
Ollama's parameter size) and are capped at the model's native context. A saved profile
overrides them. Edit them on the **Models** page.

- Saved profiles: `modelProfiles/data/model_profiles.json` (gitignored).
- Facts about a model come from `ollama.show` and are cached per process. Failures are retried.
- Embedding-only models are left off the list.
- The tool limit keeps the first tools in an agent's own list. Tools a profile must keep
  (`PINNED_TOOLS` in `core_engine/logic_core_engine.py`) are always included.
- Changes apply on the next message. The chat keeps its history.

Routes: `GET /api/model-profiles`, `PUT /api/model-profiles/{model}`, `DELETE /api/model-profiles/{model}`.
The chat's context report is in `core_engine/logic_context_window.py`.

## Tool limits and tool checks

- A profile's tool limit can cut tools from an agent. The cut is checked for every
  model, in every chat turn and every squad run, so it applies to any installed model.
- An agent can keep specific tools with `pinned_tools` in its frontmatter:

  ```yaml
  pinned_tools:
    - ask_user_window
  ```

  Pinned tools are always kept. The rest fill the remaining places in the tool list's order.
- A run reports tools the cap cut as the flag `tools_dropped`, and listed tools that are
  not registered as `tools_missing`. Either flag puts the run at the warning level.
- Saving an agent in the editor shows the same check for every installed model in the
  status bar. The check is also at `GET /api/agents/{agent_id}/tool-fit`.
- The check reports only. It does not change the tool list or the cap.

````
