        entry["effective_status"] = self.effective_status(entry, execution)
        return entry

    def normalize_handoffs(
        self, handoffs: list[dict[str, Any]], execution: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [self.normalize_handoff(handoff, execution) for handoff in handoffs or []]

    @staticmethod
    def _tail(value: Any, limit: int) -> tuple[str, bool]:
        text = str(value or "")
        if len(text) <= limit:
            return text, False
        return text[-limit:], True

    def execution_evidence(
        self,
        execution: dict[str, Any] | None,
        text_limit: int = 8_000,
        diagnostic_limit: int = 20,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a bounded, prompt-safe view of the latest execution result."""
        if not execution:
            return {}
        evidence: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key in ("run_id", "status", "return_code", "timed_out", "duration_seconds", "source_matches_editor"):
            if key in execution:
                evidence[key] = execution[key]
        for key in ("stdout", "stderr", "error"):
            text, truncated = self._tail(execution.get(key), text_limit)
            if text:
                evidence[key] = text
                if truncated:
                    evidence[f"{key}_truncated"] = True
        diagnostics = execution.get("diagnostics")
        if isinstance(diagnostics, list) and diagnostics:
            evidence["diagnostics"] = diagnostics[:diagnostic_limit]
            if len(diagnostics) > diagnostic_limit:
                evidence["diagnostics_truncated"] = True
        if execution.get("stuck"):
            evidence["stuck"] = execution["stuck"]
        return evidence


# --- Sub-agent runner ------------------------------------------------------------------

class SubAgentRunner:
    """Runs one turn of a library agent (Markdown) or a background sub-agent (YAML)."""

    TOKEN_FLUSH_SECONDS = 0.15

    def load_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> Tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
        """Resolve Markdown agent from library/ or YAML sub-agent from subAgentLibrary/."""
        clean = agent_library.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
        primary_file = agent_library.LIBRARY_ROOT / f"{clean}.md"
        if primary_file.is_file():
            profile = agent_library.load_agent_definition_from_md(primary_file)
            meta = {
                "id": profile.id,
                "name": profile.name,
                "description": profile.description,
                "mode": profile.mode,
                "model": profile.model,
                "tools": list(profile.tools),
                "role": profile.role,
                "purpose": profile.purpose,
                "boundaries": profile.boundaries,
                "max_tool_rounds": profile.extras.get("max_tool_rounds"),
            }
            return meta, profile.system_prompt

        subagent_yaml = agent_library.SUBAGENT_LIBRARY_ROOT / f"{clean}.yaml"
        if subagent_yaml.is_file():
            return agent_library.parse_subagent_yaml(clean)

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Agent definition '{agent_id}' not found in library/ or subAgentLibrary/."
        )

    def read_latest_subagent_scratchpad(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        memory = scratchpad.read_memory("latest_subagent_result")
        return memory.get("latest_subagent_result", {})

    def read_scratchpad_snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return scratchpad.read_memory()

    def _build_profile(self, agent_id: str, meta: dict[str, Any], body: str) -> AgentProfile:
        tools = meta.get("tools") or []
        if not isinstance(tools, list):
            tools = [tools]
        return AgentProfile(
            id=str(meta.get("id") or agent_id),
            name=str(meta.get("name") or agent_id),
            description=str(meta.get("description") or ""),
            mode=str(meta.get("mode") or "agent"),
            system_prompt=body,
            role=str(meta.get("role") or ""),
            purpose=str(meta.get("purpose") or ""),
            boundaries=str(meta.get("boundaries") or ""),
            model=str(meta.get("model") or ""),
            tools=[str(tool) for tool in tools],
            extras={"max_tool_rounds": meta["max_tool_rounds"]} if meta.get("max_tool_rounds") else {},
        )

    def run_agent_turn_stream(
        self,
        agent_id: str,
        prompt_input: str,
        trace_id: str,
        model: str | None = None,
        should_stop: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Run one text-only agent turn, streaming batched AGENT_TOKEN telemetry.

        Code-squad agents answer with prose and fenced code; the orchestrator applies
        the code itself, so no tool calls are offered to the model here.
        """
        import ollama

        meta, body = self.load_agent(agent_id)
        profile = self._build_profile(agent_id, meta, body)
        messages = [
            {"role": "system", "content": profile.system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt_input},
        ]
        text = ""
        pending = ""
        usage_chunk = None
        last_flush = time.monotonic()
        resolved_model = model or profile.model or "qwen2.5-coder:latest"
        num_ctx = model_profiles.effective(resolved_model)["num_ctx"]
        stream = ollama.chat(
            model=resolved_model,
            messages=messages,
            stream=True,
            options={"num_ctx": num_ctx},
        )

        def flush() -> None:
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "AGENT_TOKEN", agent_id, "orchestrator",
                {"agent_id": agent_id, "text": pending},
            )

        try:
            for chunk in stream:
                if should_stop and should_stop():
                    raise AgentTurnCancelled(agent_id)
                if context_window.read_field(chunk, "prompt_eval_count") is not None:
                    usage_chunk = chunk
                piece = (chunk.get("message") or {}).get("content") or ""
                if not piece:
                    continue
                text += piece
                pending += piece
                if time.monotonic() - last_flush >= self.TOKEN_FLUSH_SECONDS:
                    flush()
                    pending = ""
                    last_flush = time.monotonic()
        finally:
            close = getattr(stream, "close", None)
            if close:
                close()
        if pending:
            flush()
        if trace_id and usage_chunk is not None:
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "AGENT_USAGE", agent_id, "orchestrator",
                stream_usage_data(
                    agent_id, resolved_model, num_ctx,
                    context_window.read_field(usage_chunk, "prompt_eval_count"),
                    context_window.read_field(usage_chunk, "eval_count"),
                ),
            )
        return text

    @staticmethod
    def _emit_usage(trace_id: str | None, agent_id: str, agent_instance: Agent) -> None:
        if trace_id:
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "AGENT_USAGE", agent_id, "orchestrator",
                usage_event_data(agent_id, agent_instance.run_stats()),
            )

    def run_agent_turn(
        self,
        agent_id: str,
        prompt_input: str,
        parameters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        if trace_id is None:
            # A sub-agent called from a running turn belongs to that run's trace.
            inherited = telemetry_bus.current_context()
            trace_id = inherited[0] if inherited else None
        context = telemetry_bus.agent_context(trace_id, agent_id) if trace_id else nullcontext()
        with context:
            if agent_library.normalize_agent_id(agent_id) == RAG_RETRIEVER_ID:
                return rag_retriever.run(prompt_input, parameters or {})

            meta, body = self.load_agent(agent_id)
            profile = self._build_profile(agent_id, meta, body)
            model = profile.model or "qwen2.5-coder:latest"
            agent_instance = Agent(model=model, tools=[], profile=profile)
            if profile.mode == "agent" and profile.tools:
                apply_model_limits(agent_instance, profile, model, SQUAD_PINNED_TOOLS)
            else:
                agent_instance.num_ctx = model_profiles.effective(model)["num_ctx"]
            try:
                reply = str(agent_instance.think(prompt_input))
            except Exception as exc:
                agent_instance.note_failure("model_error", "", str(exc))
                self._emit_usage(trace_id, agent_id, agent_instance)
                raise
            self._emit_usage(trace_id, agent_id, agent_instance)
            return reply


class RagRetriever:
    """Deterministic retrieval worker: searches a knowledge branch, filters by relevance
    and hands the result to the scratchpad for the presenting agent."""

    RAG_RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD = 0.25

    def run(self, task_prompt: str, parameters: dict) -> str:
        query = str(task_prompt or "").strip()
        payload = {"query": query, "knowledge_branch_id": "", "results": []}
        status = "error"
        try:
            if not isinstance(parameters, dict):
                raise ValueError("Sub-agent parameters must be a JSON object.")
            if not query:
                raise ValueError("A retrieval query is required.")
            branch_id = str(
                parameters.get("knowledge_branch_id")
                or rag.selected_source_id()
            )
            top_k = int(parameters.get("top_k", 5))
            result = rag.search_knowledge(query, top_k, source_id=branch_id)
            payload = {
                "query": query,
                "knowledge_branch_id": result["knowledge_base_id"],
                "knowledge_branch_name": result["knowledge_base"],
                "results": [
                    item for item in result["results"]
                    if float(item["score"]) >= self.RAG_RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD
                ],
                "skipped_incompatible_chunks": result.get(
                    "skipped_incompatible_chunks", 0
                ),
            }
            status = "success" if payload["results"] else "nothing_found"
        except Exception as exc:
            payload["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

        scratchpad.store_subagent_result(
            subagent_id=RAG_RETRIEVER_ID,
            task_type="rag_retrieval",
            status=status,
            payload=payload,
        )
        trace_context = telemetry_bus.current_context()
        if trace_context:
            trace_id, agent_id = trace_context
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF", agent_id, "scratchpad",
                {
                    "status": status,
                    "subagent_id": RAG_RETRIEVER_ID,
                    "result_count": len(payload.get("results", [])),
                    "direction": "write",
                },
            )
        return json.dumps(
            {
                "subagent_id": RAG_RETRIEVER_ID,
                "status": status,
                "payload": payload,
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
        )


# --- Execution patterns (RAG squad and user-defined squads) ----------------------------

def _print_trace(message: str) -> None:
    """Print a trace line without failing on terminals that cannot encode box glyphs."""
    try:
        print(message, flush=True)
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        print(message.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii"), flush=True)


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _result_count(scratchpad_entry: dict) -> int:
    payload = scratchpad_entry.get("payload")
    results = payload.get("results") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
    return len(results) if isinstance(results, list) else int(bool(payload))


def _squad_for_request(request: OrchestrationRequest) -> str | None:
    if request.workflow_action != "all":
        raise ValueError("Plan, Build, Test, and Fix actions are only available for code-squad.")
    if request.squad_id:
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(request.squad_id)
        if squad is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown registered squad: {request.squad_id}")
        request.primary_agent = squad["primary_agent"]
        request.subagents = list(squad["subagents"])
        return request.squad_id
    return squad_registry.get_squad_id_for_primary_agent(request.primary_agent)


class _PatternRun:
    """Mutable state of one squad pattern run."""

    def __init__(self, request: OrchestrationRequest, squad_id: str | None):
        self.request = request
        self.trace_id = request.trace_id or ""
        self.squad_id = squad_id
        self.primary_id = request.primary_agent or "rag-presenter"
        self.members = list(request.subagents or [RAG_RETRIEVER_ID])
        self.steps: list[TraceStep] = []
        self.started = time.perf_counter()

    def add_step(
        self, agent_id: str, phase: str, status: str, details: str, error_reason: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        self.steps.append(TraceStep(
            step_number=len(self.steps) + 1, agent_id=agent_id, phase=phase, status=status,
            details=details, error_reason=error_reason, timestamp=_now(),
        ))


class BasePattern(ABC):
    """Shared squad run lifecycle: members run (per pattern), scratchpad barrier, primary
    synthesis, then metrics, the saved result and RUN_COMPLETE."""

    name = "sequential"

    @abstractmethod
    def run_members(self, run: _PatternRun) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
        """Run the squad members; returns extra synthesis context and an optional result payload."""

    def execute(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        if request.squad_id == CODE_SQUAD_ID:
            return code_squad_pipeline.run(request)

        request.trace_id = request.trace_id or f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        run = _PatternRun(request, _squad_for_request(request))
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "RUN_STARTED", "orchestrator", run.squad_id or run.primary_id,
            {"squad_id": run.squad_id or "unregistered", "pattern": self.name},
        )
        _print_trace(
            f"\n\033[94m[ORCHESTRATION TRACE: {run.trace_id}]\033[0m Starting {self.name} pipeline."
        )
        extra_payload = None
        try:
            context, extra_payload = self.run_members(run)
            scratchpad_entry = subagent_runner.read_latest_subagent_scratchpad()
            scratchpad_snapshot = subagent_runner.read_scratchpad_snapshot()
            status = (
                str(scratchpad_entry.get("status") or "success")
                if scratchpad_entry
                else "no_context_found"
            )
            if extra_payload and status == "no_context_found":
                status = "success"
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                run.trace_id, "SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF", "orchestrator", "scratchpad",
                {
                    "status": status,
                    "subagent_id": scratchpad_entry.get("subagent_id", ""),
                    "result_count": _result_count(scratchpad_entry),
                    "direction": "read",
                },
            )
            run.add_step(
                "scratchpad", "SCRATCHPAD_BARRIER", status,
                "Retrieved latest sub-agent payload from scratchpad",
            )
            final_answer = self._synthesize(run, context)
            if any(step.status == "ERROR" for step in run.steps):
                status = "error"
        except Exception as exc:
            status = "error"
            final_answer = f"Workflow failed: {exc}"
            scratchpad_entry, scratchpad_snapshot = {}, {}
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                run.trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", run.squad_id or run.primary_id,
                {"error": final_answer, "status": "error"},
            )

        payload = scratchpad_entry.get("payload") if scratchpad_entry else None
        if extra_payload:
            payload = {**extra_payload, "scratchpad_payload": payload}
        return self._finish(run, status, final_answer, payload, scratchpad_snapshot)

    def _run_member(self, run: _PatternRun, member_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, Exception | None]:
        """Run one member turn with telemetry; never raises."""
        _print_trace(f" ├── Executing member '\033[93m{member_id}\033[0m'...")
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", "orchestrator", member_id,
            {"summary": "Sub-agent phase started", "status": "running"},
        )
        request = run.request
        if member_id == RAG_RETRIEVER_ID:
            prompt = request.user_query
        else:
            prompt = f"Task: '{request.user_query}'. Parameters: {request.parameters}"
        try:
            output = subagent_runner.run_agent_turn(
                member_id, prompt, request.parameters, trace_id=run.trace_id
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _print_trace(f" │   \033[91m[ERROR]\033[0m Member '{member_id}' failed: {exc}")
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                run.trace_id, "ERROR", member_id, "orchestrator",
                {"error": f"Sub-agent '{member_id}' failed: {exc}", "status": "error"},
            )
            return None, exc
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", member_id, "orchestrator",
            {"summary": "Sub-agent phase completed", "status": "success"},
        )
        return output, None

    @staticmethod
    def _record_member(run: _PatternRun, member_id: str, error: Exception | None) -> None:
        if error is None:
            run.add_step(member_id, "SUBAGENT_EXECUTION", "SUCCESS", f"Executed worker '{member_id}'")
        else:
            run.add_step(
                member_id, "SUBAGENT_EXECUTION", "ERROR",
                f"Sub-agent '{member_id}' raised an exception", error_reason=str(error),
            )

    def _synthesize(self, run: _PatternRun, context: str) -> str:
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", "orchestrator", run.primary_id,
            {"summary": "Primary synthesis started", "status": "running"},
        )
        prompt = (
            f"User request: '{run.request.user_query}'. "
            "Inspect scratchpad using read_agent_scratchpad('latest_subagent_result') "
            "and synthesize the final output in clear, user-facing prose."
        )
        if context:
            prompt += f"\n\n{context}"
        final_answer = subagent_runner.run_agent_turn(run.primary_id, prompt, trace_id=run.trace_id)
        run.add_step(
            run.primary_id, "PRIMARY_SYNTHESIS", "SUCCESS",
            f"Primary agent '{run.primary_id}' completed response",
        )
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", run.primary_id, "orchestrator",
            {"summary": "Primary synthesis completed", "status": "success"},
        )
        return final_answer

    def _finish(
        self, run: _PatternRun, status: str, final_answer: str, payload: Any,
        scratchpad_snapshot: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - run.started) * 1000)
        if run.squad_id:
            squad_registry.record_squad_run(run.squad_id, status != "error", duration_ms)
        response = OrchestrationResponse(
            trace_id=run.trace_id,
            pattern=self.name,
            query=run.request.user_query,
            status=status,
            final_answer=final_answer,
            result_payload=payload,
            execution_trace=run.steps,
        )
        # Save before RUN_COMPLETE so the client's result fetch never races a 404.
        run_results.save(
            run.trace_id,
            {
                **response.model_dump(),
                "squad_id": run.squad_id,
                "scratchpad_snapshot": scratchpad_snapshot,
                "agent_stats": summarize_agent_usage(telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(run.trace_id)),
            },
        )
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", run.squad_id or run.primary_id,
            {"status": status, "duration_ms": duration_ms},
        )
        telemetry_bus.finish_trace(run.trace_id)
        _print_trace(f" \033[94m[ORCHESTRATION TRACE: {run.trace_id}]\033[0m Pipeline complete.\n")
        return response


def _member_outputs_context(outputs: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    lines = ["Squad member outputs:"]
    for member_id, output in outputs.items():
        lines.append(f"--- {member_id} ---\n{str(output).strip()[:4000]}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


class SequentialPattern(BasePattern):
    """Executes squad members one after another to avoid local LLM hardware bottlenecks."""

    name = "sequential"

    def run_members(self, run: _PatternRun) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
        for member_id in run.members:
            _, error = self._run_member(run, member_id)
            self._record_member(run, member_id, error)
        return "", None


class FanOutPattern(BasePattern):
    """Runs every squad member on the same task concurrently (bounded by ``max_parallel``)
    and hands all of their outputs to the primary agent for synthesis."""

    name = "fanout"

    @staticmethod
    def max_parallel(run: _PatternRun) -> int:
        value = run.request.parameters.get("max_parallel")
        if value is None and run.squad_id:
            value = (squad_registry.get_squad(run.squad_id) or {}).get("max_parallel")
        try:
            limit = int(value or DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            limit = DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL
        return max(1, min(limit, MAX_PARALLEL_LIMIT))

    def run_members(self, run: _PatternRun) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
        outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
        errors: dict[str, str] = {}
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(
            max_workers=self.max_parallel(run), thread_name_prefix="squad-fanout"
        ) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(self._run_member, run, member_id): member_id for member_id in run.members}
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                member_id = futures[future]
                output, error = future.result()
                self._record_member(run, member_id, error)
                if error is None:
                    outputs[member_id] = str(output or "")
                else:
                    errors[member_id] = str(error)
        ordered = {member_id: outputs[member_id] for member_id in run.members if member_id in outputs}
        return _member_outputs_context(ordered), {"fanout_results": ordered, "fanout_errors": errors}


def _parse_routing_reply(reply: str, allowed: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """Pull ``{"subagents": [...], "reason": ...}`` out of a model reply; unknown ids are dropped."""
    match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", str(reply or ""), re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        return [], ""
    try:
        data = json.loads(match.group(0))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return [], ""
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return [], ""
    picked = data.get("subagents") or data.get("members") or []
    if isinstance(picked, str):
        picked = [picked]
    chosen: list[str] = []
    for member_id in picked if isinstance(picked, list) else []:
        member_id = str(member_id).strip()
        if member_id in allowed and member_id not in chosen:
            chosen.append(member_id)
    return chosen, str(data.get("reason") or "")[:500]


class RouterPattern(BasePattern):
    """The primary agent picks which squad members handle the task, then only those run
    (sequentially) before the primary agent synthesizes."""

    name = "router"

    @staticmethod
    def _member_descriptions(members: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
        try:
            catalog = squad_registry.list_agent_catalog()
        except RuntimeError:
            return {}
        known = {item["id"]: item["description"] for item in catalog["agents"] + catalog["subagents"]}
        return {member_id: known.get(member_id, "") for member_id in members}

    def route(self, run: _PatternRun) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
        descriptions = self._member_descriptions(run.members)
        listing = "\n".join(
            f"- {member_id}: {descriptions.get(member_id) or 'no description'}" for member_id in run.members
        )
        prompt = (
            f"You are routing a task to members of your squad. Task: '{run.request.user_query}'.\n"
            f"Available members:\n{listing}\n\n"
            'Reply with JSON only: {"subagents": ["<member id>", ...], "reason": "<one sentence>"}. '
            "Choose only ids from the list, in the order they should run."
        )
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", "orchestrator", run.primary_id,
            {"summary": "Routing decision started", "status": "running"},
        )
        try:
            reply = subagent_runner.run_agent_turn(run.primary_id, prompt, trace_id=run.trace_id)
            chosen, reason = _parse_routing_reply(reply, run.members)
        except Exception as exc:
            chosen, reason = [], f"Routing turn failed: {exc}"
        if not chosen:
            chosen = run.members[:1]
            reason = f"Fallback to first member. {reason}".strip()
        run.add_step(run.primary_id, "ROUTING", "SUCCESS", f"Routed to {', '.join(chosen)}. {reason}".strip())
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            run.trace_id, "AGENT_MESSAGE", run.primary_id, "orchestrator",
            {"summary": f"Routed to {', '.join(chosen)}", "status": "success"},
        )
        return chosen, reason

    def run_members(self, run: _PatternRun) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any] | None]:
        chosen, reason = self.route(run)
        outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
        for member_id in chosen:
            output, error = self._run_member(run, member_id)
            self._record_member(run, member_id, error)
            if error is None:
                outputs[member_id] = str(output or "")
        routing = {"chosen": chosen, "reason": reason, "skipped": [m for m in run.members if m not in chosen]}
        return _member_outputs_context(outputs), {"routing": routing, "member_results": outputs}


# --- Code Development Squad pipeline ---------------------------------------------------

class CodeSquadPipeline:
    """Deterministic plan -> build -> test -> fix pipeline for the CodeBuilder editor.

    Agents only write text and one fenced Python block. The orchestrator applies that
    code to the editor buffer, runs it, and records factual handoffs, so a small local
    model never has to produce a large tool-call argument to deliver its work.
    """

    MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS = 3
    SHARED_NOTES = 3
    SHARED_NOTES_CHARS = 2_000
    TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15.0
    TEST_NAME = "__codebuilder_test__"
    ACTION_ALIASES = {"troubleshoot": "fix"}
    STEP_AGENTS = {
        "plan": "code-planer",
        "build": "code-builder",
        "test": "tester",
        "fix": "code-troubleshooter",
    }

    # --- code extraction -----------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def fenced_code_blocks(response: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        return [
            ((match.group(1) or "").strip().split(" ", 1)[0].lower(), match.group(2))
            for match in re.finditer(r"```([^\r\n`]*)\r?\n([\s\S]*?)```", response or "")
            if match.group(2).strip()
        ]

    def extract_python_block(self, response: str) -> str | None:
        """Return the module the agent produced: the single block, else the largest Python block."""
        blocks = self.fenced_code_blocks(response)
        if len(blocks) == 1:
            return blocks[0][1]
        python_blocks = [
            content for language, content in blocks if language in {"python", "py", "python3"}
        ]
        if not python_blocks:
            return None
        return max(python_blocks, key=len)

    # --- step bookkeeping ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _check_cancel(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext) -> None:
        if codebuilder_run_state.is_cancelled(ctx.trace_id):
            raise PipelineCancelled()

    def _step_status(
        self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, step: str, status: str, attempt: int = 0, summary: str = ""
    ) -> None:
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "STEP_STATUS", "orchestrator", self.STEP_AGENTS.get(step, step),
            {"step": step, "status": status, "attempt": attempt, "summary": summary},
        )

    def _record(
        self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, step: str, status: str, details: str, error: str | None = None
    ) -> None:
        ctx.steps.append(
            TraceStep(
                step_number=len(ctx.steps) + 1,
                agent_id=self.STEP_AGENTS.get(step, step),
                phase=step.upper(),
                status=status,
                details=details,
                error_reason=error,
                timestamp=_now(),
            )
        )

    def _handoff(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, agent_id: str, status: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        codebuilder_run_state.save_handoff(
            ctx.trace_id, agent_id, TASK_TYPE_BY_AGENT.get(agent_id, "code_plan"), status, payload
        )

    def _note(
        self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, author: str, kind: str, title: str, content: str,
        status: str = "success",
    ) -> None:
        """Record a step on the coding agents' shared scratchpad; never fail the run over it."""
        try:
            code_scratchpad.post(author, kind, title, content, run_id=ctx.trace_id)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - the scratchpad is a record, not a dependency
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                ctx.trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", "scratchpad",
                {"error": f"Could not write the code scratchpad: {exc}", "status": "error"},
            )
            return
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF", author, "scratchpad",
            {"status": status, "subagent_id": author, "result_count": 1, "direction": "write"},
        )

    def _shared_notes_section(self) -> str:
        """Notes chat agents or the user left on the code scratchpad, newest first."""
        try:
            notes = code_scratchpad.entries(limit=self.SHARED_NOTES, kind="note")
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return ""
        if not notes:
            return ""
        lines = "\n".join(f"- ({note['author']}) {note['title']}: {note['content']}" for note in notes)
        return "\nNotes from other agents on the code scratchpad:\n" + lines[:self.SHARED_NOTES_CHARS] + "\n"

    def _ask_agent(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, step: str, prompt: str, attempt: int = 0) -> str:
        agent_id = self.STEP_AGENTS[step]
        self._check_cancel(ctx)
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "AGENT_STARTED", "orchestrator", agent_id,
            {"agent_id": agent_id, "step": step, "attempt": attempt},
        )
        try:
            reply = subagent_runner.run_agent_turn_stream(
                agent_id,
                prompt,
                ctx.trace_id,
                model=ctx.model,
                should_stop=lambda: codebuilder_run_state.is_cancelled(ctx.trace_id),
            )
        except AgentTurnCancelled as exc:
            raise PipelineCancelled() from exc
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "AGENT_DONE", agent_id, "orchestrator",
            {"agent_id": agent_id, "step": step, "text": reply},
        )
        return reply

    def apply_code(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, code: str, agent_id: str) -> list[int]:
        """Place agent code in the editor buffer and announce it to the frontend."""
        from tools.logic_tools import code_change_preview

        try:
            lines = code_change_preview.changed_line_numbers(ctx.code, code, "after")
        except ValueError:
            lines = []
        codebuilder_run_state.save_preview(ctx.trace_id, code, lines)
        ctx.code = code
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE", agent_id, "editor",
            {"content": code, "changed_lines": lines},
        )
        return lines

    @staticmethod
    def _buffer_section(code: str) -> str:
        if not code.strip():
            return "The editor is currently empty."
        return f"Current editor module:\n```python\n{code}\n```"

    # --- test harness ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _test_harness(self, code: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
        """Return runnable source that imports the module without running its main guard.

        The ``__name__`` override shares the first line when that is valid, so traceback
        line numbers match the editor. Otherwise it gets its own line (offset 1).
        """
        first = code.splitlines()[0] if code else ""
        override = f"__name__ = {self.TEST_NAME!r}"
        # Only simple statements may follow ';' on one line (not def/class/if/@...).
        if first.startswith(("import ", "from ", "#", '"', "'")) and not first.startswith("from __future__"):
            return f"{override}; {code}", 0
        return f"{override}\n{code}", 1

    def _run(self, code: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        from codebuilder.execution import execute_python_code
        from codebuilder.schemas_codebuilder import CodeExecutionRequest

        result = execute_python_code(
            CodeExecutionRequest(code=code, timeout_seconds=self.TEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        )
        return result.model_dump()

    @staticmethod
    def _compile_error(code: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        try:
            compile(code, "editor.py", "exec")
        except SyntaxError as exc:
            message = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc.msg} (line {exc.lineno})"
            return {
                "status": "ERROR",
                "stdout": "",
                "stderr": message + ("\n" + exc.text if exc.text else ""),
                "return_code": 1,
                "timed_out": False,
                "diagnostics": [
                    {"path": None, "line": exc.lineno, "column": exc.offset, "message": message, "severity": "error"}
                ],
            }
        return None

    def _publish_execution(
        self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, result: dict[str, Any], offset: int, agent_id: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Map diagnostics back to editor lines, store the result, and notify the UI."""
        total = len(ctx.code.splitlines())
        diagnostics = []
        for item in result.get("diagnostics") or []:
            item = dict(item)
            line = item.get("line")
            if isinstance(line, int):
                line -= offset
                item["line"] = line if 0 < line <= total else None
            diagnostics.append(item)
        result = {**result, "diagnostics": diagnostics}
        codebuilder_run_state.save_execution(ctx.trace_id, ctx.code, result, allow_non_editor_source=True)
        passed = result.get("status") == "SUCCESS"
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            ctx.trace_id, "EDITOR_CODE_EXECUTION", agent_id, "editor",
            {
                "status": "success" if passed else "error",
                "diagnostic_lines": sorted({d["line"] for d in diagnostics if d.get("line")})[:120],
            },
        )
        return result

    # --- steps -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def step_plan(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext) -> None:
        self._step_status(ctx, "plan", "running")
        prompt = (
            f"User request: {ctx.query}\n\n{self._buffer_section(ctx.code)}\n{self._shared_notes_section()}\n"
            "Write a short implementation plan for a single Python module: the functions "
            "to add or change, what each does, and how the result will be checked. "
            "Do not write the full code."
        )
        ctx.plan = self._ask_agent(ctx, "plan", prompt).strip()
        self._handoff(ctx, "code-planer", "success" if ctx.plan else "error", {"plan": ctx.plan[:4_000]})
        if ctx.plan:
            self._note(ctx, "code-planer", "plan", f"Plan: {ctx.query[:120]}", ctx.plan)
        self._record(ctx, "plan", "SUCCESS" if ctx.plan else "ERROR", "Created implementation plan")
        self._step_status(ctx, "plan", "success" if ctx.plan else "error")

    def step_build(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext) -> bool:
        self._step_status(ctx, "build", "running")
        prompt = f"User request: {ctx.query}\n\n{self._buffer_section(ctx.code)}\n{self._shared_notes_section()}"
        if ctx.plan:
            prompt += f"\nPlan to follow:\n{ctx.plan[:8_000]}\n"
        prompt += (
            "\nReturn the COMPLETE resulting Python module in exactly one ```python block, "
            "then 1-3 short lines saying what you did."
        )
        reply = self._ask_agent(ctx, "build", prompt)
        code = self.extract_python_block(reply)
        if code is None:
            self._handoff(ctx, "code-builder", "error", {"summary": "No Python code block in reply.", "reply": reply[:4_000]})
            self._note(ctx, "code-builder", "code", "Build failed: no Python code block", reply, "error")
            self._record(ctx, "build", "ERROR", "Builder returned no Python code block")
            self._step_status(ctx, "build", "error", summary="The builder did not return a Python code block.")
            return False
        lines = self.apply_code(ctx, code, "code-builder")
        self._handoff(ctx, "code-builder", "success", {"summary": "Applied module to editor.", "changed_lines": len(lines)})
        self._note(ctx, "code-builder", "code", f"Built module ({len(lines)} lines changed)", reply)
        self._record(ctx, "build", "SUCCESS", f"Applied builder code ({len(lines)} changed lines)")
        self._step_status(ctx, "build", "success", summary=f"{len(lines)} lines changed")
        return True

    def step_test(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, attempt: int = 0) -> bool:
        self._step_status(ctx, "test", "running", attempt)
        agent_id = "tester"
        if not ctx.code.strip():
            ctx.last_test = {"status": "ERROR", "stderr": "The editor is empty; there is nothing to test.", "diagnostics": []}
            self._record(ctx, "test", "ERROR", "Nothing to test")
            self._step_status(ctx, "test", "error", attempt, "The editor is empty.")
            return False

        result = self._compile_error(ctx.code)
        offset = 0
        stage = "syntax check"
        snippet = None
        if result is None:
            harness, offset = self._test_harness(ctx.code)
            self._check_cancel(ctx)
            result = self._run(harness)
            stage = "import smoke test"
            if result.get("status") == "SUCCESS":
                prompt = (
                    f"User request: {ctx.query}\n\n{self._buffer_section(ctx.code)}\n\n"
                    "Write a short Python test snippet that will run directly after this "
                    "module's code (its functions and classes are already defined; do not "
                    "import it). Use plain assert statements on the module's functions, "
                    "with no input(), servers, loops waiting on users, or file writes. "
                    "Return exactly one ```python block and nothing else."
                )
                snippet = self.extract_python_block(self._ask_agent(ctx, "test", prompt, attempt))
                if snippet and snippet.strip():
                    self._check_cancel(ctx)
                    result = self._run(f"{harness}\n\n# --- tester checks ---\n{snippet}")
                    stage = "tester checks"
        result = self._publish_execution(ctx, result, offset, agent_id)
        passed = result.get("status") == "SUCCESS"
        outcome = f"{stage} {'passed' if passed else 'failed'}"
        ctx.last_test = {**code_handoffs.execution_evidence(result), "stage": stage}
        self._handoff(ctx, agent_id, "success" if passed else "error", ctx.last_test)
        evidence = json.dumps(ctx.last_test, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)[:8_000]
        self._note(
            ctx, agent_id, "test", outcome,
            f"```json\n{evidence}\n```" + (f"\n\nTester checks:\n```python\n{snippet}\n```" if snippet else ""),
            "success" if passed else "error",
        )
        self._record(ctx, "test", "SUCCESS" if passed else "ERROR", outcome)
        self._step_status(ctx, "test", "success" if passed else "error", attempt, outcome)
        return passed

    def step_fix(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, attempt: int = 1) -> bool:
        self._step_status(ctx, "fix", "running", attempt)
        evidence = json.dumps(ctx.last_test or {}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)[:8_000]
        prompt = (
            f"User request: {ctx.query}\n\n{self._buffer_section(ctx.code)}\n\n"
            f"The latest test failed with this evidence:\n{evidence}\n\n"
            "Find the root cause in the module and fix it with the smallest correct change. "
            "Interactive or entry-point code must stay under `if __name__ == \"__main__\":`. "
            "Return the COMPLETE corrected module in exactly one ```python block, then 1-3 "
            "short lines explaining the cause and the fix."
        )
        reply = self._ask_agent(ctx, "fix", prompt, attempt)
        code = self.extract_python_block(reply)
        if code is None or code == ctx.code:
            reason = "no Python code block" if code is None else "an unchanged module"
            self._handoff(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "nothing_found", {"summary": f"Troubleshooter returned {reason}."})
            self._note(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "fix", f"Fix attempt {attempt}: returned {reason}", reply, "nothing_found")
            self._record(ctx, "fix", "ERROR", f"Troubleshooter returned {reason}")
            self._step_status(ctx, "fix", "error", attempt, f"Returned {reason}.")
            return False
        lines = self.apply_code(ctx, code, "code-troubleshooter")
        self._handoff(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "success", {"summary": "Applied fix to editor.", "changed_lines": len(lines)})
        self._note(ctx, "code-troubleshooter", "fix", f"Fix attempt {attempt} ({len(lines)} lines changed)", reply)
        self._record(ctx, "fix", "SUCCESS", f"Applied fix attempt {attempt} ({len(lines)} changed lines)")
        self._step_status(ctx, "fix", "success", attempt, f"{len(lines)} lines changed")
        return True

    def _fix_loop(self, ctx: CodeSquadRunContext) -> bool:
        """Fix and retest until the tests pass or attempts run out."""
        for attempt in range(1, self.MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
            if not self.step_fix(ctx, attempt):
                return False
            if self.step_test(ctx, attempt):
                return True
        ctx.notes.append(f"Tests still fail after {self.MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS} fix attempts.")
        return False

    @staticmethod
    def _summary(ctx: CodeSquadRunContext, action: str, passed: bool | None) -> str:
        lines = [f"**{action.capitalize()}** finished."]
        for step in ctx.steps:
            mark = "✓" if step.status == "SUCCESS" else "✗"
            lines.append(f"- {mark} {step.details}")
        if passed is True:
            lines.append("\nThe module passed its checks.")
        elif passed is False and ctx.last_test:
            detail = (ctx.last_test.get("stderr") or ctx.last_test.get("stdout") or "").strip()
            if detail:
                lines.append(f"\nLast failure:\n```\n{detail[-1_500:]}\n```")
        lines.extend(ctx.notes)
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # --- entry point -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def run(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        if not request.trace_id:
            request.trace_id = f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
            telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(request.trace_id)
        trace_id = request.trace_id
        action = self.ACTION_ALIASES.get(request.workflow_action, request.workflow_action)
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(CODE_SQUAD_ID) or {}
        params = request.parameters or {}
        editor_code = params.get("editor_code")
        ctx = CodeSquadRunContext(
            trace_id=trace_id,
            request=request,
            code=editor_code if isinstance(editor_code, str) else "",
            plan=str(params.get("plan") or ""),
            model=str(params.get("model") or "") or None,
        )
        if codebuilder_run_state.get_editor_code(trace_id) is None:
            codebuilder_run_state.begin(trace_id, ctx.code, request.user_query, action)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            trace_id, "RUN_STARTED", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
            {"squad_id": CODE_SQUAD_ID, "pattern": squad.get("default_pattern", "sequential")},
        )
        status = "success"
        passed: bool | None = None
        try:
            if action == "plan":
                self.step_plan(ctx)
            elif action == "build":
                if not ctx.plan:
                    stored = code_scratchpad.latest("plan")
                    ctx.plan = stored["content"] if stored else ""
                if not self.step_build(ctx):
                    status = "error"
            elif action == "test":
                passed = self.step_test(ctx)
            elif action == "fix":
                if ctx.last_test is None and self.step_test(ctx):
                    passed = True
                    ctx.notes.append("Tests already pass; no fix was needed.")
                else:
                    passed = self._fix_loop(ctx)
            else:  # all
                self.step_plan(ctx)
                if not self.step_build(ctx):
                    status = "error"
                else:
                    passed = self.step_test(ctx) or self._fix_loop(ctx)
            if passed is False:
                status = "error"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, passed)
        except PipelineCancelled:
            status = "cancelled"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, None) + "\n\nStopped by user."
        except Exception as exc:
            status = "error"
            final_answer = self._summary(ctx, action, None) + f"\n\nWorkflow failed: {exc}"
            telemetry_bus.log_event(
                trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
                {"error": f"Workflow failed: {exc}", "status": "error"},
            )

        self._note(
            ctx, "orchestrator", "summary", f"{action.capitalize()} {status}: {request.user_query[:120]}",
            final_answer, status if status in {"success", "error"} else "nothing_found",
        )
        duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        squad_registry.record_squad_run(CODE_SQUAD_ID, status == "success", duration_ms)
        handoffs = codebuilder_run_state.get_handoffs(trace_id)
        response = OrchestrationResponse(
            trace_id=trace_id,
            pattern=request.pattern or "sequential",
            query=request.user_query,
            status=status,
            final_answer=final_answer,
            result_payload={
                "action": action,
                "plan": ctx.plan,
                "code": ctx.code,
                "last_test": ctx.last_test,
            },
            execution_trace=ctx.steps,
        )
        # Save before RUN_COMPLETE so the client's result fetch never races a 404.
        run_results.save(
            trace_id,
            {
                **response.model_dump(),
                "squad_id": CODE_SQUAD_ID,
                "agent_stats": summarize_agent_usage(telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id)),
                "scratchpad_snapshot": {
                    "latest_subagent_result": handoffs[-1] if handoffs else {},
                    "subagent_history": handoffs,
                },
            },
        )
        telemetry_bus.log_event(
            trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", CODE_SQUAD_ID,
            {"status": status, "duration_ms": duration_ms},
        )
        telemetry_bus.finish_trace(trace_id)
        return response


# --- Dispatch and background runs ------------------------------------------------------

class PipelineRegistry:
    """Maps pattern names to execution strategies and runs orchestration requests.

    Requests for ``code-squad`` always go to the Code Development Squad pipeline.
    """

    PATTERNS: Dict[str, Type[BasePattern]] = {
        "sequential": SequentialPattern,
        "fanout": FanOutPattern,
        "router": RouterPattern,
    }

    def get_pattern(self, pattern_name: str | None) -> BasePattern:
        key = (pattern_name or "sequential").lower().strip()
        pattern_cls = self.PATTERNS.get(key, SequentialPattern)
        return pattern_cls()

    @staticmethod
    def resolve_pattern(request: OrchestrationRequest) -> str:
        """A run's explicit pattern wins; otherwise the registered squad's default applies."""
        if request.pattern:
            return request.pattern
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(request.squad_id or "") if request.squad_id else None
        return str((squad or {}).get("default_pattern") or "sequential")

    def run_orchestration(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> OrchestrationResponse:
        if request.squad_id == CODE_SQUAD_ID:
            return code_squad_pipeline.run(request)
        request.pattern = self.resolve_pattern(request)
        return self.get_pattern(request.pattern).execute(request)


class OrchestrationRunService:
    """Starts orchestration runs on a small background pool, bounded by a capacity limit."""

    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = 2, capacity: int = 10):
        self._executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers, thread_name_prefix="orchestration")
        self._capacity = BoundedSemaphore(capacity)

    def start(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Validate and queue a run; returns its new ``trace_id`` and ``squad_id``."""
        squad = squad_registry.get_squad(request.squad_id or "")
        if squad is None:
            raise ValueError("A registered squad_id is required.")
        if request.workflow_action != "all" and squad["squad_id"] != CODE_SQUAD_ID:
            raise ValueError("Plan, Build, Test, and Fix actions are only available for code-squad.")
        editor_code = request.parameters.get("editor_code", "")
        if not isinstance(editor_code, str):
            raise ValueError("The editor_code parameter must be text.")
        if len(editor_code.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_EDITOR_CONTENT_BYTES:
            raise EditorBufferTooLargeError("The CodeBuilder editor buffer exceeds the 1 MB workflow limit.")
        if request.pattern and request.pattern not in PipelineRegistry.PATTERNS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown pattern: {request.pattern}")
        if not self._capacity.acquire(blocking=False):
            raise RunCapacityError("Orchestration capacity is full. Try again after a run completes.")
        request.trace_id = f"tr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        request.pattern = request.pattern or squad["default_pattern"]
        try:
            codebuilder_run_state.begin(
                request.trace_id,
                editor_code,
                user_query=request.user_query,
                workflow_action=request.workflow_action,
                editor_path=str(request.parameters.get("editor_path") or ""),
            )
            telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(request.trace_id)
            self._executor.submit(self._run_background, request)
        except Exception:
            # If trace initialization fails, do not leave a stale editor buffer behind.
            codebuilder_run_state.discard(request.trace_id)
            self._capacity.release()
            raise
        return {"trace_id": request.trace_id, "squad_id": squad["squad_id"]}

    def _run_background(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> None:
        trace_id = request.trace_id or ""
        try:
            pipeline_registry.run_orchestration(request)
        except Exception:
            history = telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id)
            run_results.save(
                trace_id,
                {
                    "trace_id": request.trace_id,
                    "squad_id": request.squad_id,
                    "status": "error",
                    "final_answer": "Workflow failed. See the execution trace for details.",
                    "result_payload": None,
                    "execution_trace": [],
                },
            )
            if not any(event["event_type"] == "RUN_COMPLETE" for event in history):
                receiver = request.squad_id or "orchestrator"
                telemetry_bus.log_event(
                    trace_id, "ERROR", "orchestrator", receiver,
                    {"error": "Orchestration execution failed", "status": "error"},
                )
                telemetry_bus.log_event(
                    trace_id, "RUN_COMPLETE", "orchestrator", receiver,
                    {"status": "error", "duration_ms": 0},
                )
                telemetry_bus.finish_trace(trace_id)
        finally:
            self._capacity.release()


telemetry_bus = TelemetryBus()
run_results = OrchestrationRunResults()
codebuilder_run_state = CodeBuilderRunState()
squad_registry = SquadRegistry()
code_handoffs = CodeHandoffNormalizer()
subagent_runner = SubAgentRunner()
rag_retriever = RagRetriever()
code_squad_pipeline = CodeSquadPipeline()
pipeline_registry = PipelineRegistry()
run_service = OrchestrationRunService()

````

## `orchestration/schemas_orchestration.py`
```python
"""Pydantic schemas for generic orchestration tasks and the Code Development Squad."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, List, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class TraceStep(BaseModel):
    step_number: int
    agent_id: str
    phase: str
    status: str
    details: str
    error_reason: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: str


class OrchestrationRequest(BaseModel):
    trace_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        max_length=80,
        pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$",
        description="Optional trace ID assigned by the orchestration service",
    )
    squad_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Registered squad to associate with this run"
    )
    pattern: Optional[Literal["sequential", "fanout", "router"]] = Field(
        default=None,
        description=(
            "Execution strategy: 'sequential' (local LLM hardware safety), 'fanout', or 'router'. "
            "Leave unset to use the registered squad's default_pattern."
        ),
    )
    primary_agent: str = Field(
        default="rag-presenter", description="Main user-facing agent ID from library/"
    )
    subagents: List[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Ordered squad member IDs: sub-agents from subAgentLibrary/ or primary agents from library/",
    )
    workflow_action: Literal["all", "plan", "build", "test", "fix", "troubleshoot"] = Field(
        default="all",
        description="Code Development Squad action; 'troubleshoot' is an alias for 'fix'.",
    )
    user_query: str = Field(..., description="User query or task prompt")
    parameters: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Custom parameters")


SquadPattern = Literal["sequential", "fanout", "router"]


class SquadCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    primary_agent: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=80)
    subagents: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    default_pattern: SquadPattern = "sequential"
    max_parallel: int = Field(default=2, ge=1, le=4)


class SquadUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=80)
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    primary_agent: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=80)
    subagents: Optional[List[str]] = Field(default=None, max_length=20)
    default_pattern: Optional[SquadPattern] = None
    max_parallel: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=4)


class SubagentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    subagent_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


class OrchestrationResponse(BaseModel):
    trace_id: str
    pattern: str
    query: str
    status: str
    final_answer: str
    result_payload: Optional[Any] = None
    execution_trace: List[TraceStep] = Field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class CodeSquadRunContext:
    """Mutable state of one Code Development Squad run."""

    trace_id: str
    request: OrchestrationRequest
    code: str
    plan: str = ""
    model: str | None = None
    last_test: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    steps: list[TraceStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def query(self) -> str:
        return self.request.user_query

```

## `ragMemory/README_ragMemory.md`
````markdown
# ragMemory: knowledge sources (RAG)

`ragMemory` is the long-term knowledge base: named **knowledge sources** (a name plus
a folder) are scanned in the background, split into chunks, embedded with a local
**Ollama** model (`nomic-embed-text` by default) and stored in **ChromaDB**. Agents and
apps then retrieve the passages most relevant to a question.

The component has no dependency on the rest of Novous, so the same code and the same
databases can be reused in other applications (see
[Reuse in another application](#reuse-in-another-application)).

## Knowledge sources

Novous supports multiple named knowledge sources from **Knowledge Sources** in
Chat & Test Controls. Each source connects one folder to a matching name and a
separate index. Select a source to search or manage its indexed files.
No implicit default source is created. Older default-source configuration is
migrated to a named branch, retaining its legacy index until that branch is
explicitly deleted.

Agent tools expose a live Knowledge TOC with each branch's exact saved name,
ID, active/archive status, and indexed-document/chunk counts. Agents should
look up a requested branch by name, then pass its ID to search or document
tools. Searching returns relevant indexed passages for the agent's context;
listing documents returns metadata only, while reading a specific indexed
document returns its extracted text. Archived branches remain accessible by ID
because archiving preserves the index.

Sources may point to folders that are currently unavailable; their name and
path remain saved, and indexing reports that the folder cannot be scanned.
Archiving removes a source from active selection without deleting its path or
index. Archived sources can be restored later.

Branches can be renamed without changing their folder or index. Deleting a
branch removes its saved source entry and indexed vectors; it never deletes
files from the linked folder. A branch cannot be deleted while its scan is
queued, running, pausing, stopping, awaiting a file-error decision, or paused.
Deleting a paused branch cancels any scheduled resume and stops its paused
worker before removing the branch. For other active scans, use **Stop
indexing** to stop after the current file finishes; wait until the job status
is **Stopped** before deleting the branch. A stopped source is excluded from
automatic scans until indexing is manually started again.

## Indexing

Indexing runs as a background job. The dialog shows progress and document
errors, and supports pausing or stopping between files, resuming, and
scheduling a resume.
Scheduled resumes use the local time selected in the browser and require the
Novous server and computer to remain running and awake. Completed files remain
indexed; on resume, unchanged files are skipped. Stale-document cleanup occurs
only after a scan reaches completion.

When indexing a file fails, the scan pauses for a choice: retry that file, skip
only that file and ask again on a later error, or skip all remaining errors.
Completion reports checked, indexed, unchanged, skipped, and failed counts so
skipped files are not mistaken for successfully indexed files.

Supported files: `.txt .md .markdown .rst .html .htm .csv .json .xml .yaml .yml
.log .py .js .ts .css .toml .ini .sql .sh .ps1` read as text, and `.pdf .docx
.pptx .odt` through Docling. If Docling's PDF parser cannot load, PDFs with
selectable text fall back to PyMuPDF; scanned PDFs that need OCR still require a
working OCR-capable parser. Text is split into 1,400-character chunks with a
200-character overlap, preferring paragraph breaks.

The automatic scanner cycles through active sources for updates every
60 seconds, with a small delay between files (see `RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS`).

## Storage

Everything lives under one folder, **`RAG_HOME`** (inside Novous: `ragMemory/`):

```
RAG_HOME/
  rag_config.json                 # sources: id, name, folder path, active, selected
  data/
    rag_scan_job.json             # current/last background index job
    rag_indexes/
      <source id>.sqlite3         # manifest: documents (path, mtime, size, chunks) + meta
      chroma/                     # ChromaDB: one collection "kb_<source id>" per source
```

* The **manifest** decides what needs reindexing (file modified time and size) and
  records the embedding model and vector size (`meta` table).
* The **Chroma collection** stores each chunk's text, its embedding and
  `{path, chunk_index}` metadata, using cosine distance. A search hit's `score` is the
  cosine similarity, `1 - distance`.
* Each index refuses vectors from a different embedding model or size. After you change
  `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL`, clear and reindex the existing sources.

**Migration from the old format:** before Chroma, vectors were stored as JSON text in
a `chunks` table inside each `.sqlite3` file. The first time an old index is opened,
its stored vectors are copied into Chroma (no re-embedding), the original file is
kept as `<id>.sqlite3.pre-chroma.bak`, and the old table is dropped. You can delete
the `.bak` files once you're happy with the result. On first start, state from the
former `agentMemory/` package is also moved here; nothing is overwritten.

## Code layout

| Module | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `interface_ragMemory.py` | **The only doorway into the component.** The `/api/rag/*` FastAPI `router`, plus the Python functions `configure`, `get_service`, `list_knowledge_sources`, `selected_source_id`, `search_knowledge`, `list_documents`, `read_document`, `add_text`, `add_source`, `start_scan`, `scan_status` and `start_document_scanner` |
| `mcp_ragMemory.py` | MCP server (stdio) exposing the knowledge base as tools; calls only the interface |
| `schemas_ragMemory.py` | `RagConfig`, `KnowledgeBase`, `DocumentRecord`, `ChunkData`, `ScanJobState`, `ScanStatus`, `ScanDecision`, `SearchHit` |
| `logic_ragMemory.py` | `RagDatabaseEngine` (SQLite manifest + Chroma vectors), `OllamaEmbedder`, `RagConfigStore` (`rag_config.json`), `DocumentIndexer` (parse, chunk, embed), `DocumentScannerService` (background job and scanner loop), `RagMemoryService` (facade) and the `create_rag_memory(home)` factory |
| `pyproject.toml` | Makes the folder pip-installable as `novous-ragmemory` (import name `ragMemory`) |

Within Novous, `server.py` mounts `interface_ragMemory.router` and calls
`start_document_scanner()` at startup. `tools/logic_tools.py`, `orchestration/` and
`core_engine/` use the interface functions. Nothing outside this folder (except the
tests) imports `logic_ragMemory`.

## Reuse in another application

### 1. Prerequisites

* Python 3.10+.
* [Ollama](https://ollama.com) running locally, with the embedding model pulled:

  ```
  ollama pull nomic-embed-text
  ```

  To use Ollama on another machine, set `OLLAMA_HOST`, for example
  `OLLAMA_HOST=http://192.168.1.20:11434`.

### 2. Install

Pick one of the following:

* **pip, editable** (picks up changes made in Novous automatically):

  ```
  pip install -e "E:/NovousV3_claude/ragMemory[documents,mcp]"
  ```

* **pip from git**:

  ```
  pip install "novous-ragmemory[documents,mcp] @ git+<repo-url>#subdirectory=ragMemory"
  ```

* **Copy the folder**: copy `ragMemory/` (without `data/` and `rag_config.json`, unless
  you want the databases too) into the other project's root and install its
  dependencies: `pip install ollama "chromadb>=1.0" fastapi`, plus `docling
  docling-slim[format-pdf-docling] pymupdf` for PDF/Office files and `mcp` for the MCP
  server.

Extras: `documents` (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/ODT parsing) and `mcp` (the MCP server).

### 3. Configure

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `RAG_HOME` | the `ragMemory/` folder | Where `rag_config.json` and `data/` live |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL` | `nomic-embed-text:latest` | Ollama embedding model (`NOVOUS_EMBEDDING_MODEL` still works) |
| `RAG_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` | `16` | Chunks per Ollama embed call |
| `RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS` | `0.15` | Pause between files while scanning; `0` disables it (`NOVOUS_RAG_SCAN_DELAY_SECONDS` still works) |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama server address |

**Outside Novous, always set `RAG_HOME`** (or call `configure(home)`). Otherwise a pip
install would write its data into `site-packages`. Set environment variables before
`ragMemory` is first imported.

### 4. Use it from Python

```python
from ragMemory import interface_ragMemory as rag

rag.configure("C:/MyApp/rag")                      # rag_config.json + data/ go here

source = rag.add_source("Manuals", "C:/MyApp/manuals")   # absolute folder; becomes selected
rag.add_text("faq", "Resetting the device: hold power for 10 s.", source["id"])

rag.start_scan(source["id"])                       # background indexing of the folder
print(rag.scan_status()["status"])                 # queued / running / completed ...

hits = rag.search_knowledge("how do I reset it?", top_k=5, source_id=source["id"])
for hit in hits["results"]:
    print(round(hit["score"], 3), hit["path"], hit["content"][:80])
```

To check for folder changes every 60 seconds, call `rag.start_document_scanner()`.
`rag.get_service()` returns the full `RagMemoryService` (rename, archive, pause/resume,
clear index, and so on) when the doorway functions aren't enough.

### 5. Use it from a FastAPI app

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from ragMemory import interface_ragMemory as rag

rag.configure("C:/MyApp/rag")
app = FastAPI()
app.include_router(rag.router)                      # adds /api/rag/*

@app.on_event("startup")
def start_rag():
    rag.start_document_scanner()
```

The routes are the ones the Novous UI uses: `GET /api/rag/bases`, `POST /api/rag/bases`,
`GET /api/rag/documents`, `POST /api/rag/documents` (add text), `POST /api/rag/reindex`,
`GET /api/rag/scan`, and the rest in `interface_ragMemory.py`.

### 6. Use it from any agent, through MCP

The MCP server offers the tools `list_knowledge_sources`, `search_knowledge`,
`list_documents`, `read_document`, `add_text`, `add_source`, `reindex_source` and
`scan_status`.

```
python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag          # read/search + on-demand indexing
python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag --scan   # also auto-scan folders
ragmemory-mcp --home C:/MyApp/rag                               # same, when pip-installed
```

Claude Code:

```
claude mcp add ragmemory -- python -m ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory --home C:/MyApp/rag
```

Claude Desktop and other MCP clients (`mcpServers` config):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ragmemory": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["-m", "ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory", "--home", "C:/MyApp/rag"],
      "env": { "OLLAMA_HOST": "http://localhost:11434" }
    }
  }
}
```

If you copied the folder instead of installing it, add `"cwd"` pointing to the folder
that *contains* `ragMemory/`, so that `-m ragMemory...` resolves.

### 7. Reuse the databases

To move an existing knowledge base (for example the one Novous built) to another app or
machine:

1. Stop indexing: stop the Novous server, or wait until the scan status isn't running.
2. Copy `rag_config.json` and the whole `data/` folder from the old `RAG_HOME` into the
   new app's `RAG_HOME`. The `.sqlite3` manifests and the `chroma/` folder belong
   together, so copy both.
3. Use the **same embedding model** (`RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL`) in the new app. A
   different model would produce incompatible vectors, and search would ask you to
   reindex.

Search and document reads work straight away, even if the source folders don't exist
on the new machine. Only rescans need the folders. To point a source at its new
location, use `rag.get_service().set_rag_folder(path)` (for the selected source) or edit
`path` in `rag_config.json`. Paths are stored as absolute paths, and documents indexed
from the old path are replaced on the next full scan.

Several apps can point `RAG_HOME` at the **same** folder to share one knowledge base,
as long as only one of them runs the background scanner.

````

## `ragMemory/interface_ragMemory.py`
```python
"""RAG doorway: the only entry point into ragMemory for everything outside the package.

* ``router``: the FastAPI routes under /api/rag/*; ``server.py`` (or any FastAPI app)
  mounts it with ``app.include_router(router)``.
* Python functions for tools, orchestration, the MCP server and other applications:
  ``configure`` picks the data home, the rest delegate to the active RagMemoryService.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from ragMemory import logic_ragMemory
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import RagMemoryService

router = APIRouter()
_service: RagMemoryService | None = None


def configure(home: str | Path | None = None) -> RagMemoryService:
    """Use the RAG config and indexes under ``home``; ``None`` restores the default home."""
    global _service
    if _service is not None:
        _service.scanner.stop_scanner()
    _service = logic_ragMemory.create_rag_memory(home) if home else None
    return get_service()


def get_service() -> RagMemoryService:
    """The active RAG service (the module default unless ``configure`` chose a home)."""
    return _service or logic_ragMemory.rag_memory


def start_document_scanner() -> bool:
    """Start automatic background indexing of the configured knowledge sources."""
    return get_service().start_document_scanner()


def list_knowledge_sources() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Every named source with its id, folder, status and indexed document/chunk counts."""
    return get_service().list_rag_bases()


def selected_source_id() -> str:
    return get_service().config.selected_knowledge_base_id()


def search_knowledge(
    query: str, top_k: int = 5, document_path: str = "", source_id: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Semantic search in one source; ``document_path`` limits it to that (absolute) file."""
    return get_service().search_knowledge_base(query, top_k, document_path, source_id)


def list_documents(source_id: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return get_service().list_documents(source_id)


def read_document(path: str, source_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Indexed metadata plus ``chunks_data`` (text and vectors) of one document."""
    return get_service().get_document(path, source_id)


def add_text(title: str, text: str, source_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Embed pasted text as the document ``manual:<title>``."""
    return get_service().add_text_document(title, text, source_id)


def add_source(name: str, folder: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Register a named source for an absolute folder path and select it."""
    return get_service().add_rag_base(name, folder)


def start_scan(source_id: str | None = None, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Start a background index job for one source; poll ``scan_status``."""
    return get_service().start_rag_scan(source_id, force=force)


def scan_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return get_service().get_rag_scan_job()


@router.get("/api/rag/config")
def api_get_rag_config():
    try:
        return get_service().get_rag_status()
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/api/rag/documents")
def api_list_rag_documents(base_id: str | None = None):
    try:
        return get_service().get_rag_overview(base_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/api/rag/bases")
def api_list_rag_bases():
    return {"bases": get_service().list_rag_bases()}


@router.post("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}/open-folder")
def api_open_rag_base_folder(base_id: str):
    try:
        return get_service().open_rag_base_folder(base_id)
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/bases")
def api_add_rag_base(payload: dict):
    try:
        return get_service().add_rag_base(
            str(payload.get("name", "")),
            str(payload.get("path", "")),
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.put("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}")
def api_rename_rag_base(base_id: str, payload: dict):
    try:
        return get_service().rename_rag_base(base_id, str(payload.get("name", "")))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.delete("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}")
def api_delete_rag_base(base_id: str):
    try:
        return get_service().delete_rag_base(base_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.put("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}/select")
def api_select_rag_base(base_id: str):
    try:
        return get_service().select_rag_base(base_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}/archive")
def api_archive_rag_base(base_id: str):
    try:
        return get_service().archive_rag_base(base_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/bases/{base_id}/restore")
def api_restore_rag_base(base_id: str):
    try:
        return get_service().restore_rag_base(base_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/documents")
def api_add_rag_text(payload: dict):
    try:
        return get_service().add_text_document(
            str(payload.get("title", "")),
            str(payload.get("text", "")),
            str(payload.get("base_id") or "") or None,
        )

        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Embedding failed: {exc}") from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/documents/delete")
def api_delete_rag_document(payload: dict):
    try:
        return get_service().delete_document(
            str(payload.get("path", "")),
            str(payload.get("base_id") or "") or None,
        )
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.put("/api/rag/config")
def api_set_rag_config(payload: dict):
    try:
        return get_service().set_rag_folder(str(payload.get("path", "")))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/reindex")
def api_reindex_rag(base_id: str | None = None):

        return get_service().start_rag_scan(base_id)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.get("/api/rag/scan")
def api_get_rag_scan():

@router.post("/api/rag/scan/pause")

@router.post("/api/rag/scan/stop")

@router.post("/api/rag/scan/resume")
def api_resume_rag_scan():
    try:
        return get_service().resume_rag_scan()

    except RuntimeError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/api/rag/scan/decision")
def api_decide_rag_scan_error(payload: dict):
    try:

## `ragMemory/logic_ragMemory.py`
```python
"""RAG domain logic: named knowledge sources, their isolated indexes, document
parsing/chunking/embedding, the background scanner and semantic search.

Storage per knowledge source: a small SQLite manifest (``rag_indexes/<id>.sqlite3``:
documents and meta) plus a ChromaDB collection (``rag_indexes/chroma/``, collection
``kb_<id>``) holding the chunk text and its Ollama embedding vectors.

Object graph (built by ``create_rag_memory``): RagDatabaseEngine is used by
RagConfigStore; both feed DocumentIndexer, which embeds through OllamaEmbedder;
DocumentScannerService drives the indexer; RagMemoryService is the facade over all of
them. Nothing here imports other Novous components, so the folder can be reused as is;
callers outside this package go through ``interface_ragMemory``.
"""

import json
import logging
import os
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import threading
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from functools import lru_cache
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable, Iterator

import ollama

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)
COMPONENT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
# RAG_HOME holds rag_config.json and data/; inside Novous it is this folder.
RAG_HOME = Path(os.environ.get("RAG_HOME") or COMPONENT_ROOT).expanduser().resolve()
DATA_DIR = RAG_HOME / "data"
LEGACY_ROOT = COMPONENT_ROOT.parent / "agentMemory"


def _env(name: str, default: str) -> str:
    """Read a RAG_* setting, falling back to its former NOVOUS_* name."""
    return os.environ.get(f"RAG_{name}") or os.environ.get(f"NOVOUS_{name}") or default


def migrate_legacy_layout() -> list[str]:
    """Move RAG state left by the former ``agentMemory`` package, once.

    Only paths that do not exist yet in ``ragMemory/`` are moved, so this is a
