## `tests/test_orchestration_usage.py`
```python
import unittest
import uuid
from unittest.mock import patch

from modelProfiles.logic_modelProfiles import model_profiles
from orchestration.logic_orchestration import (
    SQUAD_PINNED_TOOLS,
    subagent_runner,
    summarize_agent_usage,
    telemetry_bus,
)

META = {"id": "worker", "mode": "agent", "tools": ["map_files", "read_agent_scratchpad"], "model": "tiny-model:1b"}


def usage_events(trace_id):
    return [event for event in telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id) if event["event_type"] == "AGENT_USAGE"]


class TestSquadTurnUsage(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.trace_id = f"tr_test_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(self.trace_id)
        patcher = patch.object(subagent_runner, "load_agent", return_value=(dict(META), "You are a worker."))
        patcher.start()
        self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)

    def test_a_turn_reports_its_usage_and_window(self):
        response = {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "done"},
                    "prompt_eval_count": 300, "eval_count": 5}
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", return_value=response) as chat:
            subagent_runner.run_agent_turn("worker", "hi", trace_id=self.trace_id)

        data = usage_events(self.trace_id)[-1]["data"]
        self.assertEqual(chat.call_args.kwargs["options"]["num_ctx"], data["num_ctx"])
        self.assertEqual(data["num_ctx"], 8192)
        self.assertEqual(data["calls"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(data["prompt_tokens"], 300)
        self.assertEqual(data["completion_tokens"], 5)
        self.assertEqual(data["level"], "ok")

    def test_the_tool_limit_keeps_the_handoff_tools(self):
        model_profiles.save("tiny-model:1b", 8192, 1024, 1)
        response = {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "done"}, "prompt_eval_count": 50}
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", return_value=response):
            subagent_runner.run_agent_turn("worker", "hi", trace_id=self.trace_id)

        data = usage_events(self.trace_id)[-1]["data"]
        self.assertEqual(data["tools_total"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(data["tools_active"], 1)
        self.assertIn("read_agent_scratchpad", SQUAD_PINNED_TOOLS)

    def test_a_sub_agent_turn_is_credited_to_the_sub_agent(self):
        response = {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "done"}, "prompt_eval_count": 40}
        with telemetry_bus.agent_context(self.trace_id, "lead"), \
                patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", return_value=response):
            subagent_runner.run_agent_turn("worker", "hi")

        usage = usage_events(self.trace_id)
        self.assertEqual(usage[-1]["sender"], "worker")

    def test_a_model_error_is_reported_before_it_is_raised(self):
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", side_effect=ConnectionError("down")):
            with self.assertRaises(ConnectionError):
                subagent_runner.run_agent_turn("worker", "hi", trace_id=self.trace_id)

        data = usage_events(self.trace_id)[-1]["data"]
        self.assertEqual(data["fail_model_error"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(data["level"], "crit")

    def test_no_telemetry_without_a_trace(self):
        response = {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "done"}, "prompt_eval_count": 40}
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", return_value=response):
            subagent_runner.run_agent_turn("worker", "hi")

        self.assertEqual(usage_events(self.trace_id), [])

    def test_a_streamed_text_turn_reports_usage_from_its_final_chunk(self):
        chunks = [
            {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "he"}},
            {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "llo"}, "prompt_eval_count": 120, "eval_count": 7},
        ]
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", return_value=iter(chunks)) as chat:
            text = subagent_runner.run_agent_turn_stream("worker", "hi", self.trace_id)

        self.assertEqual(text, "hello")
        self.assertEqual(chat.call_args.kwargs["options"]["num_ctx"], 8192)
        data = usage_events(self.trace_id)[-1]["data"]
        self.assertEqual(data["prompt_tokens"], 120)
        self.assertEqual(data["completion_tokens"], 7)
        self.assertEqual(data["num_ctx"], 8192)

    def test_build_profile_carries_max_tool_rounds(self):
        profile = subagent_runner._build_profile("worker", {"id": "worker", "mode": "agent", "max_tool_rounds": 12}, "b")

        self.assertEqual(profile.extras, {"max_tool_rounds": 12})


class TestTelemetryAllowList(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_usage_keys_are_sanitised_and_unknown_keys_dropped(self):
        trace_id = f"tr_test_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        telemetry_bus.initialize_trace(trace_id)
        telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "AGENT_USAGE", "worker", "orchestrator", {
            "agent_id": "worker", "level": "bogus", "flags": ["context_full", "x y"],
            "prompt_tokens": None, "fail_tool_error": -4, "secret": "do not leak",
        })
        telemetry_bus.log_event(trace_id, "TOOL_CALL_END", "worker", "read_file", {
            "tool_name": "read_file", "status": "error", "duration_ms": 3, "error_kind": "nonsense",
        })

        usage, tool_end = telemetry_bus.get_trace_history(trace_id)
        self.assertEqual(usage["data"]["level"], "unknown")
        self.assertEqual(usage["data"]["flags"], "context_full,unknown")
        self.assertEqual(usage["data"]["prompt_tokens"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(usage["data"]["fail_tool_error"], 0)
        self.assertNotIn("secret", usage["data"])
        self.assertEqual(tool_end["data"]["error_kind"], "")


class TestSummary(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_per_agent_totals_and_the_worst_level(self):
        events = [
            {"event_type": "AGENT_USAGE", "sender": "lead", "data": {
                "agent_id": "lead", "model": "m", "num_ctx": 1000, "calls": 2, "prompt_tokens": 300,
                "peak_prompt_tokens": 300, "completion_tokens": 10, "tool_calls": 3, "tool_errors": 1,
                "fail_tool_error": 1, "level": "warn", "flags": "tool_failures"}},
            {"event_type": "AGENT_USAGE", "sender": "worker", "data": {
                "agent_id": "worker", "model": "m", "num_ctx": 1000, "calls": 1, "prompt_tokens": 960,
                "peak_prompt_tokens": 960, "completion_tokens": 4, "tool_calls": 0, "tool_errors": 0,
                "rounds_exhausted": 1, "level": "crit", "flags": "context_full,rounds_exhausted"}},
            {"event_type": "SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF", "sender": "worker", "data": {"direction": "write"}},
            {"event_type": "SCRATCHPAD_HANDOFF", "sender": "lead", "data": {"direction": "read"}},
        ]
        summary = summarize_agent_usage(events)

        by_agent = {agent["agent_id"]: agent for agent in summary["agents"]}
        self.assertEqual(by_agent["lead"]["tool_errors"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(by_agent["lead"]["level"], "warn")
        self.assertEqual(by_agent["worker"]["percent_peak"], 96.0)
        self.assertEqual(by_agent["worker"]["flags"], ["context_full", "rounds_exhausted"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["summary"]["level"], "crit")
        self.assertEqual(summary["summary"]["percent_peak"], 96.0)
        self.assertEqual(summary["summary"]["scratchpad_reads"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(summary["summary"]["scratchpad_writes"], 1)

    def test_an_empty_run_has_no_agents(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize_agent_usage([]), {
            "agents": [],
            "summary": {"level": "ok", "percent_peak": 0.0, "tool_calls": 0, "tool_errors": 0,
                        "scratchpad_reads": 0, "scratchpad_writes": 0},
        })


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

## `tests/test_rag_and_scratchpad_memory.py`
```python
import json
import os
from contextlib import nullcontext
import threading
import tempfile
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from ragMemory import logic_ragMemory
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import document_indexer as indexer
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import document_scanner as scanner
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import rag_config, rag_database, rag_memory
from scratchpadMemory.logic_scratchpadMemory import scratchpad

_chunk_text = indexer._chunk_text


class TestAgentMemory(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp_dir.cleanup)
        self.temp_path = Path(self.temp_dir.name)
        self.database_patch = patch.object(
            rag_database, "DATABASE_PATH", self.temp_path / "knowledge.sqlite3"
        )
        self.scratchpad_path_patch = patch.object(
            scratchpad, "SCRATCHPAD_PATH", self.temp_path / "scratchpad.json"
        )
        self.scratchpad_dir_patch = patch.object(
            scratchpad, "DATA_DIR", self.temp_path
        )
        self.rag_config_path_patch = patch.object(
            rag_config, "CONFIG_PATH", self.temp_path / "rag_config.json"
        )
        self.rag_data_dir_patch = patch.object(
            rag_config, "DATA_DIR", self.temp_path / "rag-data"
        )
        self.database_patch.start()
        self.scratchpad_path_patch.start()
        self.scratchpad_dir_patch.start()
        self.rag_config_path_patch.start()
        self.rag_data_dir_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.database_patch.stop)
        self.addCleanup(self.scratchpad_path_patch.stop)
        self.addCleanup(self.scratchpad_dir_patch.stop)
        self.addCleanup(self.rag_config_path_patch.stop)
        self.addCleanup(self.rag_data_dir_patch.stop)
        rag_database.initialize()
        knowledge_folder = self.temp_path / "knowledge"
        knowledge_folder.mkdir()
        rag_config._write_config({
            "knowledge_bases": [{
                "id": "test",
                "name": "Test Knowledge",
                "path": str(knowledge_folder),
                "active": True,
                "legacy_index": True,
            }],
            "selected_knowledge_base": "test",
        })

    def test_scratchpad_stores_latest_read_and_map(self):
        read = scratchpad.store_read("notes.txt", "remember this", "summarize")
        scratchpad.store_read("second.txt", "also remember this", "compare")
        mapped = scratchpad.store_map({"name": "workspace"}, "workspace")

        memory = scratchpad.read_memory()
        self.assertEqual(memory["latest_read"]["content"], "also remember this")
        self.assertEqual(memory["latest_read"]["request"], "compare")
        self.assertEqual(
            [entry["path"] for entry in memory["read_history"]],
            ["notes.txt", "second.txt"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(memory["latest_map"]["tree"], {"name": "workspace"})
        self.assertEqual(read["path"], mapped["path"])

    def test_read_history_is_bounded_and_clear_removes_saved_memory(self):
        for index in range(scratchpad.MAX_READ_HISTORY + 3):
            scratchpad.store_read(f"file-{index}.txt", str(index))

        history = scratchpad.read_memory()["read_history"]
        self.assertEqual(len(history), scratchpad.MAX_READ_HISTORY)
        self.assertEqual(history[0]["path"], "file-3.txt")
        self.assertEqual(history[-1]["path"], f"file-{scratchpad.MAX_READ_HISTORY + 2}.txt")

        self.assertTrue(scratchpad.clear_memory()["cleared"])
        self.assertEqual(scratchpad.read_memory(), {})

    def test_recall_index_lists_newest_first_with_ids_and_previews(self):
        self.assertEqual(scratchpad.recall(), {"items": [], "total_items": 0, "showing": 0,
                                               "hint": "Nothing is saved yet."})
        scratchpad.store_read("notes.txt", "remember this", "summarize")
        scratchpad.store_map({"name": "workspace"}, "workspace")
        scratchpad.store_read("second.txt", "also remember this", "compare")

        index = scratchpad.recall()
        self.assertEqual(index["total_items"], 3)
        self.assertEqual([row["label"] for row in index["items"]], ["second.txt", "workspace", "notes.txt"])
        self.assertEqual(index["items"][0]["request"], "compare")
        self.assertEqual(index["items"][0]["preview"], "also remember this")
        self.assertTrue(all(row["id"].startswith(f"{row['kind']}-") for row in index["items"]))
        self.assertEqual(scratchpad.recall("all"), index)

    def test_recall_pages_reassemble_the_exact_text(self):
        text = "\n".join(f"line {number} " + "x" * 60 for number in range(600))
        scratchpad.store_read("long.txt", text, "summarize")

        pages, offset = [], "0"
        while True:
            page = scratchpad.recall(item="long.txt", offset=offset, max_chars="4000")
            self.assertLessEqual(len(page["content"]), 4000)
            pages.append(page["content"])
            if not page["truncated"]:
                break
            offset = str(page["next_offset"])

        self.assertGreater(len(pages), 1)
        self.assertEqual("".join(pages), text)
        self.assertEqual(page["total_chars"], len(text))
        self.assertIsNone(page["next_offset"])

    def test_recall_item_by_path_is_newest_and_by_id_is_exact(self):
        first = scratchpad.store_read("notes.txt", "first version", "")
        scratchpad.store_read("notes.txt", "second version", "")

        self.assertEqual(scratchpad.recall(item="notes.txt")["content"], "second version")
        self.assertEqual(scratchpad.recall(item=first["id"])["content"], "first version")

    def test_recall_latest_subagent_keeps_legacy_shape_and_pages_when_large(self):
        scratchpad.store_subagent_result("rag-retriever", "retrieval", "success",
                                         {"results": [{"content": "small"}]})
        small = scratchpad.recall(memory_type="latest_subagent_result")["latest_subagent_result"]
        self.assertEqual(small["payload"], {"results": [{"content": "small"}]})

        big_payload = {"results": [{"content": "evidence " * 800}]}
        scratchpad.store_subagent_result("rag-retriever", "retrieval", "success", big_payload)
        paged = scratchpad.recall(memory_type="latest_subagent_result", max_chars="1000")["latest_subagent_result"]
        self.assertEqual(paged["subagent_id"], "rag-retriever")
        self.assertEqual(paged["payload_format"], "json_text")
        self.assertTrue(paged["truncated"])
        self.assertLessEqual(len(paged["payload"]), 1000)
        self.assertEqual(paged["total_chars"],
                         len(json.dumps(big_payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))))

    def test_recall_clamps_page_size_and_rejects_bad_arguments(self):
        scratchpad.store_read("notes.txt", "x" * 30000, "")
        self.assertEqual(len(scratchpad.recall(item="notes.txt", max_chars="10")["content"]), 500)
        self.assertEqual(len(scratchpad.recall(item="notes.txt", max_chars="99999")["content"]), 20000)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "memory_type must be one of"):
            scratchpad.recall(memory_type="everything")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "whole number"):
            scratchpad.recall(offset="abc")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "offset must be 0 or greater"):
            scratchpad.recall(offset="-1")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "No saved item matches"):
            scratchpad.recall(item="missing.txt")

    def test_document_crud_and_semantic_search(self):
        rag_database.replace_document(
            "workspace/Knowledge Base/guide.md",
            1,
            12,
            "2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
            [
                ("cats and kittens", [1.0, 0.0]),
                ("space and planets", [0.0, 1.0]),
            ],
        )
        with patch("ragMemory.logic_ragMemory.ollama.embed", return_value={"embeddings": [[0.9, 0.1]]}):
            result = rag_memory.search_knowledge_base("cats", top_k=1)

        self.assertEqual(result["results"][0]["content"], "cats and kittens")
        self.assertEqual(rag_memory.list_documents()[0]["chunks"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(rag_memory.delete_document("workspace/Knowledge Base/guide.md")["deleted"])
        self.assertEqual(rag_memory.list_documents(), [])

    def test_stale_document_cleanup_normalizes_path_separators(self):
        rag_database.replace_document(
            "workspace\\Knowledge Base\\keep.md", 1, 1, "now", []
        )
        rag_database.replace_document(
            "workspace/Knowledge Base/remove.md", 1, 1, "now", []
        )

        removed = rag_database.delete_documents_under(
            "workspace/Knowledge Base",
            {"workspace/Knowledge Base/keep.md"},
        )

        self.assertEqual(removed, ["workspace/Knowledge Base/remove.md"])
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["path"] for item in rag_database.list_documents()],
            ["workspace\\Knowledge Base\\keep.md"],
        )

    def test_chunking_preserves_text_and_bounds_chunk_size(self):
        text = ("line of knowledge\n\n" * 120).strip()

        chunks = _chunk_text(text)

        self.assertGreater(len(chunks), 1)
        self.assertTrue(all(len(chunk) <= 1400 for chunk in chunks))
        self.assertTrue(all(chunk in text for chunk in chunks))

    def test_configured_folder_is_scanned_and_root_change_purges_old_entries(self):

        first = self.temp_path / "first"
        second = self.temp_path / "second"
        first.mkdir()
        second.mkdir()
        (first / "a.md").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
        (second / "b.md").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
        embed = {"embeddings": [[0.1, 0.2]]}
        with patch.object(rag_config, "CONFIG_PATH", self.temp_path / "rag_config.json"), \
                patch("ragMemory.logic_ragMemory.ollama.embed", return_value=embed):
            self.assertEqual(
                rag_memory.set_rag_folder(str(first))["path"], str(first.resolve())
            )
            result = indexer.scan_knowledge_base()
            self.assertEqual(result["indexed"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(
                [d["path"] for d in rag_memory.list_documents()],
                [(first / "a.md").resolve().as_posix()],
            )

            rag_memory.set_rag_folder(str(second))
            result = indexer.scan_knowledge_base()
            self.assertEqual(len(result["removed"]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(
                [d["path"] for d in rag_memory.list_documents()],
                [(second / "b.md").resolve().as_posix()],
            )

            cleared = rag_memory.clear_rag_index()
            self.assertEqual(cleared["removed"], 1)
            self.assertEqual(cleared["documents"], 0)

    def test_manual_text_is_added_listed_and_deleted(self):
        with patch("ragMemory.logic_ragMemory.ollama.embed", return_value={"embeddings": [[0.1, 0.2]]}):
            result = rag_memory.add_text_document("  My   note ", "some knowledge")
        self.assertEqual(result["path"], "manual:My note")

    def test_scan_job_can_pause_schedule_resume_and_persist_progress(self):

        folder = self.temp_path / "scheduled"
        folder.mkdir()
        entered_scan = threading.Event()
        pause_gate = threading.Event()
        finished_scan = threading.Event()
        resume_time = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=2)).isoformat()

        def controlled_scan(**kwargs):
            kwargs["progress"](discovered=2, completed=0, current="first.md")
            entered_scan.set()
            pause_gate.wait(2)
            kwargs["pause_point"]()
            kwargs["progress"](completed=1, indexed=1, current="")
            finished_scan.set()
            return {"errors": [], "removed": []}

        with patch.object(rag_config, "CONFIG_PATH", self.temp_path / "scan_config.json"), \
                patch.object(scanner, "JOB_PATH", self.temp_path / "rag_scan_job.json"), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_job", {"status": "idle"}), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_job_thread", None), \
                patch.object(indexer, "scan_knowledge_base", side_effect=controlled_scan), \
                patch.object(rag_config, "DATA_DIR", self.temp_path / "rag-data"):
            base = rag_config.add_knowledge_base("Scheduled", str(folder))
            base_id = base["id"]
            scanner.start_scan_job(base_id)
            self.assertTrue(entered_scan.wait(2))
            scanner.pause_scan_job()
            pause_gate.set()
            deadline = datetime.now() + timedelta(seconds=2)
            while scanner.get_scan_job()["status"] != "paused" and datetime.now() < deadline:
                threading.Event().wait(0.01)
            self.assertEqual(scanner.get_scan_job()["status"], "paused")

            scanner.schedule_scan_resume(resume_time)
            saved = json.loads((self.temp_path / "rag_scan_job.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertEqual(saved["resume_at"], resume_time)
            scanner.resume_scan_job()
            self.assertTrue(finished_scan.wait(2))
            thread = scanner._job_thread
            if thread:
                thread.join(2)
            self.assertEqual(scanner.get_scan_job()["status"], "completed")
            self.assertIsNone(scanner.get_scan_job()["resume_at"])

    def test_stopping_scan_wakes_worker_and_blocks_automatic_restarts(self):
        folder = self.temp_path / "stopping"
        folder.mkdir()
        entered_scan = threading.Event()
        stop_gate = threading.Event()

        def controlled_scan(**kwargs):
            entered_scan.set()
            stop_gate.wait(2)
            kwargs["pause_point"]()
            self.fail("scan continued after it was stopped")

        with patch.object(rag_config, "CONFIG_PATH", self.temp_path / "stop_config.json"), \
                patch.object(scanner, "JOB_PATH", self.temp_path / "rag_scan_job.json"), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_job", {"status": "idle"}), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_job_thread", None), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_stop_requested", threading.Event()), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_pause_requested", threading.Event()), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_resume_event", threading.Event()), \
                patch.object(scanner, "_error_decision_event", threading.Event()), \
                patch.object(indexer, "scan_knowledge_base", side_effect=controlled_scan), \
                patch.object(rag_config, "DATA_DIR", self.temp_path / "rag-data"), \
                patch.object(rag_config, "list_knowledge_bases", return_value=[
                    {"id": "stopping", "active": True}
                ]):
            scanner._resume_event.set()
            base = rag_config.add_knowledge_base("Stopping", str(folder))
            scanner.start_scan_job(base["id"])
            self.assertTrue(entered_scan.wait(2))
            result = scanner.stop_scan_job()
            stop_gate.set()
            thread = scanner._job_thread
            if thread:
                thread.join(2)

            self.assertEqual(result["status"], "stopping")
            self.assertEqual(scanner.get_scan_job()["status"], "stopped")
            self.assertIn(base["id"], scanner.get_scan_job()["stopped_base_ids"])
            self.assertFalse(thread and thread.is_alive())
            deleted = rag_memory.delete_rag_base(base["id"])
            self.assertTrue(deleted["deleted"])
            self.assertNotIn(base["id"], scanner.get_scan_job()["stopped_base_ids"])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

## `tests/test_rag_chroma_store.py`
```python
import json
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from ragMemory import interface_ragMemory, logic_ragMemory, mcp_ragMemory

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def fake_embed(model, input):
    """Deterministic 3-d vectors: 'alpha' texts point one way, everything else another."""
    texts = [input] if isinstance(input, str) else input
    return {"embeddings": [[1.0, 0.0, 0.0] if "alpha" in text else [0.0, 1.0, 0.0] for text in texts]}


class TestRagChromaStore(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(ignore_cleanup_errors=True)
        self.addCleanup(self.temp_dir.cleanup)
        self.home = Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "home"
        self.folder = Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "docs"
        self.folder.mkdir()
        embed_patch = patch.object(logic_ragMemory.ollama, "embed", side_effect=fake_embed)
        embed_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(embed_patch.stop)
        self.service = logic_ragMemory.create_rag_memory(self.home)

    def test_index_search_and_delete_round_trip(self):
        source = self.service.add_rag_base("Docs", str(self.folder))
        (self.folder / "a.md").write_text("alpha facts", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.folder / "b.md").write_text("beta facts", encoding="utf-8")

        result = self.service.indexer.scan_knowledge_base(base_id=source["id"])
        self.assertEqual(result["indexed"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["chunks"] for item in self.service.list_documents(source["id"])], [1, 1]
        )

        hits = self.service.search_knowledge_base("alpha question", top_k=2, base_id=source["id"])
        self.assertEqual(Path(hits["results"][0]["path"]).name, "a.md")
        self.assertAlmostEqual(hits["results"][0]["score"], 1.0, places=5)
        self.assertEqual(hits["skipped_incompatible_chunks"], 0)

        document = self.service.get_document(hits["results"][0]["path"], source["id"])
        self.assertEqual(document["chunks_data"][0]["content"], "alpha facts")
        self.assertEqual(len(document["chunks_data"][0]["embedding"]), 3)

        (self.folder / "a.md").unlink()
        rescan = self.service.indexer.scan_knowledge_base(base_id=source["id"])
        self.assertEqual(len(rescan["removed"]), 1)
        hits = self.service.search_knowledge_base("alpha question", top_k=5, base_id=source["id"])
        self.assertEqual([Path(hit["path"]).name for hit in hits["results"]], ["b.md"])

        cleared = self.service.clear_rag_index(source["id"])
        self.assertEqual(cleared["removed"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(cleared["chunks"], 0)

    def test_factory_keeps_all_state_under_its_home(self):
        source = self.service.add_rag_base("Docs", str(self.folder))
        self.service.add_text_document("note", "alpha note", source["id"])

        self.assertTrue((self.home / "rag_config.json").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.home / "data" / "rag_indexes" / f"{source['id']}.sqlite3").is_file())
        self.assertTrue((self.home / "data" / "rag_indexes" / "chroma").is_dir())
        self.assertNotEqual(self.service.config.CONFIG_PATH, logic_ragMemory.rag_config.CONFIG_PATH)

    def test_deleting_a_source_removes_its_vectors(self):
        source = self.service.add_rag_base("Docs", str(self.folder))
        self.service.add_text_document("note", "alpha note", source["id"])
        self.service.delete_rag_base(source["id"])

        again = self.service.add_rag_base("Docs again", str(self.folder))
        with self.service.config.database_context(again["id"]):
            self.assertEqual(self.service.database.list_chunks(), [])
        self.assertFalse(
            (self.home / "data" / "rag_indexes" / f"{source['id']}.sqlite3").exists()
        )

    def test_legacy_json_chunks_migrate_into_chroma_without_embedding(self):
        source_id = "0123456789abcdef"
        self.home.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.home / "rag_config.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "knowledge_bases": [{
                "id": source_id, "name": "Old", "path": str(self.folder),
                "active": True, "legacy_index": False,
            }],
            "selected_knowledge_base": source_id,
        }), encoding="utf-8")
        manifest = self.home / "data" / "rag_indexes" / f"{source_id}.sqlite3"
        manifest.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        connection = sqlite3.connect(manifest)
        connection.executescript(
            """
            CREATE TABLE documents (path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modified_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
                size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, indexed_at TEXT NOT NULL);
            CREATE TABLE chunks (path TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(path) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, embedding TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (path, chunk_index));
            CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
            INSERT INTO documents VALUES ('old.md', 1, 10, '2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00');
            INSERT INTO chunks VALUES ('old.md', 0, 'alpha legacy', '[1.0,0.0,0.0]');
            INSERT INTO chunks VALUES ('old.md', 1, 'beta legacy', '[0.0,1.0,0.0]');
            """
        )
        connection.commit()
        connection.close()

        with patch.object(logic_ragMemory.ollama, "embed", side_effect=fake_embed) as embed:
            documents = self.service.list_documents(source_id)
            embed.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(documents[0]["chunks"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(manifest.with_name(f"{manifest.name}.pre-chroma.bak").is_file())
        with sqlite3.connect(manifest) as check:
            tables = {row[0] for row in check.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")}
        self.assertNotIn("chunks", tables)

        hits = self.service.search_knowledge_base("alpha?", top_k=1)
        self.assertEqual(hits["results"][0]["content"], "alpha legacy")

    def test_interface_doorway_and_mcp_tools_use_the_configured_home(self):
        self.addCleanup(interface_ragMemory.configure, None)
        interface_ragMemory.configure(self.home)
        source = interface_ragMemory.add_source("Docs", str(self.folder))
        interface_ragMemory.add_text("note", "alpha note", source["id"])

        self.assertEqual(interface_ragMemory.selected_source_id(), source["id"])
        hits = interface_ragMemory.search_knowledge("alpha?", 3)
        self.assertEqual(hits["results"][0]["path"], "manual:note")

        listed = json.loads(mcp_ragMemory.list_knowledge_sources())
        self.assertEqual([(item["name"], item["chunks"]) for item in listed], [("Docs", 1)])
        found = json.loads(mcp_ragMemory.search_knowledge("alpha?", 1, source["id"]))
        self.assertEqual(found["results"][0]["content"], "alpha note")
        document = json.loads(mcp_ragMemory.read_document("manual:note"))
        self.assertEqual(document["content"], "alpha note")

        interface_ragMemory.configure(None)
        self.assertIs(interface_ragMemory.get_service(), logic_ragMemory.rag_memory)


class TestRagComponentBoundaries(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_package_imports_without_other_novous_components(self):
        code = (
            "import sys\n"
            "for name in ('editor', 'core_engine', 'tools', 'orchestration', 'scratchpadMemory'):\n"
            "    sys.modules[name] = None\n"
            "import ragMemory, ragMemory.mcp_ragMemory\n"
            "print(ragMemory.get_service().indexer.embedder.model)\n"
        )
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-c", code], cwd=REPO_ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)

    def test_only_ragmemory_and_tests_import_the_logic_module(self):
        offenders = []
        for path in REPO_ROOT.rglob("*.py"):
            relative = path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
            if relative.parts[0] in {"ragMemory", "tests", "venv", ".git"}:
                continue
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            if "ragMemory.logic_ragMemory" in text or "from ragMemory import logic_ragMemory" in text:
                offenders.append(relative.as_posix())
        self.assertEqual(offenders, [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

## `tests/test_rag_pdf_indexer_fallback.py`
```python
import os
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

import fitz

from ragMemory import logic_ragMemory
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import document_indexer as indexer


class TestPdfIndexerFallback(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_uses_pymupdf_when_docling_pdf_backend_cannot_load(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            pdf_path = Path(directory) / "text.pdf"
            document = fitz.open()
            page = document.new_page()
            page.insert_text((72, 72), "PDF text remains searchable")
            document.save(pdf_path)
            document.close()

            converter = Mock()
            converter.convert.side_effect = ImportError("native parser unavailable")
            with patch.object(indexer, "_doc_converter", converter):
                text = indexer._document_text(pdf_path)

        self.assertIn("PDF text remains searchable", text)

    def test_reports_when_fallback_cannot_extract_pdf_text(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            pdf_path = Path(directory) / "image-only.pdf"
            document = fitz.open()
            document.new_page()
            document.save(pdf_path)
            document.close()

            converter = Mock()
            converter.convert.side_effect = ImportError("native parser unavailable")
            with patch.object(indexer, "_doc_converter", converter):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "scanned PDFs require"):
                    indexer._document_text(pdf_path)


class TestCloudPlaceholderSources(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_failed_cloud_download_reports_how_to_fix_it(self):
        error = OSError(22, "Invalid argument", "notes.docx", 362)
        with patch.object(indexer, "cloud_provider", return_value="OneDrive"), \
                patch.object(indexer, "_is_cloud_placeholder", return_value=True), \
                patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", side_effect=error):
            phases = []
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                RuntimeError, r"File not downloaded: OneDrive.*WinError 362.*Always keep on this device"
            ):
                indexer._document_text(Path("C:/OneDrive/notes.docx"), phase=phases.append)

        self.assertEqual(phases, ["downloading from OneDrive"])

    def test_stuck_cloud_download_times_out_with_a_clear_message(self):
        release = threading.Event()
        self.addCleanup(release.set)
        with patch.object(indexer, "cloud_provider", return_value="Google Drive"), \
                patch.object(indexer, "_is_cloud_placeholder", return_value=False), \
                patch.object(indexer, "CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 0.2), \
                patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", side_effect=lambda: release.wait(5) and b""):
            phases = []
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                RuntimeError, r"File not downloaded: Google Drive did not deliver it within 0.2 seconds.*Available offline"
            ):
                indexer._document_text(Path("G:/My Drive/notes.docx"), phase=phases.append)

        self.assertEqual(phases, ["reading from Google Drive"])

    def test_google_drive_volume_and_onedrive_folder_are_recognised(self):
        with patch.object(logic_ragMemory, "_volume_label", side_effect=lambda anchor: {
            "G:\\": "Google Drive"
        }.get(anchor, "Windows")), patch.dict(os.environ, {"OneDrive": r"C:\Users\me\OneDrive"}):
            self.assertEqual(indexer.cloud_provider(Path(r"G:\My Drive\Resume")), "Google Drive")
            self.assertEqual(indexer.cloud_provider(Path(r"C:\Users\me\OneDrive\Docs")), "OneDrive")
            self.assertIsNone(indexer.cloud_provider(Path(r"C:\Users\me\Desktop\missing")))

    def test_docling_receives_a_stream_of_the_downloaded_bytes(self):
        from docling.datamodel.base_models import DocumentStream

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = Path(directory) / "notes.docx"
            path.write_bytes(b"docx bytes")
            converter = Mock()
            converter.convert.return_value.document.export_to_markdown.return_value = "# Notes"
            with patch.object(indexer, "_doc_converter", converter):
                text = indexer._document_text(path)

        source = converter.convert.call_args.args[0]
        self.assertIsInstance(source, DocumentStream)
        self.assertEqual(source.name, "notes.docx")
        self.assertEqual(source.stream.read(), b"docx bytes")
        self.assertEqual(text, "# Notes")

    def test_pdf_without_text_is_parsed_again_with_ocr(self):
        plain = Mock()
        plain.convert.return_value.document.export_to_markdown.return_value = "<!-- image -->"
        ocr = Mock()
        ocr.convert.return_value.document.export_to_markdown.return_value = "Scanned words"
        phases = []
        with patch.object(indexer, "PDF_OCR", "auto"), \
                patch.object(indexer, "_doc_converter", plain), \
                patch.object(indexer, "_ocr_converter", ocr):
            text = indexer._document_text(Path("scan.pdf"), b"%PDF", phases.append)

        self.assertEqual(text, "Scanned words")
        self.assertEqual(phases, ["parsing", "parsing with OCR"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

```python
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from test_environment.logic_test_environment import sandbox_env


class SandboxEnvTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_package_names_are_validated(self):
        self.assertEqual(sandbox_env.validate_packages(["streamlit", "requests==2.31.0", "numpy>=1.0"]),
                         ["streamlit", "requests==2.31.0", "numpy>=1.0"])
        for bad in ["--index-url http://x", "git+https://x/y", "../local", "a b", "", "pkg;rm"]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=bad):
                sandbox_env.validate_packages([bad])

    def test_third_party_modules_skip_stdlib_and_project_modules(self):
        source = "import os, json\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom cv2 import imread\nfrom tools import interface\nimport a.b\n"
        self.assertEqual(sandbox_env.third_party_modules(source), ["streamlit", "cv2", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(sandbox_env.package_for_module("cv2"), "opencv-python")

    def test_install_uses_sandbox_pip_with_validated_names(self):
        with patch.object(sandbox_env, "ensure_venv", return_value={"ok": True, "output": ""}), \
                patch.object(sandbox_env, "_run", return_value={"ok": True, "output": "done"}) as run:
            result = sandbox_env.install(["streamlit"])
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"])
        command = run.call_args[0][0]
        self.assertEqual(command[1:4], ["-m", "pip", "install"])
        self.assertEqual(command[-1], "streamlit")

    def test_promotion_appends_only_new_packages_to_requirements(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            requirements = Path(temp) / "requirements.txt"
            requirements.write_text("fastapi>=0.110.0\nrequests>=2.0", encoding="utf-8")
            source = "import fastapi\nimport requests\nimport streamlit\nimport cv2\n"
            with patch.object(sandbox_env, "REQUIREMENTS_PATH", requirements), \
                    patch.object(sandbox_env, "list_packages",
                                 return_value=[{"name": "streamlit", "version": "1.40.0"}]):
                added = sandbox_env.add_to_requirements(source)
                again = sandbox_env.add_to_requirements(source)
            self.assertEqual(added, ["streamlit>=1.40.0", "opencv-python"])
            self.assertEqual(again, [])
            lines = requirements.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            self.assertEqual(lines, ["fastapi>=0.110.0", "requests>=2.0", "streamlit>=1.40.0", "opencv-python"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```python
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from tools import logic_tools


class WriteAgentScratchpadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_payload_is_refused_and_nothing_is_stored(self):
        store = Mock()
        with patch.object(logic_tools.scratchpad, "store_subagent_result", store):
            for empty in ("", "   ", "{}", "[]"):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "payload is empty"):
                    logic_tools.write_agent_scratchpad(subagent_id="problem-identifier",
                                                       task_type="critical_thinking", payload=empty)
        store.assert_not_called()

    def test_json_payload_is_stored_as_an_object(self):
        store = Mock(return_value={"id": "x"})
        payload = '{"answers": {"goal": "Move into operations"}, "summary": "Retail leader seeking ops roles."}'
        with patch.object(logic_tools.scratchpad, "store_subagent_result", store):
            logic_tools.write_agent_scratchpad(subagent_id="problem-identifier",
                                               task_type="critical_thinking", payload=payload)

        self.assertEqual(store.call_args.kwargs["payload"]["answers"]["goal"], "Move into operations")

    def test_empty_answers_object_is_still_stored(self):
        store = Mock(return_value={"id": "x"})
        with patch.object(logic_tools.scratchpad, "store_subagent_result", store):
            logic_tools.write_agent_scratchpad(subagent_id="problem-identifier", task_type="critical_thinking",
                                               payload='{"answers": {}, "summary": "No answers were given."}')
        store.assert_called_once()
```

## `tests/test_squads_architect.py`
```python
import pytest

from core_engine.logic_core_engine import agent_library
from squads.logic_squads import squad_architect
from squads.schemas_squads import SquadBlueprint, SquadMember

LEAD = """---
id: lead
name: Lead
description: Runs the squad.
mode: chat
tools: []
---

# Lead

Coordinate the squad.
"""

PEER = LEAD.replace("id: lead", "id: peer").replace("name: Lead", "name: Peer")

WORKER = """id: worker
name: Worker
description: Does background work.
type: subagent
mode: agent
tools:
  - write_agent_scratchpad
prompt: |
  # Worker
"""


@pytest.fixture
def libraries(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    library = tmp_path / "library"
    subagents = tmp_path / "subAgentLibrary"
    library.mkdir()
    subagents.mkdir()
    (library / "lead.md").write_text(LEAD, encoding="utf-8")
    (library / "peer.md").write_text(PEER, encoding="utf-8")
    (subagents / "worker.yaml").write_text(WORKER, encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.setattr(agent_library, "REPO_ROOT", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(agent_library, "LIBRARY_ROOT", library)
    monkeypatch.setattr(agent_library, "SUBAGENT_LIBRARY_ROOT", subagents)
    return library, subagents


def blueprint(**overrides):
    data = {
        "name": "Research Team",
        "pattern": "fanout",
        "lead": SquadMember(agent_id="lead", tools=["read_agent_scratchpad"]),
        "members": [SquadMember(agent_id="peer"), SquadMember(agent_id="worker")],
    }
    data.update(overrides)
    return SquadBlueprint(**data)


def test_describe_agent_reports_kind_tools_and_mode(libraries):
    assert squad_architect.describe_agent("lead")["kind"] == "agent"
    worker = squad_architect.describe_agent("worker")
    assert worker["kind"] == "subagent"
    assert worker["tools"] == ["write_agent_scratchpad"]
    assert squad_architect.describe_agent("ghost") is None


def test_validate_reports_structural_errors_and_handoff_warnings(libraries):
    result = squad_architect.validate(blueprint(
        lead=SquadMember(agent_id="worker"),
        members=[SquadMember(agent_id="ghost", tools=["no_such_tool"])],
        pattern="router",
    ))
    assert not result.ok
    joined = " | ".join(result.errors)
    assert "must be a primary agent" in joined
    assert "Member not found: ghost" in joined
    assert "unknown tools no_such_tool" in joined
    assert "router pattern needs at least two members" in joined

    ok = squad_architect.validate(blueprint(lead=SquadMember(agent_id="lead")))
    assert ok.ok
    assert any("read_agent_scratchpad" in warning for warning in ok.warnings)


def test_save_blueprint_registers_squad_and_applies_tools_and_allow_list(libraries):
    saved = squad_architect.save_blueprint(blueprint(
        members=[SquadMember(agent_id="peer", tools=["read_file"]), SquadMember(agent_id="worker")],
        lead_delegates=True,
    ))

    plan = saved["blueprint"]
    assert plan["pattern"] == "fanout"
    assert [member["id"] for member in plan["members"]] == ["peer", "worker"]
    assert plan["lead"]["tools"] == ["read_agent_scratchpad", "call_subagent"]
    assert plan["lead"]["mode"] == "agent"
    # Only sub-agent members go on the delegation allow-list; peers run through the pattern.
    assert plan["lead"]["allowed_subagents"] == ["worker"]
    assert agent_library.allowed_subagents("lead") == ["worker"]
    assert squad_architect.describe_agent("peer")["tools"] == ["read_file"]

    updated = squad_architect.save_blueprint(blueprint(
        squad_id=plan["squad_id"], pattern="sequential", members=[SquadMember(agent_id="worker")],
    ))
    assert updated["blueprint"]["pattern"] == "sequential"
    assert [member["id"] for member in updated["blueprint"]["members"]] == ["worker"]

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cannot also be a squad member"):
        squad_architect.save_blueprint(blueprint(members=[SquadMember(agent_id="lead")]))
    with pytest.raises(LookupError):
        squad_architect.save_blueprint(blueprint(squad_id="missing"))


def test_attach_and_detach_tool(libraries):
    attached = squad_architect.attach_tool("peer", "read_file")
    assert attached["tools"] == ["read_file"] and attached["mode"] == "agent"
    assert squad_architect.attach_tool("peer", "read_file")["tools"] == ["read_file"]
    assert squad_architect.detach_tool("peer", "read_file")["tools"] == []
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown tools"):
        squad_architect.attach_tool("peer", "no_such_tool")
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        squad_architect.attach_tool("ghost", "read_file")


def test_create_member_scaffolds_either_kind(libraries):
    agent = squad_architect.create_member("agent", "analyst", "Analyst", "Analyses things.")
    sub = squad_architect.create_member("subagent", "fetcher", "Fetcher", "Fetches things.")
    assert agent["kind"] == "agent" and agent["id"] == "analyst"
    assert sub["kind"] == "subagent" and "write_agent_scratchpad" in sub["tools"]

```

## `tests/test_tool_fit.py`
```python
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from core_engine.logic_core_engine import Agent, agent_library, apply_model_limits, tool_catalog
from core_engine.schemas_core_engine import AgentProfile
from modelProfiles.logic_modelProfiles import model_profiles

FIVE_TOOLS = [
    "call_subagent",
    "read_agent_scratchpad",
    "write_agent_scratchpad",
    "write_file",
    "ask_user_window",
]


def make_profile(tools, mode="agent", extras=None):
    return AgentProfile(
        id="fit-test", name="Fit Test", description="", mode=mode, role="", purpose="",
        boundaries="", model="", tools=tools, extras=extras or {},
    )


def limits(max_tools):
    return {"num_ctx": 8192, "max_tools": max_tools}


class ToolFitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tool_catalog.load_tools()

    def fit(self, tools, max_tools, extras=None, mode="agent", model="any-model:1b"):
        agent = Agent(model=model, tools=[], profile=make_profile(tools, mode, extras), session="fit")
        with patch.object(model_profiles, "effective", return_value=limits(max_tools)):
            apply_model_limits(agent, agent.profile, model)
        return agent

    def test_tool_cut_by_the_cap_is_reported_as_dropped(self):
        agent = self.fit(FIVE_TOOLS, max_tools=4)

        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_dropped, ["ask_user_window"])
        self.assertNotIn("ask_user_window", agent.tools)
        stats = agent.run_stats()
        self.assertIn("tools_dropped", stats["flags"])
        self.assertEqual(stats["tools_dropped"], ["ask_user_window"])
        self.assertEqual(stats["level"], "warn")

    def test_agent_pinned_tools_survive_the_cap(self):
        agent = self.fit(FIVE_TOOLS, max_tools=4, extras={"pinned_tools": ["ask_user_window"]})

        self.assertIn("ask_user_window", agent.tools)
        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_dropped, ["write_file"])

    def test_listed_but_unregistered_tool_is_reported_as_missing(self):
        agent = self.fit(["call_subagent", "no_such_tool"], max_tools=None)

        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_missing, ["no_such_tool"])
        stats = agent.run_stats()
        self.assertIn("tools_missing", stats["flags"])
        self.assertEqual(stats["level"], "warn")

    def test_no_cap_and_all_registered_reports_nothing(self):
        agent = self.fit(FIVE_TOOLS, max_tools=None)

        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_dropped, [])
        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_missing, [])
        stats = agent.run_stats()
        self.assertNotIn("tools_dropped", stats["flags"])
        self.assertNotIn("tools_missing", stats["flags"])

    def test_chat_mode_has_no_tools_to_check(self):
        agent = self.fit(FIVE_TOOLS, max_tools=4, mode="chat")

        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_dropped, [])
        self.assertEqual(agent.tools_missing, [])

    def test_pinned_tools_frontmatter_is_read_into_the_profile(self):
        text = (
            "---\n"
            "id: pin-test\n"
            "name: Pin Test\n"
            "mode: agent\n"
            "tools:\n"
            "  - call_subagent\n"
            "  - ask_user_window\n"
            "pinned_tools:\n"
            "  - ask_user_window\n"
            "---\n\n"
            "## Role\nGuide the user.\n"
        )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            path = Path(folder) / "pin-test.md"
            path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
            profile = agent_library.load_agent_definition_from_md(path)

        self.assertEqual(profile.extras.get("pinned_tools"), ["ask_user_window"])


class ToolFitReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tool_catalog.load_tools()

    def report(self, tools, models):
        from core_engine.logic_core_engine import chat_service
        listing = {"models": models, "error": None}
        with patch.object(agent_library, "load_agent", return_value=make_profile(tools)), \
                patch.object(model_profiles, "list_models", return_value=listing), \
                patch.object(model_profiles, "effective", side_effect=lambda model: limits(
                    next(m["max_tools"] for m in models if m["model"] == model))):
            return chat_service.tool_fit_report("fit-test")

    def test_warns_for_each_model_whose_cap_cuts_tools(self):
        models = [{"model": "small:2b", "max_tools": 4}, {"model": "big:7b", "max_tools": 8}]
        report = self.report(FIVE_TOOLS, models)

        self.assertEqual(report["models"][0]["dropped"], ["ask_user_window"])
        self.assertEqual(report["models"][1]["dropped"], [])
        self.assertEqual(len(report["warnings"]), 1)
        self.assertIn("small:2b cuts 1 tool(s): ask_user_window", report["warnings"][0])

    def test_warns_about_tools_that_are_not_registered(self):
        report = self.report(["call_subagent", "no_such_tool"], [{"model": "big:7b", "max_tools": 8}])

        self.assertTrue(any("no_such_tool" in warning and "not registered" in warning
                            for warning in report["warnings"]))

    def test_no_warnings_when_everything_fits(self):
        report = self.report(FIVE_TOOLS, [{"model": "big:7b", "max_tools": 8}])

        self.assertEqual(report["warnings"], [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

````python
import sys

class ToolWorkbenchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_extracts_primary_function_and_builds_agent_schema(self):
        function = tool_workbench.get_function_definition(
            'def calculate(weight: float, *, region: str = "US"):\n'
            '    """Calculate a value."""\n'
            "    return weight\n"
        )

        schema = tool_workbench.get_tool_schema(function)["function"]
        self.assertEqual(schema["name"], "calculate")
        # Agents send every parameter as a string, so the test does too.
        self.assertEqual(schema["parameters"]["properties"]["weight"]["type"], "string")
        self.assertEqual(schema["parameters"]["properties"]["region"]["type"], "string")
        self.assertEqual(schema["parameters"]["required"], ["weight"])

    def test_workbench_schema_matches_the_agent_schema(self):
        source = 'def calculate(weight: float, *, region: str = "US"):\n    """Calculate a value."""\n    return weight\n'
        namespace = {}
        exec(source, namespace)
        agent = Agent.__new__(Agent)  # schema building needs no model or session
        agent_schema = agent._ollama_schema(namespace["calculate"])
        workbench_schema = tool_workbench.get_tool_schema(tool_workbench.get_function_definition(source))
        self.assertEqual(workbench_schema, agent_schema)

    def test_description_override_replaces_docstring(self):
        function = tool_workbench.get_function_definition('def calculate(weight: float):\n    """Docstring."""\n    return weight\n')
        schema = tool_workbench.get_tool_schema(function, description="Use for weights.")
        self.assertEqual(schema["function"]["description"], "Use for weights.")

    def test_rejects_syntax_errors_and_variadic_arguments(self):

            tool_workbench.get_function_definition("def broken(:\n")

            tool_workbench.get_function_definition("def unsafe(*args):\n    return args\n")

        with patch.object(tool_workbench, "run_python_tool", return_value=failed_result):
            with patch.object(tool_workbench, "promote_python_tool") as promote:
                with self.assertRaises(HTTPException) as error:

        self.assertEqual(error.exception.status_code, 400)

    def test_promotes_passing_tool_into_catalog(self):
        first_name = "workbench_test_add"
        second_name = "workbench_test_double"
        first_source = (
            f"def {first_name}(left: int, right: int):\n"
            "    return left + right\n"
        )
        second_source = f"def {second_name}(value: int):\n    return value * 2\n"
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            promoted_path = Path(directory) / "promoted.py"
            with patch.object(tool_registry, "PROMOTED_MODULE_PATH", promoted_path):
                try:
                    promoted = api_promote_tool(ToolWorkbenchRequest(
                        tool_code=first_source, function_input={"left": 2, "right": 3}
                    ))
                    self.assertEqual(promoted["promoted"]["name"], first_name)
                    self.assertEqual(
                        promoted["promoted"]["path"], "tools/promoted_tools.py"
                    )
                    second_promoted = api_promote_tool(ToolWorkbenchRequest(
                        tool_code=second_source, function_input={"value": 3}
                    ))
                    self.assertEqual(second_promoted["promoted"]["name"], second_name)
                    promoted_source = promoted_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                    self.assertLess(
                        promoted_source.index(first_name), promoted_source.index(second_name)
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(
                        tool_catalog.registry[first_name]["function"](2, 3), 5
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(
                        tool_catalog.registry[second_name]["function"](3), 6
                    )
                finally:
                    tool_catalog.registry.pop(first_name, None)
                    tool_catalog.registry.pop(second_name, None)

    def test_promotes_tool_with_top_level_import(self):
        tool_name = "workbench_test_fraction"
        source = (
            "import fractions as workbench_test_fraction_module\n\n"
            f"def {tool_name}(value: int):\n"
            "    return str(workbench_test_fraction_module.Fraction(value, 2))\n"
        )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            promoted_path = Path(directory) / "promoted.py"
            with patch.object(tool_registry, "PROMOTED_MODULE_PATH", promoted_path):
                try:
                    result = api_promote_tool(ToolWorkbenchRequest(
                        tool_code=source, function_input={"value": 3}
                    ))
                    self.assertEqual(result["promoted"]["name"], tool_name)
                    self.assertEqual(
                        tool_catalog.registry[tool_name]["function"](3), "3/2"
                    )
                    promoted_source = promoted_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                    self.assertIn(
                        "import fractions as workbench_test_fraction_module\n\n"
                        f"@tool\ndef {tool_name}",
                        promoted_source,
                    )
                finally:
                    tool_catalog.registry.pop(tool_name, None)

    def test_custom_tool_source_can_be_loaded_and_removed_from_library(self):
        tool_name = "workbench_library_tool"
        remaining_name = "workbench_library_remaining"
        source = (
            f"@tool\ndef {tool_name}(value: int):\n    return value * 2\n\n\n"
            f"@tool\ndef {remaining_name}(value: int):\n    return value + 1\n\n"
        )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            promoted_path = Path(directory) / "promoted.py"
            promoted_path.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
            with patch.object(tool_registry, "PROMOTED_MODULE_PATH", promoted_path):
                try:
                    exec(source, {"tool": tool_catalog.tool, "__name__": "tools.promoted_tools"})
                    loaded = tool_workbench.get_custom_tool_source(tool_name)
                    self.assertEqual(
                        loaded["source"],
                        f"@tool\ndef {tool_name}(value: int):\n    return value * 2\n",
                    )
                    self.assertEqual(loaded["path"], "tools/promoted_tools.py")
                    self.assertIn(tool_name, tool_catalog.registry)
                    self.assertIn(remaining_name, tool_catalog.registry)

                    removed = tool_workbench.delete_custom_tool(tool_name)
                    self.assertTrue(removed["deleted"])
                    self.assertTrue(promoted_path.exists())
                    self.assertNotIn(tool_name, tool_catalog.registry)
                    self.assertIn(remaining_name, tool_catalog.registry)
                    self.assertIn(remaining_name, promoted_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

                    tool_workbench.delete_custom_tool(remaining_name)
                    self.assertNotIn(remaining_name, tool_catalog.registry)
                    self.assertTrue(promoted_path.exists())
                    self.assertNotIn(remaining_name, promoted_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                finally:
                    tool_catalog.registry.pop(tool_name, None)
                    tool_catalog.registry.pop(remaining_name, None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

````

```python
import json
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import os

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from core_engine.logic_core_engine import Agent, tool_catalog
from core_engine.schemas_core_engine import AgentProfile
from ragMemory.logic_ragMemory import document_scanner, rag_config, rag_memory
from scratchpadMemory.logic_scratchpadMemory import scratchpad
from server import app
from editor.logic_editor import editor_files
from file_manager.logic_file_manager import file_backend
from tools.logic_tools import read_agent_scratchpad, tool_registry, workspace_files


class TestToolsInterface(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tool_catalog.load_tools(reload=True)

    def tearDown(self):
        tool_catalog.load_tools(reload=True)

    def test_agent_tool_events_include_bounded_return_results(self):
        def successful_tool():
            return {"path": "notes/result.txt", "written": True}

        def failing_tool():
            raise ValueError("write failed")

        agent = Agent(
            model="test-model",
            tools=[successful_tool, failing_tool],
            profile=AgentProfile(mode="agent"),
        )
        agent.act(
            {"function": {"name": "successful_tool", "arguments": {}}},
            "native",
        )
        agent.act(
            {"function": {"name": "failing_tool", "arguments": {}}},
            "native",
        )

        success, failure = agent.tool_events
        self.assertEqual(success["status"], "success")
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(success["result"]),
            {"path": "notes/result.txt", "written": True},
        )
        self.assertEqual(failure["status"], "error")
        self.assertEqual(failure["error"], "write failed")

    def test_agent_executes_tool_json_embedded_in_explanatory_text(self):
        calls = []

        def read_agent_scratchpad(memory_type="all"):
            calls.append(memory_type)
            return '{"latest_subagent_result":{"status":"success"}}'

        agent = Agent(
            model="test-model",
            tools=[read_agent_scratchpad],
            profile=AgentProfile(mode="agent"),
        )
        responses = [
            {
                "message": {
                    "content": (
                        "Here is the JSON for a function call:\n"
                        '{"name": "read_agent_scratchpad", "parameters": '
                        '{"memory_type": "latest_subagent_result"}}'
                    )
                }
            },
            {"message": {"content": "Scratchpad retrieval succeeded."}},
        ]
        with patch("core_engine.logic_core_engine.ollama.chat", side_effect=responses):
            reply = agent.think("Check the latest sub-agent result")

        self.assertEqual(calls, ["latest_subagent_result"])
        self.assertEqual(reply, "Scratchpad retrieval succeeded.")
        self.assertEqual(agent.tool_events[0]["tool"], "read_agent_scratchpad")
        self.assertEqual(agent.tool_events[0]["origin"], "text_json")

    def test_rag_presenter_format_answer_json_becomes_markdown(self):
        agent = Agent(

            tools=[],

    def test_scratchpad_api_reads_and_clears_saved_memory(self):
        client = TestClient(app)
        with patch.object(scratchpad, "read_memory", return_value={"latest_read": {"path": "a.txt"}}):
            response = client.get("/api/agent-memory/scratchpad")

    def test_python_doorway_delegates_to_file_and_editor_services(self):
        with (
            patch.object(
                file_backend,
                "directory_tree",
                return_value={"path": "docs"},
            ) as tree,
            patch.object(
                file_backend,
                "list_directory",
                return_value={"entries": []},

            ) as write,

                "delete_path",

            ) as delete,
            patch.object(
                editor_files,

                return_value={"path": "", "children": []},
            ) as editor_tree,

        ):

            self.assertEqual(

            self.assertTrue(workspace_files.delete_file("docs/old.txt")["deleted"])

            self.assertEqual(
                workspace_files.editor("write", path="readme.md", content="editor")[

        delete.assert_called_once_with("docs/old.txt")
        editor_read.assert_called_once_with("readme.md")

    def test_register_get_remove_round_trip(self):
        source = (
            "def calc_square(n: int) -> int:\n"
            "    \"\"\"Calculate square of n.\"\"\"\n"
            "    return n * n\n"
        )
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            promoted_path = Path(td) / "promoted.py"
            header = (
                '"""Custom tools promoted from the Function Testing Workbench."""\n'
                'from core_engine.logic_core_engine import tool\n\n'
                '# PROMOTION_MARKER: tools appended below will be registered as custom tools\n\n'
            )
            promoted_path.write_text(header, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
            initial_bytes = promoted_path.read_bytes()

            with patch.object(tool_registry, "PROMOTED_MODULE_PATH", promoted_path):
                # 1. Register
                reg_result = tool_registry.register_tool(source, "calc_square")
                self.assertEqual(reg_result["name"], "calc_square")
                self.assertEqual(reg_result["path"], "tools/promoted_tools.py")

                # 2. Get tool callable
                fn = tool_registry.get_tool("calc_square")
                self.assertIsNotNone(fn)
                self.assertEqual(fn(5), 25)

                library = {t["name"]: t for t in tool_registry.list_tools_directory()}
                self.assertTrue(library["calc_square"]["custom"])

                # 3. Get tool source
                src_info = tool_registry.get_tool_source("calc_square")
                self.assertEqual(src_info["name"], "calc_square")
                self.assertIn("calc_square", src_info["source"])
                self.assertEqual(src_info["path"], "tools/promoted_tools.py")

                # 4. Remove tool
                del_result = tool_registry.remove_tool("calc_square")
                self.assertTrue(del_result["deleted"])
                self.assertIsNone(tool_registry.get_tool("calc_square"))

                # 5. Check byte-identical
                after_bytes = promoted_path.read_bytes()
                self.assertEqual(initial_bytes, after_bytes)
```

```python
import json
import sys
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from tools import logic_tools
from tools.logic_tools import FileReadLimitError, workspace_files


class TestReadTool(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        workspace_files._doc_converter = None

    def tearDown(self):
        workspace_files._doc_converter = None

    def _source(self, path: str, content: bytes = b"%PDF") -> dict:
        return {
            "path": path,
            "resolved_path": Path(path),
            "size_bytes": len(content),
            "content": content,
        }

    def test_reads_text_files_as_utf8(self):
        read_bytes = Mock()
        read_bytes.return_value = self._source("notes.txt", "hello".encode("utf-8"))

        with patch.object(workspace_files, "read_file_bytes", read_bytes):
            source, content = workspace_files.read_document("notes.txt")

        self.assertEqual(source["path"], "notes.txt")
        self.assertEqual(content, "hello")

    def test_extracts_pdf_text_with_docling(self):
        read_bytes = Mock()
        read_bytes.return_value = self._source("manual.pdf")
        document = Mock()
        document.export_to_markdown.return_value = "# Manual"
        converter = Mock()
        converter.convert.return_value.document = document

        with (
            patch.object(workspace_files, "read_file_bytes", read_bytes),
            patch.object(workspace_files, "_get_docling_converter", return_value=converter),
        ):
            source, content = workspace_files.read_document("manual.pdf")

        self.assertEqual(content, "# Manual")
        converter.convert.assert_called_once_with("manual.pdf")

    def test_docling_converter_enables_ocr_for_pdf(self):
        input_format = object()
        input_formats = types.ModuleType("docling.datamodel.base_models")
        input_formats.InputFormat = types.SimpleNamespace(PDF=input_format)

        pipeline_options = Mock()
        pipeline_options_module = types.ModuleType("docling.datamodel.pipeline_options")
        pipeline_options_module.PdfPipelineOptions = Mock(return_value=pipeline_options)

        converter_module = types.ModuleType("docling.document_converter")
        converter_class = Mock(return_value=object())
        pdf_format_option = Mock()
        converter_module.DocumentConverter = converter_class
        converter_module.PdfFormatOption = pdf_format_option

        modules = {
            "docling": types.ModuleType("docling"),
            "docling.datamodel": types.ModuleType("docling.datamodel"),
            "docling.datamodel.base_models": input_formats,
            "docling.datamodel.pipeline_options": pipeline_options_module,
            "docling.document_converter": converter_module,
        }
        with patch.dict(sys.modules, modules):
            workspace_files._get_docling_converter()

        self.assertTrue(pipeline_options.do_ocr)
        pdf_format_option.assert_called_once_with(pipeline_options=pipeline_options)
        converter_class.assert_called_once_with(
            format_options={input_format: pdf_format_option.return_value}
        )

    def test_reports_oversized_pdf_with_actionable_message(self):
        read_bytes = Mock()
        read_bytes.side_effect = FileReadLimitError("over limit")

        with patch.object(workspace_files, "read_file_bytes", read_bytes):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "25 MB.*Split or compress"):
                workspace_files.read_document("manual.pdf")

    def test_reports_unreadable_pdf_without_fabricating_content(
        self,
    ):
        read_bytes = Mock()
        read_bytes.return_value = self._source("locked.pdf")
        converter = Mock()
        converter.convert.side_effect = ValueError("bad PDF")

        with (
            patch.object(workspace_files, "read_file_bytes", read_bytes),
            patch.object(workspace_files, "_get_docling_converter", return_value=converter),
        ):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "encrypted, damaged, unsupported"):
                workspace_files.read_document("locked.pdf")

    def test_stores_extracted_document_text_in_agent_memory(
        self,
    ):
        read_content = Mock()
        store_read = Mock()
        read_content.return_value = (self._source("manual.pdf"), "# Manual")
        store_read.return_value = {
            "path": "agentMemory/data/scratchpad.json",
            "updated_at": "2026-10-21T00:00:00+00:00",
        }

        with (
            patch.object(workspace_files, "read_document", read_content),
            patch.object(logic_tools.scratchpad, "store_read", store_read),
        ):
            result = json.loads(logic_tools.read_file("manual.pdf", "summarize"))

        self.assertEqual(result["content"], "# Manual")
        self.assertEqual(result["content_type"], "document_text")
        store_read.assert_called_once_with("manual.pdf", "# Manual", "summarize")

    def test_long_read_returns_first_page_and_stores_full_text(self):
        long_text = "line\n" * 2000
        read_content = Mock(return_value=(self._source("long.md"), long_text))
        store_read = Mock(return_value={
            "path": "scratchpadMemory/data/scratchpad.json",
            "updated_at": "2026-10-21T00:00:00+00:00",
        })

        with (
            patch.object(workspace_files, "read_document", read_content),
            patch.object(logic_tools.scratchpad, "store_read", store_read),
        ):
            result = json.loads(logic_tools.read_file("long.md", "summarize"))

        store_read.assert_called_once_with("long.md", long_text, "summarize")
        self.assertTrue(result["truncated"])
        self.assertLessEqual(len(result["content"]), 4000)
        self.assertEqual(result["total_chars"], len(long_text))
        self.assertEqual(result["next_offset"], len(result["content"]))
        self.assertIn("read_agent_scratchpad(item='long.md', offset='", result["scratchpad"]["context"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```python
"""Tools doorway: FastAPI router for /api/tools/* (catalog, library, health, custom
tool registration and the paged workspace map)."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from core_engine.logic_core_engine import tool_catalog
from tools.logic_tools import ToolConflictError, ToolNotFoundError, ToolReadOnlyError, tool_registry, workspace_files
from tools.schemas_tools import MapPageRequest, RegisterToolRequest, ToolPromptRequest, UpdateToolRequest

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/api/tools")
def api_list_tools():
    rep = tool_registry.catalog_report()
    return {
        "tools": tool_registry.list_tools(),
        "providers": tool_registry.provider_bindings(),
        "warnings": rep.get("warnings", []),
    }


@router.get("/api/tools/library")
def api_tool_library():
    return {"tools": tool_registry.list_tools_directory()}


@router.get("/api/tools/health")
def api_tools_health():
    errors = tool_catalog.get_load_errors()
    return {
        "status": "healthy" if not errors else "degraded",
        "load_errors": errors,
        "warnings": tool_registry.catalog_report().get("warnings", []),
    }


@router.post("/api/tools/register")
def api_register_tool(req: RegisterToolRequest):
    try:
        return tool_registry.register_tool(req.source, req.name)
    except ToolConflictError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/api/tools/map-page")
def api_map_page(req: MapPageRequest):
    tool_catalog.load_tools()
    try:
        return workspace_files.render_map_page(req.path, req.max_depth, req.include_files, req.offset)
    except (PermissionError, ValueError, NotADirectoryError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/api/tools/{name}")
def api_get_tool(name: str):
    tool_catalog.load_tools()
    meta = tool_catalog.registry.get(name)
    if not meta:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Tool '{name}' not found.")
    promoted = set(tool_registry.list_promoted_tool_names())
    return {
        "name": meta["name"],
        "provider": meta["provider"],
        "description": meta["description"],
        "signature": meta["signature"],
        "custom": meta["name"] in promoted or meta.get("custom", False),
    }


@router.get("/api/tools/{name}/details")
def api_get_tool_details(name: str):
    try:
        return tool_registry.get_tool_details(name)
    except ToolNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))


@router.put("/api/tools/{name}")
def api_update_tool(name: str, req: UpdateToolRequest):
    try:
        return tool_registry.update_tool(name, req.source)
    except ToolReadOnlyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc))


@router.put("/api/tools/{name}/prompt")
def api_set_tool_prompt(name: str, req: ToolPromptRequest):
    try:
        return tool_registry.set_prompt_description(name, req.prompt_description)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc))


@router.delete("/api/tools/{name}")
def api_delete_tool(name: str):
    try:
        return tool_registry.remove_tool(name)
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc))
```
